<The authority of the Unnamed Kainos Emperor has undergone an unknown change.>
WAA!
His radiant crown flashed amidst the raging splendorous white gold essence surging around him as the ecritures of <ETHEREAL EMPE> gained a distinct sandy golden glow that was hard to miss.
Noah's will gazed at this unique phenomenon as even the prompt for it stated that the change was unknown!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1784
paragraphs: Chapter 1784 A Mythical Natural Born Physique! ll
A change to his authority had occurred as while Noah was surrounded by surging essence and cracks of another Dimension entirely, he couldn't help but pay attention to this!

Even while Sanguine Adequation was working on overdrive to redirect the strength of the body to the Soul and slow down the raging elevation of all of Noah's physiques so that he didn't reach the limit of his body before finishing the full advancement of the newly born Physique..Noah couldn't help but gaze at his crown that showed off his authority!
The unknown change that had occurred dealt with too many unknowns as he couldn't help but ask the existence that seemed to know a great deal.
"What changes occur to the authority when one gains something linked to a Dimension?"
WAA!
Yes.
The change stemmed from the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique.
But even as Noah asked, Lavalliere remained silent as she uttered no words!
This was because this involved too many secrets.
Just what was the authority of Emperors that existences were building up in this Age? How did it relate to the Infinite Realities, and how did it relate to the current Realities?

Did it have anything to do with the vast Dimensions like the Mirror and Dream Dimensions that seemed to have their own unknown forces and Hegemonies? And how did all of this fit into Lavalliere calling the vast Realities Barren Lands?!

The biggest question of all was the seat of the True Emperor that OPPENHEIMER had attained in the last Age and used its authority to do something utterly shocking. What exactly was this and what secrets did it hold...
These questions and many swirled in Noah's mind as he had no answers, only gazing at his spinning crown and ecritures silently as boundless essence still surged around him.
Meanwhile, the description of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique slowly became clear in his mind as Noah condensed its many prompts into a singular definition.

[<Mythical Natural Born Dream Physique>:: The elevation of the Infinite Dream Physique born from Absolute Dream Authority. Even though you weren't born with it, you have undergone a successful budding of this physique and have been recognized by the Dream Dimension. A unique Dream Physique that fundamentally changes a core of your being is born as you are granted the capability to convert your True Reality Damage and Defense Values to True Dimensional Dream Damage and Defense Values. Different to True Reality Damage Values, True Dimensional Dream Damage Values impose the Reality altering debuff effects of <Endless Dream>, causing the abilities of the target to gradually enter the dwelling of dreams and become deactivated. If one suffers enough True Dimensional Dream Damage, their Ascendancy Halos, Reality Passages, and other forms of Authority will gradually also become deactivated and unusable as at the end of it all- even their very Aspects of Existence shall forever fall into an Endless Dream...]
Barely a half of the description of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique came down as its contents were already terror inducing for any being unlucky enough to be Noah's enemy!

One of the many boons of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique was that Noah could convert his damage and Defenses into Dimensional Damage and Defence Values. But...what did this exactly mean?
How much more of his True Reality Damage Values could get through to other existences, and how much stronger were his defenses?!

This wasn't listed in the details as what was listed was the shocking perk of the True Dimensional Dream Damage being capable of making everything about the enemy fall into the land of dreams. Their concepts, Halos, Reality Passages, and even their Aspects of Existence! Such a thought alone was terrifying as apart from Noah being able to suppress others with his Infinite Reality Passages- he could now do even deadlier oppression so long as he began to deal damage to them.
His eyes hungrily searched for the remaining portion of the details of this Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique!

[...The Mythical Natural Born Dream Physique also grants an unnatural amount of Dream Essence Reserves through the ability <Dreamling>, a passive ability that also allows you to move across the boundaries of the Dream Dimension unhindered among other things. The <Dimensional Dream Tamer> ability is also granted as it allows you to tame a small number of existences bound to the Dream Dimension so long as you can defeat them. Other features and an elevation of the features of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique will be unlocked when another 20 new Cycles Pass...>]
"Beautiful..."
Noah's eyes shone with dazzling light as his surroundings began to calm.

His Infinite Reality Passages gushed with a myriad of essences as the Dimensional Dream Essence became among those at the very forefront, Noah's body becoming bathed in resplendent stellar multicolored light and drizzles of sandy gold as he seemed like a celestial creature floating in the skies!

Yet his eyes released luminous lights of excitement at the sheer details of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique that granted <Dreamling> and <Dimensional Dream Tamer> as some more of its features- with more waiting for Noah to unlock as he increased his cycles in this Physique.
The number of cycles was an additional 20 as even though it wasn't hard for Noah to reach this number, it would be impossible for the foreseeable future!
That is...unless he breaks the shackles of the Firmament of Ascendancy and forms his Reality.

This was because his Body neared completion as he had to burn it at this moment as all his Physiques were automatically being raised due to the completion of the 10th Cycle, with his shackles of the Seventh Firmament that he had released when he formed his passages taking his Ascendancy Value past the 999 million of the Eighth Firmament of Ascendancy as he reached the Ascendancy Value exceeded the 1 Billion that marked the beginning of the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy and reach 9.9 Billion of the peak Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy at this point in time!

An Ascendancy Value that didn't mean much for the level of strength of Limit Breakers and other genius existences- a Value that was incomparably far from Noah just weeks ago...but he had achieved it so seamlessly at this moment.

He had attained this and much more as at this moment, he couldn't help but gaze at his Aspects of Existence that were painted with a golden sandy hue that represented the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique!

The peak of the Seventh Firmament has been revised to be 99 Million Ascendancy Values. 100 Million signifies entrance into the Eighth Firmament of Ascendancy, with the peak being 999 Million. 1 Billion signifies entrance into the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy, with the peak being 9.9 Billion.

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1785
paragraphs: Chapter 1785 A Mythical Natural Born Physique! lll
In the Purple Endeavor streaking across space.

The eyes of Noah's True Sanguine Clone that was acting as Alexander flashed with shocking radiance right before his main body had undergone the change and attained the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique!

The brought about change affected all of the Clones as it was rather drastic, where Noah's destiny told him he had to act fast to make sure that his clone wasn't seen through even under the veil of LETHE!

The eruption of Essence was simply too destructive as his Body attained shocking levels of strength, his clone instantly sitting down in a meditative position aboard the vast deck of the Purple Endeavor where he was surrounded by Legions of Primordial Adjudicators behind him shimmering with Valor and power, and the visage of Genevieve and Brightborn ahead of him as more monstrous existences were hidden bow this TABOO Vessel.
BZZZT!

To hide the undeniable Essence that was about to erupt from his clone, Noah had to either cut off the connection with this clone and disable it entirely- this bringing its death...or he could mask the eruption of essence of his Body attaining a Dimensional Physique with surges of Essence of Reality!
The Essence that interwove around the Natural Laws of Reality to make up the very Reality itself.
This was the only thing Noah had in his arsenal that he felt could mask the eruption of Dream Essence as with the aid of LETHE...
BOOM!

His meditating body was seen to erupt with a storm of Essence of Reality that pushed those nearby away, the eyes of Brightborn and Genevieve locking onto him instantly as others moved back in alarm and shock!

The genius Royal Humans aboard this vessel looked at the overpowering bursts of strength the visage of this being released as his very skin had coiling arcs of unidentifiable light that far surpassed anything in the Firmaments of Ascendancy!
"Is he actually close to...exceeding the Limits of the Body and becoming a Limit Breaker?"
A small voice of a nearby Adjudicator Commander that was under Katelyn spoke out in disbelief.

This was because they knew the genius follower of Genevieve appeared to have forged three Physiques successfully, being extremely strong with his body as he had even bathed in the Sacred Blood Sea to nearly attain a Bloodline onto True Royalty of the Royal Humans from the Pure Reality held!
"Haha, good! If he succeeds, you would have a truly strong body practitioner by your side, Little Gen!"
Brightborn's strong voice was jovial as this being was happier that those he had agreements with were getting more powerful- only thinking of the possible boons he would be getting in the end.
Meanwhile, the eyes of Genevieve hid their hidden somberness as in her eyes- the enemy she had resolved to devour the talent of only became more difficult for her to handle.
These were the destinies of Chosen Emperors.
They would somehow be exceeding their Limits out of nowhere as one might be considered crazy to ever target them!
But Genevieve remained steadfast in her aims as she knew of one particular being that had succeeded.
OPPENHEIMER!
He had hunted Chosen Emperors and butchered them like chickens on his path to becoming a True Emperor.
So Genevieve raised her head high as she held a level of confidence due to the number of TABOO Edicts and a Physique she had pulled from her old Body and Origin in the Royal Treasury!
'Surely, I can handle a single Chosen Emperor that hasn't even become a LEGEND...'

Her eyes shone luminously with such thoughts as on the deck below, the figure of Katelyn that was isolated from everything else in a unique spatially enclosed room opened her glazed silver eyes at this moment to lock onto Noah who others saw to be undergoing a breakthrough with his Body.

Her Mirror like eyes bypassed the vibrant layers of multicolored Essence of Reality that Noah was utilizing with LETHE to fool the eyes of others as she saw a trace of Dimensional Essence, her eyes becoming filled with sharp radiance as more curiosity arose from this being she had secretly observed before!

The Purple Endeavor continued on as Brightborn had to collect more genius existences he had made deals with before making way towards the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, the identity of the Royal Human known as Alexander becoming elevated in the eyes of many as he became an existence that might very soon exceed the limits of the Body under their eyes!
With his True Sanguine Clone covered, Noah's main body retained most of its will as he took a closer look at his shimmering body as the surging essences around him calmed down every so little.
BZZT!

Above him, the 49th Infinite Reality Passage formed as it rained down glorious rivers of essence, Noah having a difficult expression on his body as when he felt the robust strength brought about by the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique, he knew that none of the many Physiques that had gained another chance to be refined would be able to finish their refinements unless he forged his Reality!

His body had truly reached its utmost Limitations as he could go no further without undergoing resonance of his Three Aspects of Existence, where even now as he burned the Body with Sanguine Adequation to raise the soul, it would raise back towards the unbreakable ceiling soon after.
Seeing this situation, Noah sighed as Lavalliere's voice echoed out.
<I think you've prepared more than enough, no? Your soul's just about to be full as well, with the only other possibilities and opportunities lying in the hands of fate and destiny.>
He had prepared enough.
This was what every part of his cells told him as Noah nodded, bringing his hands up as he saw the boundless strength within them that held shocking meaning.
When one truly thought about it, his Body alone through its many Physiques had base boosts above 2,850+ in True Reality Damage Values!
Again, one had to understand what this truly signified! A wave of Noah's hand or a pinch of his fingers...was now equivalent to the destruction of hundreds of Realities.
This was before any multiplicative effects through Authorities like Halos and True Forms as when those were included, his damage went towards the equivalent destruction of millions of Realities!
When Noah looked at all of this and the many more things to come, he could only repeat Lavalliere's words while nodding.
"I've prepared enough..."
WAA!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1786
paragraphs: Chapter 1786 A Mythical Natural Born Physique! IV
"I've prepared enough..."
WAA!
The moment Noah finished these words, the bursting essence being transferred over by Sanguine Adequation filled his soul entirely as it also could not go any further!
When this occurred....
HUUM!
His three Aspects of Existence trembled as the surging essence within them reached utter peak.
They were saturated.
They couldn't take anymore!
His Soul, Origin, and Body buzzed as they were ready to undergo resonance and utilize the method of the Infinite Runic Ecriture of Modus Operandi.

But they could do nothing as the will of the existence they made had no intention of doing this- and the spark or epiphany that all beings required to become LEGENDS would not arise when the existence in question did not seek it!
So they resonated with utter brilliance as the progress of all the Physiques that were trying to achieve completion but couldn't...stopped.
Golden liquid began to build up between the gaps of Noah's Cosmos once more as they attained 1 Trillion glimmering Royal Cosmos.
Above him, 49 glorious and massive stellar Infinite Reality Passages glowed and gushed down essence as when he looked at them, Noah's eyes tightened as this number didn't sit too well with him!

He had multiple Physiques waiting to be refined as they had begun their process at the same time, each one adding the capability to withstand tens of normal Passages as even though they were completed in their refinements, the initial boosts to Noah's body were still there!
And with the vibrant strength of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique he now carried, Noah felt like he could do it.
"Let's just push for one more..."
OOOM!

His will domineeringly surged out as he burnt 2 million Units of the Essence of Reality, calling for yet another Reality Passage to form as before it could, his body had to be sure it could handle it!

A brilliant stellar luster covered him from head to toe as Noah floated with ease as a pressure of a Passage built up, his visage remaining undaunted and unphased by just one additional pressure as...
THUCK!
In the skies, the 50th Infinite Reality Passage came to be.
"Hooo..."
Noah breathed out with satisfaction as he felt the boundless essence constantly washing over his body.
The fact he could generate 1 million Units of the Essence of Reality per second!
And this was after subtracting the tens of thousands that were being used up by the few skills with the Infinite Reality Passages undergoing REIFICATION.
He felt accomplished. He felt like he had truly achieved something somewhat significant as even with all this...there was still much more for him to accomplish.
"Like you...<Dimensional Dream Tamer>."
WAA!
His mesmerizing voice echoed out as he moved his vibrant stellar arms and legs while looking at the details of one of the new capabilities of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique.
It allowed him to put under his reign a 'few' unspecified number of existences from the Dream Dimension so long as he could put them under his feet!

At this moment, a grand idea was rising in Noah's mind as he didn't know at this moment in time of the existence that was Katelyn having already done something similar with an even more unique authority.

Katelyn had multiple Mirror Beast LEGENDS hidden under her wings as no beings knew of this- even Noah. Yet at this moment, the Unnamed Kainos Emperor began to think how glorious it would be if he- an existence at the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy...suddenly pulled out Dimensional Dream LEGENDS to fight for his behalf when he looked at the feature of <Dimensional Dream Tamer>!
"You, you, and you...go."

Noah pointed to three True Sanguine Clones as they disappeared into the cracks of the Dream Dimension that were healing, joining the other True Sanguine Clone in this Dimension as their goal...was to seek viable creatures Noah could subjugate or even defeat in the Dream Dimension.

He could even start by investigating the results of the battle between Ancestral Beowulf and the Emperor of the Golden Eye against the Nightmare and Dream LEGENDS...even though this carried a level of danger and he would have to be careful!
But at this moment, there were only a few things remaining for him to do as his body of Alexander headed towards the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.

<Enjoy the feeling of Nourishment from your Infinite Reality Passages. Allow your chosen skills to feel it too as they become REIFIED. Be familiar with your Infinite Reality Passages and utilization...and start on another Infinite Dream. There should be a birth of at least one or two Seeds of TABOO there.>
Lavalliere's voice echoed out in his mind as Noah smiled brightly.
The Third Infinite Dream.
He had released a hundred portions of his Soul for the first Infinite Dream as he released a thousand for the second one.

There were two particular Edicts that benefited from his Conquest and Apocalypse of Realities as they assimilated into his Infinite Reality, and then there was the elevation of the Infinite Reality itself as it would match its requirements after this Infinite Dream!
The possible Seeds of TABOO that could rise from this were abundant.
"The Atlatl of Reality should be equivalent to a TABOO Relic at that time, yes?"

Noah's smile only widened as he waved his hands to call a radiant stellar spear of Reality, thinking of the many possibilities after achieving complete refinement of his three Aspects of Existence as he now gazed for the future.

He expected many of the things he looked forward to occur as he entered or while inside the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, so his main body would remain in the Cosmic Holy Land as the scene of his astounding stellar visage adorned in a shimmering multicolored crown that was being paid homage to with the sandy gold Ecritures of <ETHEREAL EMPE> while 50 Infinite Reality Passages gushed down essence from above.... this scene was something that should be recorded in the annals of history as it showed the time that the Unnamed Kainos Emperor first began establishing his pristine Foundation!

A brilliant stellar luster covered him from head to toe as Noah floated with ease as a pressure of a Passage built up, his visage remaining undaunted and unphased by just one additional pressure as...
THUCK!
In the skies, the 50th Infinite Reality Passage came to be.
"Hooo..."
Noah breathed out with satisfaction as he felt the boundless essence constantly washing over his body.
The fact he could generate 1 million Units of the Essence of Reality per second!
And this was after subtracting the tens of thousands that were being used up by the few skills with the Infinite Reality Passages undergoing REIFICATION.
He felt accomplished.
He felt like he had truly achieved something somewhat significant as even with all this...there was still much more for him to accomplish.
"Like you...<Dimensional Dream Tamer>."
WAA!
His mesmerizing voice echoed out as he moved his vibrant stellar arms and legs while looking at the details of one of the new capabilities of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique.
It allowed him to put under his reign a 'few' unspecified number of existences from the Dream Dimension so long as he could put them under his feet!

At this moment, a grand idea was rising in Noah's mind as he didn't know at this moment in time of the existence that was Katelyn having already done something similar with an even more unique authority.
Katelyn had multiple Mirror Beast LEGENDS hidden under her wings as no beings knew of this- even Noah.

Yet at this moment, the Unnamed Kainos Emperor began to think how glorious it would be if he- an existence at the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy...suddenly pulled out Dimensional Dream LEGENDS to fight for his behalf when he looked at the feature of <Dimensional Dream Tamer>!
"You, you, and you...go."

Noah pointed to three True Sanguine Clones as they disappeared into the cracks of the Dream Dimension that were healing, joining the other True Sanguine Clone in this Dimension as their goal...was to seek viable creatures Noah could subjugate or even defeat in the Dream Dimension.

He could even start by investigating the results of the battle between Ancestral Beowulf and the Emperor of the Golden Eye against the Nightmare and Dream LEGENDS...even though this carried a level of danger and he would have to be careful!
But at this moment, there were only a few things remaining for him to do as his body of Alexander headed towards the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.
<Enjoy the feeling of Nourishment from your Infinite Reality Passages.
Allow your chosen skills to feel it too as they become REIFIED.
Be familiar with your Infinite Reality Passages and utilization...and start on another Infinite Dream.
There should be a birth of at least one or two Seeds of TABOO there.>
Lavalliere's voice echoed out in his mind as Noah smiled brightly.
The Third Infinite Dream.
He had released a hundred portions of his Soul for the first Infinite Dream as he released a thousand for the second one.

There were two particular Edicts that benefited from his Conquest and Apocalypse of Realities as they assimilated into his Infinite Reality, and then there was the elevation of the Infinite Reality itself as it would match its requirements after this Infinite Dream!
The possible Seeds of TABOO that could rise from this were abundant.
"The Atlatl of Reality should be equivalent to a TABOO Relic at that time, yes?"

Noah's smile only widened as he waved his hands to call a radiant stellar spear of Reality, thinking of the many possibilities after achieving complete refinement of his three Aspects of Existence as he now gazed for the future.

He expected many of the things he looked forward to occur as he entered or while inside the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, so his main body would remain in the Cosmic Holy Land as the scene of his astounding stellar visage adorned in a shimmering multicolored crown that was being paid homage to with the sandy gold Ecritures of <ETHEREAL EMPE> while 50 Infinite Reality Passages gushed down essence from above.... this scene was something that should be recorded in the annals of history as it showed the time that the Unnamed Kainos Emperor first began establishing his pristine Foundation!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1787
paragraphs: The Purple Endeavor streaked across space as in a few hours, it arrived in a far off region that could have spanned the distance across two Pure Blooded Domains- this time stopping in the Boundary Between Realities right before a unique domain!
A domain...that showed a hazy accumulation of cerulean blue wisps of light that surrounded a hut!
A hut that floated seamlessly in the middle of nowhere between many Realities as from it- an existence with a curvaceous figure and a head full of blue hair stepped out.

A deep smile could be seen on her face as a shimmering crown pulsed above her, the ecritures of <EMPER> spinning wondrously around it as behind this drop dead gorgeous existence was a long bow that froze the surrounding space behind it!
"Brightborn."
She nodded freely towards a LEGEND as she also took him as if he was a peer even though she still hadn't formed her Reality.

Brightborn didn't look too kindly at this as he merely gazed on coldly while communicating with her telepathically, this powerful existence also joining their party as she had a free air around her- even going as far as to gaze at all those here as she nodded before sitting down in a meditative position atop the deck of the TABOO Relic.
Her blue glacial bow sat with her as it froze the surrounding space, her aura maddening to see as the Adjudicator Legions looked over with care!

Yet another monster had joined them as their history and bloodline was unknown, the Purple Endeavor making such trips to gather two more powerful existences that each had solidified crowns with condensed ecritures as these would be the blades of Brightborn in the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.

Noah watched all of these events as he measured the beings entering the TABOO Vessel, none of them giving him warnings of danger so far as the only being he couldn't discern was enclosed off in the deck below them- Katelyn!
This made him curious of the many more geniuses from the other factions of Pure-Blooded Bloodlines- and even more so from the Main Reality.

His visage of Alexander currently showed off impeccable battle power in the Aspect of the Body- the Primordials around him identifying him with this strength as his identity now was considered an existence close to breaking the Limits of his Body!

With destiny weaving in its own mysterious ways and many cards falling into place, the Purple Endeavor that included 6 known Kainos Candidate Emperors and a hidden Unnamed Kainos Emperor began going towards the location of the doorway that would lead into the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.

No incidents occurred when the new entrants appeared as the journey from here on out was bound to be smooth- the only thing left to see being just what powerhouses would be in the vicinity of the doorway of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum!
Near the established borders of the Royal Human Domains, the Infinite Willow Tree Domains, and the Reality Ursidae Domains.
In the unique cluster that was actually within the region of Explorer Lands of the vast Realities- a new Domain Rift had ruptured and been discovered by Primordials!
This Domain Rift was one of the many forms that an entrance to a fairly powerful Domain Space could take- with some Grotto Sanctums having their doorways taking on such a form as this was similar.

The Domain Rift pulsed with stellar purple blue colors as it seemed like a vast Reality- and it was truly such a sizable doorway as Primordial LEGENDS affirmed they couldn't enter, and the test subject Primordials at the Ninth Firmament that were sent in returned with shock and terror as they reported back the space within to be filled with boundless destiny- but also with insurmountable dangers as their very Origins felt like they would be crushed if they moved a little bit forward!

It meant only truly powerful existences in the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy could enjoy the boons of this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum- and a few important personages of the Primordial Bloodlines paid attention to this to send their Geniuses over.

This was because any existence who gazed or knew about this Domain Rift leading to an Unexplored Grotto Sanctum who had even a semblance of destiny...would find an unshakable pull calling them towards this Grotto Sanctum as their very destinies and Fates knew that something astounding was waiting within.
If they could grasp it in their hands...they would advance greatly on their path to becoming the True Emperor!

This feeling...was shockingly universal across all beings that merely found out about this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum as it raised the brows of the few important personages of the Pure-Blooded Primordial Bloodlines paying attention to it.

Any single Grotto Sanctum held profound natural treasures that even LEGENDS fought for, and this new one to rise up that LEGENDS could not enter released a universal pull of destiny for all existences who knew about it.

Such a fact was enough to draw in truly astounding Chosen Emperors hidden among the Pure-Blooded Primordial Bloodlines along with Obsidian Adjudicator Commanders, regular Adjudicator Commanders, and Will Bearers!

The established belief currently about this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum that the 5 Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Bloodlines were sending some of their genius existences into was that it would hold a destiny so grand that the Emperor to obtain it all would more than likely take the lead to be a strong contender for the seat of the True Emperor...that is if they didn't perish when they finally came out of the Grotto Sanctum with all their gains.
Thus- one needed protection.
The LEGENDS of their Bloodlines were there for their protection as in exchange, many of those entering had agreements to share the boons that would stem from this location!
Of course, there were other important personages from the Main Reality who would be entering as even LEGENDS didn't dare to force them into agreements.
One such being...was known as the Young Emperor who stemmed from the Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Dragon Phoenix Bloodline.
He was just one of the few astounding Chosen Emperors that had already arrived on the Domain Rift leading into the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1788
paragraphs: "The pull of destiny is astoundingly greater here."

With a calm gaze and eyes shining with innumerable lights, the Young Emperor floated in front of a party of existences who released shocking auras exceeding the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy each one floating with their own solidified crown and varieties of authority as they were all Scions stemming from the Main Reality that were considered familiar with this being!

These beings were among the many that were arriving in front of the enormous purple blue stellar Domain Rift, this location currently being surrounded protectively on all sides by the auras of tens of LEGENDS and many stationed vessels.
There were even rivers of Reality from nearby dragged over and positioned defensively around this stellar Domain Rift as no uninvited existences would ever come close!

The party of beings behind the Young Emperor were just some of the many unique beings that had arrived here, other Vessels making their entrance in now as accomplished beings similar to them also stepped out and began talking to each other.

They all had airs of profound existences as they were adorned in a variety of colors of radiant robes ranging from gold to blue to black, each of their eyes releasing shocking confidence as if they were the protagonists of their own story.
"It seems what destiny is hidden here will make us all fight each other for it."
Another voice echoed out as it was from a devilishly handsome red haired Emperor from this same party.
"No hard feelings when the time comes, Aegon."
WAA!
Another distinguished Ninth Firmament Emperor whose eyes swirled with Quasars replied as his body released a violent outburst of domineering power that only the Dragon Phoenix Bloodline could attain!
"Haha, it is still unknown just which of us will be increasing their authority and which one might be returning home with their confidence crushed!"

These special beings spoke amongst each other jovially as many beings were paying attention to them silently- the Scions of the 5 Pure Blooded Bloodlines slowly arriving around the entrance to the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.

Far away from them on a small vessel that was actually a pink lotus flower that released a radiant aura of a natural TABOO Relic, two shockingly gorgeous women could be seen as one was adorned in a tight red dress with a head full of flaming hair, her body constantly shining with stellar light!

The other woman beside her had an apathetic expression as her body radiated danger and power- both of these beings having solidified crowns as on the Astral flaming girl in particular, the words <FLAME EMPE> were shining radiantly around her crown.

She seemed full of energy and life as her eyes captured everything around her, her melodious voice coming out so that only she and the woman beside her on the TABOO Vessel shaped like a pink lotus could hear.
"There's the man you grew up with, Helen. Young Emperor now is it? He has his own entourage of Emperors as all of them look like suave gentlemen! Ah...you think any of them are suitable for me?"
Her eyes released bursts of radiance as she spoke, her body packed full of power as this being had just decimated a LEGEND Ender not too long ago while under the observation of her parents!
Yet she spoke freely now as the girl beside her rolled her eyes.
"Why are you still acting childish, Juliette? You've already exceeded another Limit of your existence and you still act like this, tell me you aren't still chasing that ridiculous goal."

Helen- an important personage from the Dragon Phoenix Bloodline spoke out while shaking her head as the Astral Bloodline existence known as Juliette paid her no heed, her eyes wandering to the other beings around them as she spoke again.
"And look at that Reality Ursidae! That should be the second son of the Alpha Strata LEGEND that fought with the party of Alpha Strata ENDERS a few days ago...he's got some meat on him!"

She stroked her chin in appreciation as her devilishly gorgeous image was gradually getting destroyed by her words, her eyes jumping about as she continued to call out everyone she saw as if she knew them all!

"Ah, and there's the Child of the Trees- already being fostered to be one of the leading Emperors of the Infinite Willow Trees of this Age, the only shame being that he is the son of a Beta Strata LEGEND..."

Her pulsing eyes hand locked onto the visage of a shimmering Infinite Willow Tree that shone with stellar radiance, being surrounded by multiple others just like it in a region around this Domain Rift as Juliette released shocking information!
Information about Strata.
Primogenial, Beta, Alpha!

These latter two were the ones she had mentioned as it wasn't mentioned what came after. Primogenial meant earliest or first, while Beta meant the second of a series of concepts among other things! Then there was Alpha...which had the meaning of the first of a series of concepts, and also held the meaning of dominant and standing above others!
Primogenial was first. Beta came second. And then the definition of dominance of Alpha was utilized to have this be the third Strata of the stage of Reality!

For the Primogenial Strata, one's Soul condescend to become liquified as to proceed in the Beta Strata, one had to crystallize everything about themselves! As for the Alpha Strata...well, that was for another time.
"Ah! The guy who caused that incident a few million years ago is also here. Mmm... Adjudicator Jamason, is it? He only has a solidified crown though..."
"Oh, and the famous Will Bearer Trio of the Nine Seas also made it..."
One after another, the Astral Bloodline Juliette spoke freely as she seemed to hold vast reserves of knowledge about all the beings here.
Her face was sparkling with utter joy as she saw them all as Helen beside her only clutched her head in annoyance as if she couldn't believe a personage like her would act like this!
As for why she was excitedly gazing and looking at the powerful personages who would be entering the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum?
BZZT!
Her stellar eyes buzzed and changed as they shone with tyrannical might in the next instant.
"Hey, Helen."
WAA!

"With all these geniuses here...let's see if I can find myself a worthy hubby to stand beside me as I ascend the path to become a True Emperor. Because if any of them disappoint...I will rip their fuckings crowns of authority right off their heads."
A horrific light of power flashed within her excited eyes as she spoke out words of brutality!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1789
paragraphs: Near the borders where the domains of three Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Bloodlines met, a Domain Rift that led to an Unexplored Grotto Sanctum was gradually being surrounded by terrifyingly exceptional beings.
They divided the space around the Rift into 5 for all the Pure Blooded Bloodlines, with the auras of LEGENDS prevalent in each camp.

Hazy colors covered the temporary bases of these beings as in one direction, an enormous Willow Tree the Size of a Reality was rooted in space as around it, stellar green mist permeated as many other Infinite Willow Trees could be seen around it!

This enormous Infinite Willow Tree was not a LEGEND at the Primogenial Strata, wondrously standing at the Alpha Strata as the Pure-Blooded Bloodlines sent out 1 such being each for overseeing the events of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.
, m Beta Strata LEGENDS were covering any gaps with their auras around this whole area, and tens of Primogenial Strata LEGENDS accompanied them to make this place impenetrable!

It was enough to show the level of importance this Unexplored Domain Space held as apart from the enormous Infinite Willow Tree that was surprised by a hazy green light and could barely be seen, the area around it was filled with hundreds of Infinite Willow Trees that formed into clusters of Adjudicator Legions and Will Bearers.

In another direction, the visage of an enormous Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Human could be seen as he had ten pairs of resplendent golden wings behind his back- this figure also shrouded by a hazy stellar light as the truth muscles and form could barely be discerned! This was the Alpha Strata LEGEND from the Main Reality overseeing the ongoing of their bloodline here today, and this base of Royal Humans also had their own Adjudicator Legions and Will Bearers that continued to expand in number even now as more and more Primordials arrived.
The muscular Human forms were glorious as their eyes gave off glints of pride and unmatchable humanistic beauty!

Then came the side of the Reality Ursidae that similarly had an enormous Alpha Strata LEGEND- his figure being astounding to stare at as the very skin of this kingly Bear shone with a majestic Obsidian stellar light.
Black and starry like an endless void!
Legions of majestic looking Reality Ursidae whose bodies glimmered of Cosmos could be seen around this existence as our eyes turn towards the temporary base Domain of the Dragon Phoenix Bloodline.

This area shone with astounding incandescence as the regality of the Dragon Phoenix was shown- an Alpha LEGEND embodying this form also being covered by a hazy golden stellar light as one could only make out pairs of deadly wings that seemed to be as vast as Realities, a golden scaled tail that divided into nine endless rivers of Reality, and stellar crimson eyes that constantly shattered and reformed the surrounding space!

The body released an aura of utter imperial royalty as it was unmatched, seeming like a perfect amalgamation of a dragon and a Phoenix as just the nine Reality-tailed portion of the Body was mesmerizing enough.

The figure of the Young Emperor and his entourage were standing at the forefront of the Legions and Will Bearers belonging to the Dragon Phoenix Bloodline, Destiny permeating profusely around this area as our eyes turn towards the last Domain.

Holding much fewer Legions compared to others, the temporary domain of the Astral Bloodline around the entrance of this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum was much quieter than other areas- the breathless image of a massive humanoid figure that seemed to be made up of endless golden blue astral starry rivers could be distinctly seen.

Hidden like all the other Alpha Strata LEGENDS, this distinguished being of the Astral Bloodline was surrounded by the auras of a few Beta Strata and Primogenial Strata LEGENDS along with a few Adjudicator Legions and Will Bearers in the surroundings- their bloodline purposefully sending off fewer beings as to them, this place held importance...but not as much as the others!

And something terrific to gaze at was all five titanic Reality sized Alpha Strata LEGENDS overseeing everything...had glimmering multicolored crowns that each shone with the stellar words of <EMPEROR>.

These 5 beings...had somehow exceeded the normal bounds of their realms- an action that was much harder once one stepped out of the Firmaments of Ascendancy...and they had actually attacked up enough achievements to attain such wondrous authorities!
The Astral Bloodline Alpha Strata LEGEND was particularly radiant as when one measured the overpowering auras these 5 core individuals spread out...this stellar being had the most terrifying one.

The glimmering pink lotus flower TABOO Vessel that Juliette and Helen stood on was at the forefront of the base of the Astral Bloodline whose Legions seemed like clusters of beautiful incandescent stellar bodies, the valiant eyes of Juliette continuing to look at all the Destined Existences who were already here and those that were arriving.
Her Astral humanoid form buzzed as stellar flames constantly snaked over her skin, her eyes landing on another being that caused her to nod slightly from the base of the Dragon Phoenix Bloodline.
"Let's see...there's the rising Adjudicator Ezekiel and his side piece- Nefertiti, was it? When did she get a solidified crown?"
Her bright eyes which shone like luminous stars landed on the visage of a young man whose body released a calm sense of authority.

A multicolored crown was adorned on his head as one couldn't see any ecritures swirling around it- causing some beings to look down on him from afar as there were a decent number of Candidate Emperors from special Lineages who had at least formed a letter or two around their crowns!
He and Nefertiti floated in front of the Adjudicator Legion they led as they were among the few Primordials who were from different Bloodlines but mixing together- their Legion also being like this.

The eyes of Nefertiti were bright as she gazed at the direction of the Royal Human Domains every now and then, intent on seeing whether a certain someone actually came! Meanwhile, the visage of Ezekiel calmly observed everything as his dark eyes devoured the surrounding light itself.

"Mmm, he's the son of that terrifying woman that isn't looked upon too kindly by the upper echelons of the Dragon Phoenixes in the Main Reality...but his authority is really too far behind others like him. Say, Helen- you must have come across this brethren of yours frequently, how is he?"
"Well..." Helen's annoyed eyes rose as she turned her head while gazing at the far away figure of Adjudicator Ezekiel.

He had the same crimson and gold hair on his head as his eyes were like two spinning black holes that devoured everything, a sense of wildness ringing about him that others just couldn't put a finger on!
Helen shook her head the more she looked at him as she sighed.

"...he's boring. He doesn't fight for authority like all the others as even now, he has only attained the title of a Primordial Adjudicator as he won't even return to the Main Reality to become an Obsidian Adjudicator. Don't waste your time on him."

They divided the space around the Rift into 5 for all the Pure Blooded Bloodlines, with the auras of LEGENDS prevalent in each camp.

Hazy colors covered the temporary bases of these beings as in one direction, an enormous Willow Tree the Size of a Reality was rooted in space as around it, stellar green mist permeated as many other Infinite Willow Trees could be seen around it!

This enormous Infinite Willow Tree was not a LEGEND at the Primogenial Strata, wondrously standing at the Alpha Strata as the Pure-Blooded Bloodlines sent out 1 such being each for overseeing the events of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.
, m Beta Strata LEGENDS were covering any gaps with their auras around this whole area, and tens of Primogenial Strata LEGENDS accompanied them to make this place impenetrable!

It was enough to show the level of importance this Unexplored Domain Space held as apart from the enormous Infinite Willow Tree that was surprised by a hazy green light and could barely be seen, the area around it was filled with hundreds of Infinite Willow Trees that formed into clusters of Adjudicator Legions and Will Bearers.

In another direction, the visage of an enormous Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Human could be seen as he had ten pairs of resplendent golden wings behind his back- this figure also shrouded by a hazy stellar light as the truth muscles and form could barely be discerned!

This was the Alpha Strata LEGEND from the Main Reality overseeing the ongoing of their bloodline here today, and this base of Royal Humans also had their own Adjudicator Legions and Will Bearers that continued to expand in number even now as more and more Primordials arrived.
The muscular Human forms were glorious as their eyes gave off glints of pride and unmatchable humanistic beauty!

Then came the side of the Reality Ursidae that similarly had an enormous Alpha Strata LEGEND- his figure being astounding to stare at as the very skin of this kingly Bear shone with a majestic Obsidian stellar light.
Black and starry like an endless void!
Legions of majestic looking Reality Ursidae whose bodies glimmered of Cosmos could be seen around this existence as our eyes turn towards the temporary base Domain of the Dragon Phoenix Bloodline.

This area shone with astounding incandescence as the regality of the Dragon Phoenix was shown- an Alpha LEGEND embodying this form also being covered by a hazy golden stellar light as one could only make out pairs of deadly wings that seemed to be as vast as Realities, a golden scaled tail that divided into nine endless rivers of Reality, and stellar crimson eyes that constantly shattered and reformed the surrounding space!

The body released an aura of utter imperial royalty as it was unmatched, seeming like a perfect amalgamation of a dragon and a Phoenix as just the nine Reality-tailed portion of the Body was mesmerizing enough.

The figure of the Young Emperor and his entourage were standing at the forefront of the Legions and Will Bearers belonging to the Dragon Phoenix Bloodline, Destiny permeating profusely around this area as our eyes turn towards the last Domain.

Holding much fewer Legions compared to others, the temporary domain of the Astral Bloodline around the entrance of this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum was much quieter than other areas- the breathless image of a massive humanoid figure that seemed to be made up of endless golden blue astral starry rivers could be distinctly seen.

Hidden like all the other Alpha Strata LEGENDS, this distinguished being of the Astral Bloodline was surrounded by the auras of a few Beta Strata and Primogenial Strata LEGENDS along with a few Adjudicator Legions and Will Bearers in the surroundings- their bloodline purposefully sending off fewer beings as to them, this place held importance...but not as much as the others!

And something terrific to gaze at was all five titanic Reality sized Alpha Strata LEGENDS overseeing everything...had glimmering multicolored crowns that each shone with the stellar words of <EMPEROR>.

These 5 beings...had somehow exceeded the normal bounds of their realms- an action that was much harder once one stepped out of the Firmaments of Ascendancy...and they had actually attacked up enough achievements to attain such wondrous authorities!
The Astral Bloodline Alpha Strata LEGEND was particularly radiant as when one measured the overpowering auras these 5 core individuals spread out...this stellar being had the most terrifying one.

The glimmering pink lotus flower TABOO Vessel that Juliette and Helen stood on was at the forefront of the base of the Astral Bloodline whose Legions seemed like clusters of beautiful incandescent stellar bodies, the valiant eyes of Juliette continuing to look at all the Destined Existences who were already here and those that were arriving.
Her Astral humanoid form buzzed as stellar flames constantly snaked over her skin, her eyes landing on another being that caused her to nod slightly from the base of the Dragon Phoenix Bloodline.

Helen shook her head the more she looked at him as she sighed.
"...he's boring.

He doesn't fight for authority like all the others as even now, he has only attained the title of a Primordial Adjudicator as he won't even return to the Main Reality to become an Obsidian Adjudicator.
Don't waste your time on him."

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1790
paragraphs: Ezekiel was actually looked down upon as Helen seemed lost in her memories when she spoke of him!
"Mmm..." Juliette nodded after a while as her eyes moved onto the brown-skinned beauty that was Nefertiti.
"This one is actually interesting as she's the sister of that woman who actually turned down the invitation of a Potentate of her Bloodline from the Main Reality-...oh?"
Her words stopped as she turned towards the direction of the Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Human base at this moment.
From the gaps of the protection of LEGENDS, a purple gold ship gradually neared as it held swirling golden waves of destiny that most beings proficient in Destiny and Fate could see!
A cluster of such dense destiny was paid attention to by the monstrous beings here as another region that was like this was near the entourage of the Young Emperor.
A smile rose in Juliette's eyes as she saw this.
"Speak of the devil..."
All entering vessels that neared the Domain Rift had to pass the tight defenses of the LEGENDS overseeing everything, and at this moment- the vessel they was the Purple Endeavor appeared.
OOOM!
It was subtle.
But the atmosphere changed!

The fee Chosen Emperors and monstrous geniuses building their foundation couldn't help but gaze towards the Purple Endeavor and see just who was on it as their destinies vibrated and reacted in that direction!

Juliette's eyes sparkled with a stellar light as she watched this TABOO Vessel anchor, figures beginning to rise from it that were led by the small visage of a smiling Brightborn towards the cluster of Royal Humans.

4 Candidate Emperors whose bodies screamed of wildness that Brightborn had picked up, the regal visage of Genevieve whose aura stood above even her sibling Namur, and then behind them and floating soundlessly alone...the visage of a silver white haired beauty whose crown glimmered with the word <SACRALIZED>.
A word more robust than many more beings here as even the four Alpha Strata LEGENDs only had <EMPEROR> swirling around their crowns as they didn't have anything attached to this!
"Sacralized? Are you kidding me?"
Even Juliette was stumped at this as her figure bubbled with power, seemingly wanting to fly over in that direction even now!
"I mean a guy is good but..." She tapped her chin as a devilish smile appeared on her exceedingly beautiful face.
"...maybe I can also see if I can subjugate her to be a hubby under my heel."
WAA!

Dreadful words echoed from her as Helen shook her head again on the Lotus Flower TABOO Vessel, floating a few more emitters away from Juliette whose body was releasing a terrifying air at this moment!
"Eh?" Yet the eyes of this being briefly stopped as they locked on to another being coincidentally.
He wasn't moving with pride and mixing with etiquette among the others, with his gaze being sharp as his eyes seemed to be brightening up as he gazed at everything around him!

Over the vast Domains of the Pure-Blooded Bloodlines. Over geniuses and LEGENDS as the look in his eyes...didn't show any apprehension or wonder within them as Juliette could swear she could see something akin to hunger!
But she shook her head and got back to staring at Katelyn as which being would gaze upon the Scions of the Pure-Blooded Bloodlines like this when they themselves didn't even have a solidified crown?
Noah stepped off the Purple Endeavor as his eyes took in the vast wonders around him.
Dense auras of powerful LEGENDS and existences with astounding Destiny permeated throughout- Noah getting a chance to meet a section of the few exceptional individuals across these vast Realities!

His main body back in the Cosmic Holy Land had pulled out a glimmering golden book as he utilized the Dictum Emperor to try and peer into what could possibly happen with the tightly coiling destinies of all beings here- but it was very hard to get back any information as he prepared to let this go and begin focusing on the Third Infinite Dream that would grant him yet another edge in this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.

His Clones had entered the Dream Dimension as they sought to find Dream LEGENDS and Nightmares, while another one of his clones with RUINATION in the Mirror Dimension was finally making headway as the eyes of the Gazer had grasped onto what he might need across the hard to navigate spaces filled with endless Mirrors.

And now, this clone of Alexander had arrived at the pulsing Domain Rift of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum as Noah couldn't help but greedily gaze at all the existences here, trying to contain himself as best as he could as the authority of the Unnamed Kainos Emperor was crying out with fervor!
OOOM!

His three Aspects of Existence that were filled to the brim vibrated intensely as his destiny could actually feel a level of danger from a few spots around this reality sized Domain Rift, such a Reality not making him sullen as it actually made him more excited.

The Realities were vast, and he had still only been moving for just over a year. The true geniuses and anomalies that rose and lived for millions or billions of years...it would be disappointing and unrealistic if there weren't a few that were utterly exceptional in their Realm!
He could feel the auras of such beings here as even with the current level of power as a Triple Limit Breaker he had achieved...
'I might still have to break some sweat.'
WAA!

Work. It seemed Noah truly had to put on work this time around as his eyes were dazzled by the many TABOO Vessels stretching out across the 5 mini domains made by the Pure-Blooded Bloodlines, and he was dazzled more than anything by the massive figures of 5 LEGENDS that represented the Bloodlines here today releasing undeniable waves of power.

When Noah merely compared his current self to them...he felt like a mere palm from these beings would eradicate all Aspects of Existence of his Clone with the damage even extending towards his main body if he were to ever face them! Their power was currently too high as this may be the case now...
'But it won't be so in just a few months...or maybe even weeks!'

His will swept out silently and madly as he made this resolution, walking towards the forefront of the Legions of Royal Humans as Genevieve and Emperor Namur went to mix and mingle with the Royal Humans from the Main Reality. Adjudicator Katelyn remained behind with one of the Adjudicator Legions that normally followed her as those invited by Brightborn and many others in the surroundings began to spare glances at her- especially the crown spinning above her head that read SACRILIZED.
She seemed to stand above many beings even here as for now, Noah didn't make any moves to stand out or cause any eyes to land on him.
He waited for the entrance into the Grotto Sanctum to fully unfurl his wings and let loose.
He waited until he was locked in a room with a few of the geniuses of these vast Realities as there...the battle for supremacy would show who excelled among the rest!

Why could he feel a level of danger from a few beings that he could only gaze at and not spread his will over at this moment? How many Limit Breakers were there and what oddities of these vast Realities had they attained?!

Noah wanted the answers to all these questions as his gaze spread over the majestic Royal Humans, Reality Ursidae, Infinite Willow Trees, Dragon Phoenixes, and the shimmering Astral Bloodline that uniquely looked very close to his Samsara Dao Origin forms.

His gaze was just about to travel towards one of the areas where he felt a level of danger- an area where a certain entourage was calmly talking amongst each other while floating behind a Young Emperor when...
HOOONG!

A blaring horn sounded as a flash of golden light actually bloomed at the very center of the temporary domains set up by the 5 Pure-Blooded Bloodlines- a light so fast that many beings only saw it when the existence behind it formed instantly before their eyes!

Before the eyes of many LEGENDS and powerhouses, an existence actually appeared with a flash of golden light as one could shockingly see a pair of purple gold wings extending from her feet, an even more pair of radiant gold wings stretching from her back as she was adorned in a sleek battle armor.
From this existence...a maddeningly sonorous commanding voice echoed out for all to hear- without even an ounce of fear!
"Why are we still tarrying around here? Let us enter!"
WAA!

With an unblemished visage and valor, an existence with no sign of a crown on her head appeared as destiny began to weave madly in the surroundings, Noah's ears picking up a few voices of beings from the Main Reality who spoke with shock when gazing at the new entrant.
"Akaris!"

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1791
paragraphs: Akaris.
This was the name Noah heard as an existence with an exceedingly powerful aura in the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy appeared at the center of all base domains of the Pure-Blooded Bloodlines.
No crown could be seen above her head as this was an unbelievable thing when looking at the visage of this being who seemed unhindered by all existences here!

Golden purple wings adorned the sides of her feet as she seemed elevated apart from many others, the radiant golden wings behind her pulsing with stellar light as she didn't even wait for a reply before gazing towards the 5 camps where the auras of powerful LEGENDS reigned.
"Those destined to be here are already here. Let the rules of engagement of this Unexplored space be known."
WAA!

She spoke in such a manner while gazing towards the Alpha Strata LEGENDS of each of the Bloodlines, and she wasn't admonished or suffocated by their pressure in any way as she seemed to hold an astounding identity!
Noah's eyes took in her visage as his destiny didn't approach this being- already feeling a sense of danger as it seemed the anomalies of the vast Realities were boundless.
As for there being no crown above her head?
She seemed to obviously be among the rare few who could hide their authority as she did it so blatantly!
<Huh...that's an interesting existence. It seems this Nexus Event won't be all that easy for you.>

Cryptic words rang out within Noah's mind from Lavalliere as majestic golden waves of destiny began to permeate throughout as the stellar crimson eyes of the Dragon Phoenix Alpha Strata LEGEND shone, a deep and ancient voice emanating from it.

"This Domain holds within it a profound sense of destiny that has only appeared a few times before in the past eons. Across the Ages, any beings lucky enough to encounter such a domain and hold the vast resources within it excelled in their Era."
OOOM!

The voice was deep as it permeated in the minds of all Adjudicator Legions, Obsidian Adjudicator Legions, Will Bearers, and even the existences that didn't have close ties with the Pure-Blooded Bloodlines as the members of Cardinal Royal Bloodlines like the Royal Cosmic Wolves and the Spirit Race could be seen mixed among the Legions or among the Royalty!

"Destiny will go to those who fight for it...so those entering this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum have to understand that battles within will be common, and deaths might occur between the Bloodlines if different parties seek to obtain an astounding destiny and fortune!"
The eyes of the Dragon Phoenix LEGENDS blazed like burning Galaxies as its voice continued to echo out, Noah's own eyes flashing as he listened closely.

"Any deaths and conflicts that occur within this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum will begin and end there as all those entering will hold their own destinies and lives in their hands. You will not be persecuted when you leave this Sanctum for what happened within as those with the strongest destinies will prevail!"
HUUM!
The eyes of many geniuses and Candidate Emperors shone as others even had their eyes raised in alarm!
They didn't know these would be the rules of engagement for the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.
Some of them thought with their identities, they would be protected if they ever ran into any dangers or fought against others- but the words of this LEGEND now caused a few to hesitate!
The other Alpha Strata LEGENDS of the four other Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Bloodlines remained silent as if this was something the upper echelons had agreed upon.
The air around the surroundings changed.
Yet the expressions of the truly powerful beings who were confident in themselves remained the same as Noah...
HUUUM!
His Origin was buzzing with excitement as a glorious possible Fates began to arise before his eyes!
From the Dragon Phoenix Alpha Strata LEGEND, the booming voice continued even after the bombshell it just dropped.
"Enter."
That fast and abrupt.

So abrupt that others couldn't even react as the visage of the woman known as Akaris flashed, turning into a streak of golden light as she instantly went towards the glimmering purple blue stellar Domain Rift that was the entrance of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum!

After Akaris, the Chosen Emperors standing at the forefront of the Adjudicator Legions also moved in sequence as they related quickly, turning into lights that surged towards the entrance of the Grotto Sanctum as the Legions behind them soon began to follow.
There were boundless destinies and wonders waiting for them in this place- they couldn't be left behind and let others obtain it before them!

From the side of the Royal Humans, esteemed Obsidian Adjudicators and Royalty from the Main Reality surged into the Grotto Sanctum first as the visage of Genevieve and others followed, Noah still remaining in the ranks of those from the Pure-Blooded Domains of the Royal Humans as the calm figure of Katelyn wasn't too far away from him.
THUMP!
He could feel the beat of his heart as he remained hidden and waited for the opportunities that would bloom in the unknown lands!

He waited to enter the domain space where he would be making his breakthrough into the stage of Reality as it was bound to be a platform for him to shoot off and also establish himself among the Primordials.
Up front, Genevieve's will came to focus on him as she actually sent a mental message to him after all this time.
"Good luck, Alexander King."
WAA!
She wished him luck as the both of them understood what the other person wanted to do.
Noah's face adopted a devilish smile as he replied vibrantly.
"You as well, Empress."
The two existences- one from the Olden Era and one from the Kainos Era went towards the enlarging Domain Rift before their eyes as soon enough, they disappeared into it like many others!
Two entered...but only a single one of them would be coming out alive, and both Noah and Genevieve knew this!

Like fireflies entering a massive flame- they and many Legions of Primordials from the 5 Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Bloodlines and those from Cardinal Royal Bloodlines lucky enough to gain a chance to enter...all surged towards the Domain Rift portal.

Glorious stellar Infinite Willow Trees. Majestic kingly Reality Ursidae, humanoid and full-formed incandescent Dragon Phoenixes who emanated pristine power and beauty. Royal Humans and Astral beings that shone with a light of Reality...every single one surged into the vast Domain Rift!

Across the Ages, any beings lucky enough to encounter such a domain and hold the vast resources within it excelled in their Era."
OOOM!

The voice was deep as it permeated in the minds of all Adjudicator Legions, Obsidian Adjudicator Legions, Will Bearers, and even the existences that didn't have close ties with the Pure-Blooded Bloodlines as the members of Cardinal Royal Bloodlines like the Royal Cosmic Wolves and the Spirit Race could be seen mixed among the Legions or among the Royalty!

"Destiny will go to those who fight for it...so those entering this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum have to understand that battles within will be common, and deaths might occur between the Bloodlines if different parties seek to obtain an astounding destiny and fortune!"
The eyes of the Dragon Phoenix LEGENDS blazed like burning Galaxies as its voice continued to echo out, Noah's own eyes flashing as he listened closely.
"Any deaths and conflicts that occur within this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum will begin and end there as all those entering will hold their own destinies and lives in their hands.
You will not be persecuted when you leave this Sanctum for what happened within as those with the strongest destinies will prevail!"
HUUM!
The eyes of many geniuses and Candidate Emperors shone as others even had their eyes raised in alarm!
They didn't know these would be the rules of engagement for the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.
Some of them thought with their identities, they would be protected if they ever ran into any dangers or fought against others- but the words of this LEGEND now caused a few to hesitate!
The other Alpha Strata LEGENDS of the four other Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Bloodlines remained silent as if this was something the upper echelons had agreed upon.
The air around the surroundings changed.
Yet the expressions of the truly powerful beings who were confident in themselves remained the same as Noah...
HUUUM!
His Origin was buzzing with excitement as a glorious possible Fates began to arise before his eyes!
From the Dragon Phoenix Alpha Strata LEGEND, the booming voice continued even after the bombshell it just dropped.
"Enter."
That fast and abrupt.

So abrupt that others couldn't even react as the visage of the woman known as Akaris flashed, turning into a streak of golden light as she instantly went towards the glimmering purple blue stellar Domain Rift that was the entrance of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum!

After Akaris, the Chosen Emperors standing at the forefront of the Adjudicator Legions also moved in sequence as they related quickly, turning into lights that surged towards the entrance of the Grotto Sanctum as the Legions behind them soon began to follow.
There were boundless destinies and wonders waiting for them in this place- they couldn't be left behind and let others obtain it before them!

From the side of the Royal Humans, esteemed Obsidian Adjudicators and Royalty from the Main Reality surged into the Grotto Sanctum first as the visage of Genevieve and others followed, Noah still remaining in the ranks of those from the Pure-Blooded Domains of the Royal Humans as the calm figure of Katelyn wasn't too far away from him.
THUMP!
He could feel the beat of his heart as he remained hidden and waited for the opportunities that would bloom in the unknown lands!

He waited to enter the domain space where he would be making his breakthrough into the stage of Reality as it was bound to be a platform for him to shoot off and also establish himself among the Primordials.
Up front, Genevieve's will came to focus on him as she actually sent a mental message to him after all this time.
"Good luck, Alexander King."
WAA!
She wished him luck as the both of them understood what the other person wanted to do.
Noah's face adopted a devilish smile as he replied vibrantly.
"You as well, Empress."
The two existences- one from the Olden Era and one from the Kainos Era went towards the enlarging Domain Rift before their eyes as soon enough, they disappeared into it like many others!
Two entered...but only a single one of them would be coming out alive, and both Noah and Genevieve knew this!

Like fireflies entering a massive flame- they and many Legions of Primordials from the 5 Pure-Blooded Cardinal Royal Bloodlines and those from Cardinal Royal Bloodlines lucky enough to gain a chance to enter...all surged towards the Domain Rift portal.
Glorious stellar Infinite Willow Trees.
Majestic kingly Reality Ursidae, humanoid and full-formed incandescent Dragon Phoenixes who emanated pristine power and beauty.
Royal Humans and Astral beings that shone with a light of Reality...every single one surged into the vast Domain Rift!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1792
paragraphs: Within minutes, no aura of existences in the Firmaments of Ascendancy could be felt in the surroundings as only the aura of LEGENDS were left behind.
Beings like Brightborn who had sent in powerful monsters and geniuses to collect treasures for them smiled as they waited!

Meanwhile, the auras of the 5 Alpha Strata LEGENDS shone brightly as they focused on the pulsing Domain Rift- reading as much destiny and Fate as they could from this unknown land as even they...had no idea what would be occurring within it.
Deaths and conflicts within the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum would remain in the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum as nobody would be persecuted once they were out.
This rule of engagement...was something to be remembered as it weighed heavily on the minds of many!
A profound spatial storm unlike anything he had felt before.

Different from entering any Realm or Reality and different from anything else Noah had experienced- this was what it felt when he entered the massive Domain Rift leading into the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum!

The very surroundings also twisted and changed as Noah felt a shockingly oppressive and restrictive force wrap around him, his luminous eyes lighting the way forward as he gradually felt the path clearing up.
BZZT!
A surge of silver and gold flashed as after a few moments in the spatial tunnel, he appeared within the Grotto Sanctum.

The first thing he ascertained was how the oppressive and restrictive force..became all the more powerful as while his body appeared in what seemed like the skies- a downward force was pushing down on him that wanted to force him to the ground!
His elevated body with pristine Foundations flashed with fervor, but even this wasn't enough to stop the terrifying gravitational force surging around Noah as it seemed undeniable.
Only when...
WAA!
The aura of TABOO erupted around Noah.
He stabilized in the skies and no longer fell as he gazed around him, this bringing about the second point that was entirely different about this Grotto Sanctum!
He...could not spread his will out for more than 5 meters around his body as he had to gaze at everything with his own eyes!
And the scene before his eyes...
"Holy..."

The figures of Empress Genevieve, Royal Human Adjudicator Legions, and Katelyn were nowhere to be seen as their entrance into the Grotto Sanctum seemed to have teleported everyone to random locations.

Noah had appeared in the skies as around him, liquified rivers of essence flowed pristinely along with sparkling red and blue crystals that dotted the skies and swirled with a mystifying brilliance- being even denser than his Infinite Reality!

The earth below him had vibrant red sand and two enormous mountainous valleys that stretched in the distance, a stellar river of Reality flowing pristinely down the valleys of the two mountains as multicolored trees stretched up to the skies holding swirling crystals and liquified essence.

Noah could feel shockingly dense reserves of all types of essence here, even wisps of the Essence of Reality being seen floating between the multicolored vegetation that littered the paradisiacal mountains as this wasn't the most shocking thing!

After being restricted to where he could only see with his sight and not his will, Noah's gaze turned around the skies to see the spatial warping of the Primordials from the 5 Pure-Blooded Bloodlines as he witnessed a shocking scene.
A Royal Human appeared in the skies as like him, the faced a terrifying gravitational force downwards as his body lit up magnificently.
But...
"What?!"
He was still pressed down as his figure smashed onto the red earth below, breaking the tout branches of the tall trees on his way down as this Ninth Firmament existence was cast down to earth!

He wasn't the only one as Noah's eyes captured many more beings already oppressively pressed down onto the ground and unable to fly up, the visage of a Dragon Phoenix with glimmering pairs of wings that surged with purple flames roaring out in the ground as even after flapping its wings, it couldn't rise.
ROAAR!
pA Reality Ursidae roared out in disbelief as it jumped across the dense vegetation, but it was always pressed back down as it also couldn't take flight!

A stellar Willow Tree took root on the ref earth and resonated with it after it was also cast down- a majority of the beings that entered this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum actually being cast down from the skies and not being able to fly as the restrictive force was too domineering.
As Noah felt it press around his body, he could tell what it was right away as it felt much more pronounced here.
"The Natural Laws of Reality..."
WAA!

There was a type of Natural Law- or multiple of them, that were so present in this domain that others could not deny them! The only thing that could possibly do it and was what kept Noah in the skies at this moment...was the aura of TABOO!

Noah wasn't the only one as within the few mile region that his eyes could see, the figures of other distinguished beings in the skies could be seen floating majestically as they were all at least adorned with Solidified Crowns- each one having attained a TABOO Edict as they were geniuses upon geniuses!

The one with the strongest aura nearby was a Dragon Phoenix whose scales glimmered purple and gold, its wings feathered and glorious with the same colors as it held the majestic beauty of dragons and phoenixes beautifully. Three flaming tails stretched out behind it as they shone with ecstatic beauty and danger, Purple gold flames constantly surging over its scales as it carried a unique sense of power and beauty.

Around it, some geniuses from the other Bloodlines seemed to know of this Dragon Phoenix as they already congregated together, the forms of three Reality Ursidae, 4 Royal Humans, and two Infinite Willow Trees also being seen nearby!
A crown with the letters <EM> swirled above the Dragon Phoenix as its eyes and the eyes of many of the geniuses in the skies were currently locked towards Noah's direction.

Noah, who was currently wearing sleek bbsidian pants and a loose shirt to match it that wrapped around his robust muscles, the one wing behind his back released a pulsing golden light every now and then as above his head, one still couldn't see a crown!
This...was why the genius beings in the skies were gazing towards him.

All those who could remain in the vibrant skies were those who had achieved TABOO...so these geniuses very quickly grasped that this being must be hiding his authority or had unique means to be able to remain in the skies!
BZZT!
The wings of the Dragon Phoenix flapped as he turned into a flaming meteor to near Noah's location.
The eyes of this regal existence gazed at Noah's laid back demeanor as it spoke vibrantly.

"You must have a decent destiny for you to have attained a treasure capable of hiding your authority. You should be over and above a few others in here...so how about you follow me in this Grotto Sanctum?"
WAA!
