paragraphs: In the floating landmass surrounded by glacial waves of deathly sea water.

Enormous multicolored crystalline stellites with rounded bottoms and pointed crystalline edges that rose like rivers of Reality were grasped into Noah's hands, information about them entering his mind as these were the true and genuine Grotto Nacres!
False Grotto Nacres that Noah could attain as loot could only strengthen two Aspects of Existence. But the genuine Grotto Nacres were much different.

<Grotto Nacre>:: An amalgamation of Reality altering essence that is naturally formed from the densest Domains of Grotto Sanctums over time. It can refine all of one's Aspects of Existence beginning at the Primogenial stage at the same time while granting a slight increase to the Affinity to the Natural Laws of Reality, and also a strengthening effect to one's Reality Passages.
Stupendous treasures that LEGENDS sought as they cultivated everything of their Strata simultaneously while increasing their Affinity to the Natural Laws of Reality.
Even more, they could achieve a strengthening effect on their Reality Passages as this was something sought after by the masses of geniuses!

This was different for Noah as his Infinite Reality Passages were already massive and unique, and they were also about to undergo a change as the Third Infinite Dream finished and the Infinite Reality completed its change to a Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.

Noah was lost in his own thoughts as he wondered about the identity of those leaving behind the <WELCOME> while playing with the Grotto Nacre with his will, but an explosive storm of Essence erupted before him as Andur and the others released their foundations to achieve Reality!

The Infinite Willow Tree and Reality Ursidae got ready to attack Noah while Andur...he actually reigned in his aura as the majestic form of a Dragon Phoenix with layers of flaming tails caused the swathes of the freezing glaciers in the surrounding seas to melt.

He gazed towards Noah with calmness and solemnity as this genius with multiple Runic ecritures was also proficient in Destiny, and he saw that even after becoming a LEGEND...the darkness around his destiny didn't change as he had truly kicked a dangerous snake this time around!
Even after forming a Reality, this being that had actually possessed him already didn't even seem approachable in terms of power.

So he didn't attack while the other two that had just formed their Realities moved against the vibrant form of the golden Destiny Stone, his voice actually resonating out to say words it never thought it would say in its lifetime.
"Spare me."
HUUUM!
The other two geniuses who were moving with restored pride and fervor trembled in shock at hearing such words from the strongest of them- especially a prideful existence from a distinguished Lineage!
"Andur, what are you doing?! We have achieved Reality while he is just at the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy still! He can't withstand attacks from three LEGENDS all at once!"
The words of the Reality Ursidae echoed out as his solidified crown shone with majesty, but Andur still contained his power as he still didn't make a move.

The more he stared at the vast Destiny Stone before them that twirled with Grotto Nacres as if they were nothing, the more his destiny told him how abysmal things were as for the sake of survival, he forcefully destroyed his pride and...
The majestic form of the Dragon Phoenix actually bowed its head.
HUUM!
"Please. Spare my life."
A scene that the Infinite Willow Tree and Reality Ursidae couldn't fathom occurred as a being with a solidified crown and multiple ecritures actually bowed himself to another.
Why didn't he even try when it was the three of them against a single being?!
The majesty of the Reality Ursidae rose crazily as his illusory Reality shone with his bellow.
"Why the fu-"
BZZZT!
A deadly ray of stellar multicolored light filled with the oppressive might of a Dimension shot out as it smashed into the Reality Ursidae before chaining onto the Infinite Willow Tree as well.

The souls and wills of these existences trembled as when they gazed at their bodies, they found their Innate Primogenial Defense Barriers that should have exceeded 5 Million in Defense Values utterly shredded as their bodies were breaking apart to follow them soon after.
'So...that was why he bowed his head...'
This was the last thought in the mind of the unwilling Reality Ursidae as his will faded!

Amidst this shocking progression of events, Andur kept his head down as he ignored every will of pride and arrogance ingrained from the Main Reality- bowing even further down until the glittering scales on his chest touched the cold seafloor.
His millions of years of Existence were telling him to fight!
His very Aspects of Existence and authority as a Kainos Emperor Candidate were trembling as they couldn't accept an Emperor bowing his head, the ecritures surrounding his crown trembling!
Yet his head did not rise up as he could see that his destiny did not turn entirely dark.
"Hmm."
He heard the mesmerizing voice of the being without a crown above his head as he could sense the life forces of two newly Risen LEGENDS were no more!
"I was going to kill you."

Such dreadful words echoed out as the vibrant Destiny Stone shone with light and faded, the radiant devilish handsome existence adorned in Obsidian loose pants and shirt appearing as a single golden wing flapped behind him.

His visage was mesmerizing and would be the downfall of many women as he floated towards the bowing Dragon Phoenix, his dark hair glowing in the cold seas as he appeared right in front of the majestic draconic head that had purple gold rising horns swirling with the Essence of Reality!
Andur stayed silent while bowing as he felt like a crucial moment had come that would decide everything.
The being in front of him had unfused with his Ascendancy Halos as if Andur made a move now, he might just be able to take him by surprise!
But before this thought rose, Andur saw his destiny entirely turn black as an instant later his body flashed, his Ascendancy Halos parting away from his body.
The Illusory Reality Passages above him faded as he took away all his forms of protection, an action that went against every cell in his body as he spoke once more!
"Please."
It was an unfathomable action, but Noah nodded towards this astounding Candidate Emperor of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage of the Main Reality as he spoke out simply!
"Offer your Blood."

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1823
paragraphs: A devilishly handsome figure of Noah's clone floated above a bowing majestic Dragon Phoenix as the scene would shock any knowledgeable geniuses from the Main Reality!

Noah's eyes shone with tyranny as he spoke, the claws of Andur rising silently as they tore open the chest of this magnificent Dragon Phoenix and caused radiant stellar crimson gold True Blood to flow out without so much as a delay.
Hematopoietic Progenitor was activated as all this blood surged into Noah's body, a prompt appearing soon after.
<The Racial Bloodline of the Dragon Phoenix has been attained.>
Noah's body shone with incandescent radiance as he nodded, his next words being even more domineering!
"Offer your Fealty."
The heart of a genius Emperor from the Main Reality trembled as never in a million years would he have foreseen doing this in order to keep his life after entering the Grotto Sanctum!
The Essence of the Tyrannical Emperor roared out and wrapped around this majestic Dragon as the identity of this being appeared within Andur's mind.

His darkened destiny was gradually brightening up as this Scion of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage sighed in his heart, knowing this action would forever cut him off at the possibility of the seat of the True Emperor as while suppressing his pride with every part of his will, he bound himself!
"I pledge Fealty..."
The solidified crown above Andur shone and flashed as the ecritures above it shockingly began to crumble!
"...to the Tyrannical Emperor."
CRACK!

The ecritures floating above his solidified crown fractured in a shocking manner as his heart felt like it was being pierced by millions of stellar needles, Andur binding himself to another being as at the same time...he was shocked to find that began to feel a sense of...
'Freedom?'

The heart of this genius resigned itself as compared to the other beings that had perished in Noah's hands, he could be considered smart to do what he did as at this moment, it allowed his life to be saved.
But this wasn't all.

A change was happening with his authority as just when he felt like even his solidified crown would shatter, immense authority washed down from the being he had pledged Fealty to as golden incandescence began to suffuse over his crown!
From the shattered remains of ecritures, new ones actually began to form as with disbelief, Andur's will watched as the letters <VAS> formed above his crown with splendor.
This wasn't all as soon after, the effects of Oath to Emperor kicked in as Andur shockingly felt his Primogenial Soul...begin to rise up powerfully in strength!

The Primogenial Soul of a being at the stage of Reality....was being strengthened by an existence that had yet to form his Reality as Andur finally understood just why this unfathomable being could erase genius LEGENDS with relative ease.
His bowed head raised for the first time in a while to gaze upon the one he had pledged Fealty to as his eyes nearly dimmed.
Above the devilishly handsome visage of this Tyrant, Andur could see a gloriously multicolored solidified crown that had the shocking ecritures of <ETHEREAL DIME EMPEROR>!

Ecritures that caused the mind of this being to buzz- and they were the ecritures that had come by through Noah's very hard effort of wiping out the few LEGENDS with Solidified Crowns in the past few minutes.

He used to have <ETHEREAL D EMPEROR> after he became bound to Dimensional Essence and set himself on an unshakable path, a path that showed his crown was bound to have Ethereal Dimensional Emperor at its helm as his authority shone with boundless glory.
Seeing the shocking visage of this being and the shockingly surging strength of his Primogenial Soul, Andur let go of everything as he called out with difficulty!
, m "...S-Sire."
A term that his parents would be shocked to hear him say that the Elders of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage would find it treasonous and preposterous!

Yet he couldn't help but say it as this existence let go of his qualifications to be a True Emperor and learned that the term genius truly shouldn't be applied to many of the existences within this Grotto Sanctum.
"Mmm."

Noah gave a light smile to the Dragon Phoenix as he patted its head, his figure going forward to stand between the golden purple horns of the draconic head of this genius as he gazed at the new mount he had gotten.
Yes.

A Scion of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage could only serve to be his mount as he appreciated the Dragon Phoenix whose scales glimmered purple and gold, its wings feathered and glorious stretching from its back with the same vibrant colors as flames even blazed around them.
Three flaming tails stretched out behind it as they released powerful waves of heat that even melted the surrounding coldness!
A LEGEND Dragon Phoenix that had just forged its Primogenial Strata...would serve as his mount!

Noah's feet stable stood above the draconic head of this majestic creature as he looked around the barren land he had taken the treasures of and destroyed the Abyssal Undead Beasts, multiple chains rising from this landmass that went upwards endlessly as the sea further ahead was solidifying into pure glacial ice- making ascension upwards a near impossibility for many.

The gains of this floating landmass were many as even more recently, Noah attained two more glimmering Purple Tier Randomized Loot Crates that stemmed from the killed Infinite Willow Tree and Reality Ursidae that he put away to open later.

When he gazed at the snaking Chains of Reality leading to an unknown location, Noah wanted to begin heading upwards right away...but his destiny was telling him that for even more glory, there was another direction he needed to head to.
"Dictum Emperor needs to be TABOO soon to make things even clearer..."
He spoke out simply as the Dragon Phoenix below him trembled while speaking out.
"Where shall we go, Sire?"

It sought for direction as this genius entirely erased its pride when it continued to feel its Primogenial Soul still strengthening until it couldn't anymore because it had vastly exceeded his Body and Origin!

Whatever repercussions his Fealty would have towards his Lineage and the larger picture didn't matter now as Andur's Will began to undergo reformation to understand this new being he had bound himself to.

Noah turned away from the Chains of Reality snaking upwards endlessly as he turned right and left, seeing a Chain of Reality in each direction that led to other floating landmasses in this region as he waved his hands to pull out a golden book that shone with Destiny.

Lines began to appear on it as Noah adopted a thoughtful look before keeping his head to the left side, going forward and sitting in front of the horn on the right side of the head of the Dragon Phoenix below him as he treated this area like it was his throne- his hand patting the scales of this Vassal as dense Dream Essence and the Essence of Reality surged from him to wrap around its whole body!
"Let's go."

Noah chose the direction as his Dragon Phoenix flapped its flaming wings, its four golden purple scaled limbs cracking apart the frozen lands below it as it shot to the left of the barren island filled with coldness, the speed being no less than Noah's own as Andur was feeling great shock while being bolstered by vibrant Dream Essence!

Its golden purple claws stepped on the Chains of Reality as it shone with dazzling light, the restrictions loosening slightly as a new mount and its Master began moving across it towards an unknown location.
It was a scene that anyone coming across would question as they might not even trust their own vision!

He used to have <ETHEREAL D EMPEROR> after he became bound to Dimensional Essence and set himself on an unshakable path, a path that showed his crown was bound to have Ethereal Dimensional Emperor at its helm as his authority shone with boundless glory.
Seeing the shocking visage of this being and the shockingly surging strength of his Primogenial Soul, Andur let go of everything as he called out with difficulty!
, m "...S-Sire."
A term that his parents would be shocked to hear him say that the Elders of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage would find it treasonous and preposterous!

Yet he couldn't help but say it as this existence let go of his qualifications to be a True Emperor and learned that the term genius truly shouldn't be applied to many of the existences within this Grotto Sanctum.
"Mmm."

Noah gave a light smile to the Dragon Phoenix as he patted its head, his figure going forward to stand between the golden purple horns of the draconic head of this genius as he gazed at the new mount he had gotten.
Yes.

A Scion of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage could only serve to be his mount as he appreciated the Dragon Phoenix whose scales glimmered purple and gold, its wings feathered and glorious stretching from its back with the same vibrant colors as flames even blazed around them.
Three flaming tails stretched out behind it as they released powerful waves of heat that even melted the surrounding coldness!
A LEGEND Dragon Phoenix that had just forged its Primogenial Strata...would serve as his mount!

Noah's feet stable stood above the draconic head of this majestic creature as he looked around the barren land he had taken the treasures of and destroyed the Abyssal Undead Beasts, multiple chains rising from this landmass that went upwards endlessly as the sea further ahead was solidifying into pure glacial ice- making ascension upwards a near impossibility for many.

The gains of this floating landmass were many as even more recently, Noah attained two more glimmering Purple Tier Randomized Loot Crates that stemmed from the killed Infinite Willow Tree and Reality Ursidae that he put away to open later.

When he gazed at the snaking Chains of Reality leading to an unknown location, Noah wanted to begin heading upwards right away...but his destiny was telling him that for even more glory, there was another direction he needed to head to.
"Dictum Emperor needs to be TABOO soon to make things even clearer..."
He spoke out simply as the Dragon Phoenix below him trembled while speaking out.
"Where shall we go, Sire?"

It sought for direction as this genius entirely erased its pride when it continued to feel its Primogenial Soul still strengthening until it couldn't anymore because it had vastly exceeded his Body and Origin!

Whatever repercussions his Fealty would have towards his Lineage and the larger picture didn't matter now as Andur's Will began to undergo reformation to understand this new being he had bound himself to.

Noah turned away from the Chains of Reality snaking upwards endlessly as he turned right and left, seeing a Chain of Reality in each direction that led to other floating landmasses in this region as he waved his hands to pull out a golden book that shone with Destiny.

Lines began to appear on it as Noah adopted a thoughtful look before keeping his head to the left side, going forward and sitting in front of the horn on the right side of the head of the Dragon Phoenix below him as he treated this area like it was his throne- his hand patting the scales of this Vassal as dense Dream Essence and the Essence of Reality surged from him to wrap around its whole body!
"Let's go."

Noah chose the direction as his Dragon Phoenix flapped its flaming wings, its four golden purple scaled limbs cracking apart the frozen lands below it as it shot to the left of the barren island filled with coldness, the speed being no less than Noah's own as Andur was feeling great shock while being bolstered by vibrant Dream Essence!

Its golden purple claws stepped on the Chains of Reality as it shone with dazzling light, the restrictions loosening slightly as a new mount and its Master began moving across it towards an unknown location.
It was a scene that anyone coming across would question as they might not even trust their own vision!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1824
paragraphs: In a different region of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.

The fantastical scene of a mesmerizing young woman adorned in a silver dress could be seen, one of her fair hands gripping tightly onto the cylindrical end of a weapon that only became larger and larger towards the opposite end that was the form of a crystalline silver mirror like hammer!
This being was adorned with a crown that had the words <SACRALIZED EM> on it, grasping the massive hammer that was many times her size as it even seemed unnatural.

It caused the surrounding space to buzz as even though the cold seas were extremely stable with the space of this Grotto Sanctum being made extremely stable, it still crackled and buzzed as she swung this hammer effortlessly downwards- bringing with it terrifying swirls of Dimensional Essence!

The poor target of this strike was a badly malformed Abyssal Undead Anaconda who seemed to have already formed its Reality, its body covering nearly a fourth of the barren and cold landmass as much of its bones were currently broken or turned to dust.
BANG!

The hammer thundered on this Abyssal Undead Anaconda once more as its serpentine draconic head began to cave in, this Undead at the level of a LEGEND screaming out unfairness as it felt its very Dimensional Bloodline be oppressed by this young woman before it.
BANG!
As she swung the Mirror Hammer effortlessly with her gaze calm, the blue flames on the sockets of the Abyssal Undead Beast turned dim with unwillingness as its Origin broke apart!
'Why is a Dimensional Royalty like you here bullying little old me? Ah!'

A melancholic thought passed through its mind as it was the last thing, the ravaging Mirror Essence that had permeated the surroundings sinking into and shattering its origin into countless Mirror Shards at this moment.
The Undead Reality of the Anaconda shattered and faded as the culprit to do all this- the Adjudicator Katelyn, floated across the cold waters calmly as the Mirror hammer faded away.

She came to float above the pulverized Abyssal Undead Beast as she patted its shattered skull, her expression showing complex emotions as she sighed and moved forward to the dome shaped golden barrier at the center of this landmass that swirled with a treasured light of destiny.

Her fair finger landed on this tough barrier for a few seconds as she felt its indestructible defense, but she uniquely didn't start infusing the barrier with essence or attack it as instead- an illusory authority of a black Halo flashed while she tapped onto the golden dome once!
BZZZT!

In the next instant, a unique scene manifested as a thin silver line appeared above the golden dome, this line showing a reflection of the dome barrier as it shockingly recreated the whole nearby area to be reflecting onto itself!

Katelyn's eyes flashed with a terrifying silver light as her hands reached into the crystalline silver mirror like reflection of the golden dome, her eyes lighting up as she pulled out a cluster of glimmering Grotto Nacres from it.
Nacres...that were clustered into the ecriture of <WELCOME> that when Katelyn saw, her gaze became even sharper.
CRACK!

The Mirror line she had drawn faded as the reflection of the golden dome faded- but the treasures within were already gone as a silver gateway appeared beside Katelyn where all the Grotto Nacres disappeared into!
It was a wondrous and unique power, and the existence to wield it was even more unique.

She gazed around the barren land around her thoughtfully as the words <WELCOME> flashed over her eyes that soon turned up to see the Chains of Reality leading to unknown areas forward, about to continue her ascension when all of a sudden...
"Oh?"

She couldn't help but speak out as she felt terrifying malice and Essence rising from behind her- from the Chain of Reality that should be leading all the way down to the first region of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum!
SHAA!
With valor and power, two terrifying auras rose up from the Chain of Reality as the oppressive might of two LEGENDS appeared.
They flashed with utter wildness and malice as at the very forefront, the figure of Xian could be seen as his whole surroundings were bathed by storms of Aether.
Beside him was a brown skinned young man with an air of poisonous allure, two sickles with a deathly green light buzzing in his hands as his eyes released a green hue!
"Haha!"
Xian let out a wild laugh as his gaze landed on Katelyn, the concentration of Aether around him getting even denser as he walked forward fearlessly.
"You haven't forgotten me yet, right? I couldn't freely make moves back then with Brightborn there, but you...you're really a fruit that I truly cannot pass up."
BZZZT!

His words were powerful as 30 dazzling Ascendancy Halos erupted and were ready to merge into him, the other monstrous genius from the Olden Times beside him doing the same as he released a horrific verdant light when he spoke.
"You really weren't lying Xian! Why don't I take first dibs with her? I'm sure you can feel how dangerous this will be."
Yes!

These two existences appeared here with their own aims, and they affirmed their target as well as the fact that their destinies told them it would be an extremely difficult task to achieve their goal!
"I might have had to run away with nothing if I came alone." Xian nodded his head as his Will tried to discern destiny and Karma.

He had lived in the Olden Era as he knew how important understanding destiny was, and he wouldn't normally take risks that showed the level of danger that he was feeling right now when facing this calm young woman before him.
"But if she was easy to take down, then she wouldn't be a Dimensional Royalty. Let's not tarry too long...make your move, Dion!"
WAA!

His lips curved in a devilish smile as he spoke, his figure shooting to the left while Dion shot to the right, circling Adjudicator Katelyn from different directions as they prepared for a tough battle!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1825
paragraphs: Two monstrous existences from the Olden Era circled a single young woman after just a few words, their goals diabolical as they planned to forcefully impose themselves on this existence to attain something special!

Even though their destinies told them what they wanted to do would be extremely dangerous, they still made a move as for others- attaining a Dimensional Physique was the difference between life and death.
There were too many Candidate Emperors that rose within an Era.
How could one become special among the masses? How could they distinguish themselves from geniuses who held Mythical Natural Born Physiques?
Throughout recorded history, those who had managed to pull power from one of the 9 Dimensions had managed to distinguish themselves as in the case of Xian and Dion, they had to do this!

Their solidified crowns shone with a menacing light as Reality Passages that neared 100 for each of them erupted above, their eyes showing terrifying gazes when they looked at the existence before them as whatever they had to do...they would make sure to not let her swim past their grasp.

They weren't normal Beginner LEGENDS as their defenses and Damage Values were already well over double the 5 Million Base, their foundation being too monstrous as they had been preparing since the Olden Era!
Yet even these beings with such power moved with seriousness against a single Ninth Firmament Dimensional Royalty.
Two beings looked at her from different directions, yet their gazes were exactly the same.
She hated that type of gaze.
It was a gaze that she had seen all the time while she was growing up- where her father was the only man around her who didn't look at her in such a way!
The LEGENDS of the Royal Humans that were supposed to look at her as a junior for them to protect looked at her this way.
The delegation of any beings from the Main Reality that passed through the Domains of the Royal Humans and saw her...looked at her in this manner!
A gaze...as if she was an object for them to possess.
As if she was something for them to use to get something...and the only reason they couldn't do it was because of the fear towards her father or her own power!
These types of gazes were also part of the reason she never went to the Main Reality even when a LEGEND exceeding the Alpha Strata had let his will to take her as a disciple be known.
"I really hate it."
BZZZT!
She uttered these words with coldness as many memories from the past were pulled up, her body blaring with astounding light as 30 bright Ascendancy Halos flashed and got ready to fuse with her!
Yet at this juncture...
SHAA!
A fourth aura with astounding uniqueness and authority appeared.

It wasn't coming from the Chain of Reality leading below- but from the Chain of Reality on the east of the floating landmass that should have been leading straight across to another floating landmass!

With buzzing authority and releasing a type of essence others couldn't ignore, the eyes of the two attackers and Kayelyn who were all about to fuse with their Halos turned their eyes to ass the outline of the new entrant.
Surrounded by a sandy golden light that caused the Chain of Reality to vibrate, the massive figure of a regal Dragon Phoenix with purple gold scales and three flaming tails appeared.

He held a vibrant crown with the words <VAS> shining resplendently, and the eyes of the three existences on this landmass constricted when they observed closely to see that a humanoid figure was situated grandly atop this regal Dragon Phoenix, using its rising glorious horns as a throne for himself as he was currently gazing at everything curiously, his eyes lighting up when he saw the visage of Katelyn!
In turn, Xian and Dion's gazes turned somber.
This was because they felt the vibrant waves of a LEGEND from this Dragon Phoenix as its aura was near theirs...and yet a being was sitting atop it as if it were a mere mount!
A being...still in the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy.
The Dragon Phoenix had a solidified crown and yet...this existence didn't show anything above his head as he had to have been masking his authority.

But his entrance here would make things complicated as their destinies showed that a battle with their target alone would already be dangerous enough- not to mention an unknown existence who had managed to subjugate a genius Dragon Phoenix!

Granted, Xian might actually be able to remember the figure of Noah had he bothered to look around the Purple Endeavor that brought them here, but he had paid little attention to anyone else apart from Katelyn as even he didn't recognize Noah's visage at this moment.
With the eyes of three beings on him, Noah rose from his makeshift throne on top of Andur as he eyed Xian and Dion coldly.
"Now, what would you two be doing surrounding Adjudicator Katelyn like this?"
HUUUM!
His words reverberated with authority as he didn't seem to put the visage of the two LEGENDS in his eyes.
He appeared like a hero in the last minute to save a damsel in distress as his eyes lit up with power...before they gradually dimmed in the next second as destiny told him something else!
'Hmm?'

His gaze turned from the powerful LEGENDS surrounding Katelyn as they locked onto her, actually seeing this being raising her brows towards him as she didn't at all seem like someone who was worried after being surrounded by powerful existences.
He could instead feel reigned coldness and anger from her as this existence turned her eyes from him and stared at those who chose to attack her, her fair hand raising up as she...snapped her finger.
And then everything went to hell.
Noah's will buzzed as the scene and situation became clear, sighing in his heart as he affirmed he would not be able to show off or save any damsel in distress today.
The being that two Olden LEGENDS had surrounded was not a meek girl they could terrorize or put under their Will.
She was a monstrous Dimensional Royalty that they had now angered, and her wrath would not be sated until her enemies were extinguished!
'Well, I could at least understand a semblance of her power then...'
Noah sat back on the vibrant head of the Dragon Phoenix as he saw the shocking scene unfolding before his eyes the moment that Katelyn snapped her fingers.
Her surroundings became hectic as multiple miniature silver doorways flashed into existence...from different parts of her own body.

Multiple miniature Mirror Gateways that seemed anchored to her very skin bloomed where in the next second...the terrifying auras of Mirror Beast LEGENDS enlarged and stepped out while roaring with wrath- sensing the anger of their Master!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1826
paragraphs: How was the stage of Reality distinguished?
How could one grasp the level of power that could truly be reached at this level and it was comparable against Supreme geniuses who had yet to break into it?

Noah had already learned from Lavalliere that the Stage of Reality was treated as the Realm for one to truly establish their foundation, with one's Reality Passages and unique items like Grotto Nacres that could simultaneously cultivate all Aspects of Existence and expand one's Reality Passages playing a role to nourish one's body until...Empyral Bones, Musculature, and Organs began to form!
Constantly nourishing every part of your body until something as abstruse as <Empyral> was formed in your body parts.
On an Empyral Bone, Musculature, or Organ- one could brand abilities or concepts onto them and unleash reified abilities with a mere thought and no consequence of energy consumption!
Even Noah after breaking all of the Limits....had gained the qualifications to forge the <Mythical Paragon's Empyral Foundation>.
Nourishment.

This was the crucial thing as newly risen LEGENDS had to depend on the foundation they established in the Firmaments of Ascendancy to show off their power in the early stages of Reality, and beings who had lived for millions of years building their foundations before breaking through should theoretically be unstoppable in the Primogenial Strata of Reality when facing against their peers.

So what was occurring at this moment atop a certain barren landmass was all the more unfathomable as two Primogenial Strata from the Olden Times adopted stern expressions while fusing with their Ascendancy Halos- their eyes staring at an unbelievable scene of a single Ninth Firmament existence opening Dimensional Gateways from her very body as 6 overpowering auras of Primogenial Strata Mirror Beast LEGENDS thundered out!
OOOOOOH!

Their bellows caused space to squeeze and fracture as the surrounded domain flashed with a silvery light, the hands of Katelyn coming together in front of her bountiful chest at this moment as they seemingly compressed dense Mirror Essence before she pulled her hands apart and caused the expansion of a radiant Mirror Barrier.
BZZT!
A barrier that made it seem countless mirrors appeared and surrounded half of the landmass as the figures of Xian and Dion were contained within.
Locked in a Mirror Dimension Domain with 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS and a particularly angered Dimensional Royalty!

Noah gazed at this shocking scene while thinking of the Abilities of RUINATION, specifically about her upgrade that should be occurring soon as he couldn't wait to see what marvelous control of Mirror Essence she would have next...because the way that Katelyn was manipulating this Dimensional Essence was even far and above what Noah could do with Dream Essence.

The 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS called out seemed to constantly be shifting their forms, their eyes wrathful locked onto Xian and Dion as the forms these Olden Emperors took while they were fusing with their Halos...were also the forms these Mirror Beasts took on.

Xian had a glorious purple aurora of wings erupting from his back as he formed into an archaic titanic crocodile whose scales shone with a menacing purple crystalline luster, storms of Aether erupting around him as Dion transformed into a titanic verdant King Cobra who had venomous green black poison dripping from its enormous fangs!

They released wild power and valor as established LEGENDS would have a hard time fighting against them, and yet three Mirror Beast LEGENDS took on the form of the Aether Bourne Crocodile that Xian adorned while the other three transformed into the Venomous Devouring King Cobra form that Dion took...the most dreadful thing being the fact that the aura these Mirror Beasts released being no less than the enemies they reflected.
The eyes of Xian and Dion turned somber.
The dress on Katelyn shimmered with a silver light as she beckoned with her fingers, her expression being akin to a queen commanding her soldiers with regality as the 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS moved!
Their appearance prompted the question of the appearance of LEGENDS within this Grotto Sanctum.

Anything that had formed its Reality would be stopped from entering with the restrictions of the barrier of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, when even if someone was connected to another as they wanted to pull them in through the folds of space once they were in it...
The very spatial essence carrying these beings would be reflected and bounce off of the barrier of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.

Yet Katelyn was able to call out LEGEND Tier existence as she had Gateways built into her own body, where she didn't pull upon their essence of connection with her to draw them into this special Domain, but she simply released these terrifying Mirror Beasts that were contained in a Dimensional Space in her own body!
It was a terrifying venture as the existences who had set their eyes on her found themselves in a difficult situation that was evolving in an unexplainable direction.

And even in this constantly changing situation, the eyes of Katelyn were languid as while her summoned Mirror Beast LEGENDS began pressing down on Xian and Dion, her visage flashed as her extremely beautiful face turned towards Noah.
Noah who was currently sitting above his Dragon Phoenix while watching everything occurring with great focus!
Katelyn's eyes flashed with a silver light while gazing at Noah as something maddening occurred in the next instant.
A flash of silver light bloomed as the sounds of Mirrors sliding could be heard, and a change occurred on the left horn of Andur where the ecstatic aura of none other than Katelyn appeared!
A Mirror Clone!

With glimmering might and an expression filled with ease as if it was nothing, a figure looking just like her from the distance landed on the purple gold scales of Andur as she turned to gaze at Noah- speaking with a pondering tone while gazing at him up and down.

"You hid yourself really well," Her voice was mesmerizing and powerful to hear as it carried a trace of regality when she spoke, her figure standing straight as she continued, "I don't think I can let you go freely again without getting a sufficient answer as to why you attached yourself to Sis Genevieve and came into the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum."

sentences.text: How was the stage of Reality distinguished?
How could one grasp the level of power that could truly be reached at this level and it was comparable against Supreme geniuses who had yet to break into it?

Noah had already learned from Lavalliere that the Stage of Reality was treated as the Realm for one to truly establish their foundation, with one's Reality Passages and unique items like Grotto Nacres that could simultaneously cultivate all Aspects of Existence and expand one's Reality Passages playing a role to nourish one's body until...Empyral Bones, Musculature, and Organs began to form!
Constantly nourishing every part of your body until something as abstruse as <Empyral> was formed in your body parts.
On an Empyral Bone, Musculature, or Organ- one could brand abilities or concepts onto them and unleash reified abilities with a mere thought and no consequence of energy consumption!
Even Noah after breaking all of the Limits....had gained the qualifications to forge the <Mythical Paragon's Empyral Foundation>.
Nourishment.

This was the crucial thing as newly risen LEGENDS had to depend on the foundation they established in the Firmaments of Ascendancy to show off their power in the early stages of Reality, and beings who had lived for millions of years building their foundations before breaking through should theoretically be unstoppable in the Primogenial Strata of Reality when facing against their peers.

So what was occurring at this moment atop a certain barren landmass was all the more unfathomable as two Primogenial Strata from the Olden Times adopted stern expressions while fusing with their Ascendancy Halos- their eyes staring at an unbelievable scene of a single Ninth Firmament existence opening Dimensional Gateways from her very body as 6 overpowering auras of Primogenial Strata Mirror Beast LEGENDS thundered out!
OOOOOOH!

Their bellows caused space to squeeze and fracture as the surrounded domain flashed with a silvery light, the hands of Katelyn coming together in front of her bountiful chest at this moment as they seemingly compressed dense Mirror Essence before she pulled her hands apart and caused the expansion of a radiant Mirror Barrier.
BZZT!
A barrier that made it seem countless mirrors appeared and surrounded half of the landmass as the figures of Xian and Dion were contained within.
Locked in a Mirror Dimension Domain with 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS and a particularly angered Dimensional Royalty!

Noah gazed at this shocking scene while thinking of the Abilities of RUINATION, specifically about her upgrade that should be occurring soon as he couldn't wait to see what marvelous control of Mirror Essence she would have next...because the way that Katelyn was manipulating this Dimensional Essence was even far and above what Noah could do with Dream Essence.

The 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS called out seemed to constantly be shifting their forms, their eyes wrathful locked onto Xian and Dion as the forms these Olden Emperors took while they were fusing with their Halos...were also the forms these Mirror Beasts took on.

Xian had a glorious purple aurora of wings erupting from his back as he formed into an archaic titanic crocodile whose scales shone with a menacing purple crystalline luster, storms of Aether erupting around him as Dion transformed into a titanic verdant King Cobra who had venomous green black poison dripping from its enormous fangs!

They released wild power and valor as established LEGENDS would have a hard time fighting against them, and yet three Mirror Beast LEGENDS took on the form of the Aether Bourne Crocodile that Xian adorned while the other three transformed into the Venomous Devouring King Cobra form that Dion took...the most dreadful thing being the fact that the aura these Mirror Beasts released being no less than the enemies they reflected.
The eyes of Xian and Dion turned somber.
The dress on Katelyn shimmered with a silver light as she beckoned with her fingers, her expression being akin to a queen commanding her soldiers with regality as the 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS moved!
Their appearance prompted the question of the appearance of LEGENDS within this Grotto Sanctum.

Anything that had formed its Reality would be stopped from entering with the restrictions of the barrier of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, when even if someone was connected to another as they wanted to pull them in through the folds of space once they were in it...
The very spatial essence carrying these beings would be reflected and bounce off of the barrier of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.

Yet Katelyn was able to call out LEGEND Tier existence as she had Gateways built into her own body, where she didn't pull upon their essence of connection with her to draw them into this special Domain, but she simply released these terrifying Mirror Beasts that were contained in a Dimensional Space in her own body!
It was a terrifying venture as the existences who had set their eyes on her found themselves in a difficult situation that was evolving in an unexplainable direction.

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1827
paragraphs: "I don't think I can let you go freely again without getting a sufficient answer as to why you attached yourself to Sis Genevieve and came into the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum."

She was a Ninth Firmament existence who was currently facing two extremely powerful LEGENDS who were geniuses from the Olden Era, and yet she didn't even seem to be putting all that much focus into the battle as a Mirror Clone of hers appeared on the vibrant scales of Andur!
What power!
What might!

"Adjudicator Katelyn," Noah gave a light nod and spoke out without even turning to his left where the dazzling figure of Katelyn stood, continuing to watch the shocking scene of Mirror Beast LEGENDS and the other figure of Katelyn commanding them as he replied.
"I didn't know you were this powerful."
His words caused the languid eyes of this Dimensional Royalty to rise as she looked at this being closely once more.

She had grown curious of him not because he was someone Genevieve brought back and his behavior- but because she had sensed a thin trace of Mirror Essence on him when he first entered the Pure Blooded Domains!
Yet now...
"How is it that you are vibrantly playing with...Dream Essence? When I first saw Mirror Essence on you not too long ago?"
WAA!

"You've asked me many questions, which one should I answer first?" Noah's eyes blazed with a profound light as he looked away from the enticing battle and gazed up at the figure of Katelyn standing atop the horn opposite to him.

Dimensional Essence buzzed between these two beings as Noah was surrounded by surging sandy gold Dream Essence, while Katelyn had silver Mirror Essence buzzing around her as these two opposing forces clashed to release a terrific pressure!

The mixture of Dream and Mirror Essence caused a unique mixture to erupt as even the dark and deathly essence from the Niflheim Dimension that was influencing the surroundings ever so slowly was pushed away.

Like two ancient beasts merely measuring each other's auras, the surging sandy gold essence and silver essence coiled and buzzed against each other as even the surrounding space trembled at their sheer impact.
The grand figure of the Dragon Phoenix these two beings stood on was trembling slightly at this moment while using everything in its power to not show its emotions, but its thoughts were tumultuous.
'What the fuck?!'

Andur watched the battle blooming from afar and the perpetrator who had actually locked down two powerful LEGENDS having another one of her bodies land atop it, not expecting to come across another being that seemed as ridiculous if not more ridiculous than the Tyrannical Emperor he had just pledged Fealty to- and it was an existence that was somewhat renowned in name that he had heard of before!
He just didn't know...she would be this dreadful.
'Are we...in the same grouping of geniuses still?'
This newly turned Vassal began questioning everything he knew as two existences wielding heavy Dimensional Essence stood on top of its majestic draconic head.
BOOOM!
"XIAN! What the hell did you embroil me in?!"

In the battle from afar, the figures of the Aether Bourne Crocodile and the Venomous Devouring King Cobra were already battered and bleeding True Blood as three Mirror Beast LEGENDS reflecting their own forms besieged them on all sides- not even having the chance to display their power and authority they had forged for millions of years as they were getting thrashed as if they were novice LEGENDS.

They were truly powerful and had forged their Foundations to a great degree as just in the short period of time they had become LEGENDS, their True Reality Damage Values could already exceed 10 Million+.
Yet...
"Fuck!"

They cursed under their breaths as Domains of Aether and Poison erupted out, battling the summons of a ridiculous being who only watched everything from afar while clasping her hands behind her silver dress.
Another form of hers was even gazing towards a terrifying existence on top of a Dragon Phoenix as if the battle in the distance had nothing to do with her!
This was the power of a Dimensional Royalty.
This was a semblance of their might!
"Start with Genevieve."
She spoke lightly as her tone was neither commanding nor servile, as if she was talking to someone on the same level as her.
Noah smiled at her reply as he turned his eyes back to the unfolding battle while he spoke.
"She is not who everyone believes she is. She is a Disaster Remnant that the LEGENDS of the Pure-Blooded Bloodlines killed and kept the body of a long time ago."
WAA!
Noah spoke of grand secrets freely as Katelyn's eyes turned extremely sharp!
"What?"

Her words carried obvious disbelief as Genevieve was the daughter of the current Bloodline Master, and if she chose not to break through to the stage of a LEGEND in this Grotto Sanctum- she would more than likely take this seat while her Father ascended to become a LEGEND and take a new position in the Main Reality!

Noah's words sounded wild, but he didn't take any more time to explain as he put his hands beside his head and caused a surge of mana, wisps of essence flowing together and condensing into a crystalline ball of light that he threw towards Katelyn.
A ball of light that when crushed by the hands of another- pre-chosen scenes and memories would play out!

Katelyn's mesmerizing eyes were fearless as she grasped this ball of light and allowed the harmless essence to sink into her, the scenes of Will Bearers appearing and waging war against Genevieve while she transformed into a 'Sacred Beast' playing out, as well as the scenes of Beatrix speaking with Noah after he had gained control of her!
Silence descended in the surroundings as only the quaking might of the far away battle could be heard.
"OOOOH!"

The ferocious bellow of Xian could be heard as TABOO waves of authority congealed around storms of Aether, beginning to form an ability that was close to REIFIED as a massive demonic Crocodile surrounded by blooming Aether lotuses on its left and right nearly opened its eyes, it's jaws opening to release beams of terrific light as the three Mirror Beasts opposing Xian...replicated this same scene in a terrific manner as Noah clicked his tongue at this.

The Mirror Beasts under this ridiculous Dimensional Royalty alone seemed capable of matching against powerful Primogenial Strata LEGENDS, Noah wanting to get his hands on his own Dream and Nightmare LEGENDS for him to call out to- or simply finish forging multiple Infinite Dream Automatons!
As for the one in question who had called them out?
Her gaze was currently difficult as she sifted through the memories Noah provided her, her head shaking with a sigh soon after as she turned to gaze towards Noah again.
"Why didn't you move to stop her then? Why follow her into the Lands of Royal Humans and into this Grotto Sanctum?"
"Because..." Noah's eyes turned luminous as his body rose, his visage that of an untouchable emperor as he stared straight at this astounding being beside him and spoke out with utmost seriousness!

"My Destiny told me that an immeasurable fate was waiting for me if I take this path- filled with treasures, authority, and even..." His luminous eyes locked on to Katelyn's silvery glazed eyes as he continued.
"...dazzling new allies that will challenge me."
WAA!
The words of the Tyrannical Emperor were bold as he gazed straight at Katelyn when he said this!
"Be serious." Katelyn's brows merely rose towards Noah's words as she brushed them off with ease, her eyes becoming covered with a silver light as she gazed off into the distant battle thoughtfully.
"This will be problematic to handle. I couldn't discern anything from her as if a Disaster Remnant is moving around freely in here..."
She seemed to be reminiscing about all the past memories of the one she knew as Genevieve as she sighed, a smile appearing on Noah's face at this as his voice echoed out.
"How is it problematic? We simply need to wipe out all traces of her before she leaves this Grotto Sanctum!"

Noah's words were filled with tyranny as he spoke, these two terrifying existences with their own Mythical Natural Born Dimensional Physiques talking straightforwardly for the first time as the results of this meeting were unknown!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1828
paragraphs: Atop a barren land mass floating in cold seas that should have been filled with death and solitude.

Two immensely powerful Olden Emperors were being thrashed like mere children, their grandeur and visage being torn down like it was nothing by 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS whose controller...was currently not even putting all her focus on them!

A Mirror Clone of hers was sitting beside the devilishly handsome Tyrannical Emperor as the two of them seemed like celestial existences gracing their presence to the masses- and they did so in a shocking fashion while standing on top of a Dragon Phoenix whose very scales burned with a tinge of golden purple hue.
One could see the two were distinguished even from afar as their bodies pulsed with vibrant Dimensional Essence.

Katelyn was surrounded by radiant silver Essence as her gaze seemed to pierce across the veils of space and see things others couldn't, thinking about Noah's words of simply 'wiping out all traces of Genevieve who was unveiled to be a Disaster Remnant!
For this, one must consider what a Disaster Remnant was- and why Will Bearers were a faction of Primordials who were especially born to hunt those like them.

Will Bearers were existences holding connections to the Ancient Bloodlines that had long since been evicted out of the Main Reality by Primordials, with their most destined beings who managed to survive in the lands of Primordials until now being cleansed over the years!

Primordial LEGENDS who were proficient in Destiny took reigns of Will Bearers that they then sent out towards any Disaster Remnants they found, and this was how the Emperor of the Golden Eye had sent the Trio of Will Bearers that opposed Noah and Genevieve...and were instead turned into Resplendent Treasure Caches.
There were many Will Bearers in this Grotto Sanctum too, but how many of them knew that a target of their hunt walked among them?
'Even I didn't know all these years...'

A sigh escaped Katelyn's red lips as she returned her attention to the being who had the same visage as her...a being that seemed to keep her attention as she was somehow able to talk to him freely without being put off as if it was geniuses of the Royal Humans or those from the Main Reality who were around her 'age group' - they would already be granting her gazes of envy and jealousy if they were women, or gazes of greed and lust if they were men!
She didn't ponder too much on this as while a bullying in the distance nearly reached its climax, she got back on track.
"The other question." Her exceedingly beautiful face shook as she got back on topic, looking Noah up and down as she spoke freely.

"You had a trace of Mirror Essence...and still do, yet you are overflowing with Dream Essence at this moment. You...did you attain a Dimensional Physique in the short period of time I first met you, or you could just hide it really well?"
Her question sought answers to many things as Noah couldn't help but raise his brows quizzically towards her.
"You...why are you so freely asking about the secrets of others as if it is nothing?"
Noah asked a very simple question that caused Katelyn to blink a few times, the silver light in her eyes fluctuating as she gradually seemed to realize something.

She had already affirmed this being didn't mean any harm to the Bloodline her father stemmed from and had now found out he was even tracking a Disaster Remnant that was aiming for her old Body in the Treasury of the Royal Humans, and like all other geniuses- he had his own secrets and means of power that he didn't have to share with others- and in fact, nobody would so freely share their secrets.

She had just freely asked this question to sate her curiosity as she had never even bothered to take the initiative to talk to other so called geniuses, where even an existence like Ezekiel whom her sister moved with that she knew carried a powerful veil over his being wasn't enough to make her bother!
So what made her so freely ask this Alexander King things as she even stood on top of a genius he had subjugated?
Katelyn was pondering this question without answering Noah as his magnetic voice brought her back to the present.
"How about this, I'll answer that question if you allow me to...take care of those two little things."

Noah's eyes were locked onto the visibly panicking Xian and Dion in their monstrous forms of Aether Bourne Crocodile and the Venomous Devouring King Cobra who were surrounded on all sides and were simply getting thrashed in a way that utterly destroyed any semblance of their authority!
Katelyn turned her eyes towards this area as she actually took Noah's words seriously, replying soon after.
"Just one."
WAA!

Just one! Katelyn had promised herself that she would seek the power and authority her family seemed to be rushing towards so much, so of course she wouldn't just let a chance to attain more authority from existences who tried to harm her go!
The sheer fact that she was okay giving one away was a testament to her curiosity as towards her reply, Noah's eyes released a terrific luster.

He had pondered and even affirmed with destiny whether he could just freely kill steal the enemies Katelyn was currently thrashing to obtain their Bloodlines and loot, and destiny showed him not so favorable fates in terms of his barely formed relationship with this terrifying Dimensional Royalty if he moved around in secret or merely said 'woops' after he did whatever he wanted!
The existence known as Katelyn...seemed to have a rather straightforward personality as Noah used her curiosity to simply say what he wanted to do.
And for the price of answering a question, he could loot an Olden existence!
HUUM!
His body buzzed with power as he rose up and stared at Xian with a devilish gaze.

To rouse more curiosity from the Dimensional Royalty beside him, his body distinctly flashed with the allure of 30 black Ascendancy Halos that fused with him, an aurora of wings erupting from his back as he adorned the True form of the Pure Arch-Royal Human!
His visage became even more devilishly handsome as tendrils of Runic golden flames surged around him, his one wing expanding behind him as his hair lengthened and adopted a golden luster.
In such a strengthened state, he didn't cast terrifyingly apocalyptic abilities or expose with power as he instead actually sat back down atop his Dragon Phoenix...and he merely began to speak!
p"Hey,"

At his mere word, Katelyn's eyes constricted with care as she felt a billowing Tyrannical will carried along with them- a will that utilized authority and Soundwave to establish itself as it was the utilization of Emperor's Haki.
The ability that would allow Noah to infuse deadly Dimensional Damage Values to his mere words and thoughts as attacks so long as he released them with his <Emperor's Haki>!

Katelyn was pondering this question without answering Noah as his magnetic voice brought her back to the present.
"How about this, I'll answer that question if you allow me to...take care of those two little things."

Noah's eyes were locked onto the visibly panicking Xian and Dion in their monstrous forms of Aether Bourne Crocodile and the Venomous Devouring King Cobra who were surrounded on all sides and were simply getting thrashed in a way that utterly destroyed any semblance of their authority!
Katelyn turned her eyes towards this area as she actually took Noah's words seriously, replying soon after.
"Just one."
WAA!
Just one!

Katelyn had promised herself that she would seek the power and authority her family seemed to be rushing towards so much, so of course she wouldn't just let a chance to attain more authority from existences who tried to harm her go!
The sheer fact that she was okay giving one away was a testament to her curiosity as towards her reply, Noah's eyes released a terrific luster.

He had pondered and even affirmed with destiny whether he could just freely kill steal the enemies Katelyn was currently thrashing to obtain their Bloodlines and loot, and destiny showed him not so favorable fates in terms of his barely formed relationship with this terrifying Dimensional Royalty if he moved around in secret or merely said 'woops' after he did whatever he wanted!
The existence known as Katelyn...seemed to have a rather straightforward personality as Noah used her curiosity to simply say what he wanted to do.
And for the price of answering a question, he could loot an Olden existence!
HUUM!
His body buzzed with power as he rose up and stared at Xian with a devilish gaze.

To rouse more curiosity from the Dimensional Royalty beside him, his body distinctly flashed with the allure of 30 black Ascendancy Halos that fused with him, an aurora of wings erupting from his back as he adorned the True form of the Pure Arch-Royal Human!
His visage became even more devilishly handsome as tendrils of Runic golden flames surged around him, his one wing expanding behind him as his hair lengthened and adopted a golden luster.
In such a strengthened state, he didn't cast terrifyingly apocalyptic abilities or expose with power as he instead actually sat back down atop his Dragon Phoenix...and he merely began to speak!
p"Hey,"

At his mere word, Katelyn's eyes constricted with care as she felt a billowing Tyrannical will carried along with them- a will that utilized authority and Soundwave to establish itself as it was the utilization of Emperor's Haki.
The ability that would allow Noah to infuse deadly Dimensional Damage Values to his mere words and thoughts as attacks so long as he released them with his <Emperor's Haki>!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1829
paragraphs: The utilization of Haki was extremely unique as those weaker than Noah who were oppressed by his will would automatically lose 50% of their battle power against him.
It had turned passive when the Tyrannical Emperor became TABOO as Noah could actively use it against his enemies, and the unique thing was how its resource cost varied depending on the target!
If it was a weak enemy that Noah's will could easily overcome, the resource cost was negligible and not even worth mentioning.

But if it was someone truly powerful that even his strong will and soul couldn't easily sway- the resource cost would be higher the longer he directed this ability against them as it could theoretically reach hundreds of thousands of Units of the Essence of Reality per microsecond!

The will for his Haki stemmed from the strength of his Primogenial Soul as its power was drawn from here too, so Noah found it unique to target those in the Primogenial Strata of Reality with his own Soul that had yet to fully establish itself in the realm of Reality as the moment he came out the victor...he reaffirmed his robust foundation.
"Hey,"
Carried by Haki, the word barreled out as under the authority of this True Form, Noah easily exceeded 10 Million True Dimensional Damage Values with this attack alone.

It came to thunder in Xian's mind as his gaze quickly changed, his head buzzing as his right eye seemingly felt a heavy pressure building up inside as this Aether Bourne Crocodile had its eye and socket explode in the next instant!

The battlefield instantly changed as Xian's battered body pulled back from the three Mirror Beast LEGENDS that actually didn't follow him- all of this being under the command of their Master who was currently watching everything with interest.
She hadn't gotten a chance to freely associate with a being holding a connection to a Dimension this closely before as even the methods of power of others were different.
She wanted to see.
She was curious!

But in the mind of the target that was Xian, his Olden Soul was shuddering as he gazed towards the source of the voice with immense shock and fear- this being already feeling his Aspects of Existence and Reality Passages beginning to dim as a pervasive Dimensional Essence ravaged throughout his body!
His eyes could see his destiny turning extremely dark.
"Wait..."
So he croaked out.
But the luminous eyes of the Tyrannical Emperor were coldly gazing downwards as he finished his words while casting Emperor's Haki three times!
"Die for me."
BZZZT!

A negligible 75,000 Units of the Essence of Reality surged out from him against this being known as Xian, three booming attacks that arrived the moment they were voiced out smashing onto the visage of an Olden Emperor on all sides as this being...

Saw his own destiny close before his very eyes as his crocodilian head burst open with the first word, his defenses already dimming down due to the effects of the Dream Essence as the other two words smashed into his Origin and Soul as they were also smashed to bits!
BOOM...SPLAT!

And the end result of it all was the enormous body of the Aether Bourne Crocodile expanding in multiple areas like a stuffed balloon as shimmering golden true blood splattered over the jagged mirror barriers!

An Emperor at the Realm of Reality who had forged his foundation for millions of years and prepared to springboard himself into Hegemony in the Kainos Era...died that simply as the masses wouldn't even be there to witness his death.

Andur's figure trembled at this scene as he wiped imaginary sweat from his draconic brows, thankful he had somewhat listened to his destiny and didn't actually die from someone merely speaking a few words!

Meanwhile, Katelyn's eyes squinted as she observed this scene closely, seeing the immense will carried by the attacks the being beside her had sent forth while he was still situated atop a Dragon Phoenix.
<Hey, die for me.>
4 words.
That was all it took to end such an existence as Katelyn saw the dense and vibrant Dimensional Damage Values that totaled over 40 Million from these 4 words put together.

Yet even though this scene was dreadful as it even caused the figure of Dion to gaze in a stupor as the 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS all surged towards this Devouring King Cobra that was already on its last legs.
Yet Katelyn herself only nodded with shining eyes as even after she saw this...she actually still didn't feel any ounce of fear or apprehension when gazing at this level of power!
"That much level of Dimensional Essence is impossible for any common Dimensional Physique."

She spoke about what interested her the most as even the deaths of two powerful Emperors weren't placed in her eyes, the poor Olden Emperors known as Xian and Dion not even getting a proper burial as the latter was ripped apart by 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS in the seconds that followed, the shimmering crown above Katelyn's head shining as more ecritures formed while above Noah...no fluctuations showed as he still hid his vibrant crown.

He didn't yet answer Katelyn's words as he watched vibrant prompts wash over his eyes, his Will also moving out to pull the glowing true blood of the ravaged Devouring King Cobra as Katelyn's Mirror Barrier began to fade while the 6 Mirror Beast LEGENDS returned to her the Dimensional Gateways on her body!
[+25 Primogenial Blood Pearls have been obtained...] DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+2,500 Physique Refining Pearls obtained.]
[+25 Liquified Soul Dews have been obtained...] DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+25 Liquified Soul Seas have been obtained.]
[+25 Seeds of Reality have been obtained...] DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+25 False Grotto Nacres have been obtained.]
[+100,000,000 Trillion Skill Points obtained...] DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+10,000 Reality Resource Points obtained.]
<The effects of Absolute Looter are applied.>
<You have attained the TABOO Edicts of Aether's Embrace, Emperor of Fortitude, Ophidian Emperor....>
<The Olden Bloodline of the Aether Bourne Crocodile has been attained.>

His body in the Main Reality buzzed with power in its slumber as the crown above him shone, the ecritures <ETHEREAL DIMENSI EMPEROR> shining with glory as even though he had just slain an existence that held multiple ecritures on his crown, the authority he had obtained from Xian added just a little to his own!

Part of the reason why he had garnered as much authority as he had was due to the fact that this being granted him 13 new TABOO Nomological Edicts, the wondrous Physique Refining Pearls, Liquefied Soul Seas, and False Grotto Nacres only being a bow to top off this whole gift as Noah began perusing the memories of this being and understand more intricacies of the past.

As he did this, his clone of Alexander released his true form as he returned to utter calmness on top of the Dragon Phoenix genius that was visibly trembling at this moment, the visage of Katelyn looking towards him with sparkling eyes that held a trace of vibrant curiosity, a quizzical expression present on her face as she asked with some hesitation.
"Are you...also a Dimensional Champion?"

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1830
paragraphs: "Are you...also a Dimensional Champion?"
The question was asked so simply as Katelyn had a quizzical expression, Noah keeping his own expression calm as he didn't give anything away even though he was hearing this term for the first time.
But his silence could be mistaken for an answer as he gazed at Katelyn while asking his own question.
"What would make you think I was a Dimensional Champion?"
Yes.
What did this title actually mean, and how was it different from a Dimensional Royalty?!
Katelyn's eyes raised at such a question as she pondered briefly before she replied, at the same time recalling all the power left behind where Xian and Dion just fell.

"Existences with tight connections to Dimensions who aren't imposed with the same restrictions. The Dimensions running alongside Reality are extremely old and powerful as the beings within are even more so, and yet you do not see any Dimensional beings running around in the vast Realities."

"All Dimensionally bound existence cannot freely step into the vast Realities. With those who can being unique as they had to have a form of astounding authority from the Dimension...or others in a unique situation like me."
Noah's eyes shone with luminous lights at these words.

Katelyn was the daughter of a Dimensional Royalty and Alpha Strata LEGEND as she shared Bloodlines of both the vast Realities and Dimensions. While Noah...had attained his Dimensional connection through his System and then eventually Lavalliere with her Absolute Dream Authority that went to birth the Infinite Dream Physique!
His form buzzed with power as he was thinking, Katelyn waiting for his answer as he only smiled after a while and replied.
"I can't say anything about me being a Dimensional Champion, but I can answer your question that we agreed upon for the death of the little Aether beast."

Noah said this as he looked at the streaks of golden crimson true blood that were all that remained of a powerful Olden Emperor that had granted him a Supreme Olden Bloodline of the Aether Bourne Crocodile.

"Just like you have a connection with the Mirror Dimension through your own means, I gained a connection with the Dream Dimension with a Physique. Though, I don't seem to be nearly as powerful with the Essence of this Dimension compared to you- nor as special as I don't have existences chasing after my body so far."

Katelyn was following his words with focus as her calm eyes gradually became covered by a silvery light towards the end when she was reminded of why two Primogenial LEGENDS had just tried to attack her!

She let out a sigh as if she was woken up, looking at Noah whom she was curious about as unlike others- he didn't look at her with the repulsive gaze that she was used to from all men. She attributed this reason to him having already attained a Dimensional Physique as his means seemed immensely interesting, but she still had to continue moving at this moment as she nodded towards Noah and began floating away from the Dragon Phoenix's scaly head.
Her other body had turned into a streak of light to fuse with her as she released vibrant authority, Noah remaining situated upon Andur as he still voiced out towards her.
"You're going to leave just like that?"

He spoke while silently admiring the visage of this Dimensional Royalty who didn't even turn back as she turned to gaze up at the vibrant and cold chains of Reality arcing towards the glacial seas above.
"Just like you have your destiny, my own destiny also has a path I need to follow for me to achieve what I want. There is also Genevieve to take of....It is dangerous, but I shall do it nonetheless."
WAA!
Her words were filled with variance as she spoke, Mirror Essence buzzing around her as Noah wouldn't let her leave this easily!
So he cast out a net as he replied with a knowing nod.
"The <WELCOME> of the Grotto Nacres, did you find that here too?"
Noah spoke as he gazed at the golden dome he didn't feel any opportunities in as he guessed Katelyn must have somehow already gotten it!
Slight surprise covered Katelyn's eyes as she focused back on Noah briefly.
"Yes."
The surprised eyes of this Dimensional Royalty turned somber soon after as she gazed up in the distant glacial seas where the Essence of the Niflheim Dimension was getting thicker and even colder.
"It's giving me extremely dangerous waves of destiny when I think about it and what lies ahead."
She had the same premonition of danger as Noah- whatever lay ahead of them being something dreadful to even cause beings like them to move with care!
"Then...since we must take care of Genevieve and know of the dangers to come ahead, why don't we move together for now? Genevieve will be coming for me soon enough anyways..."
Noah had cast out a net as he began to pull it in at this moment.
Katelyn turned back towards him as she only saw his confident smile, her curiosity towards the mysteries he held still keeping her on the hook as she actually began to ponder.

"I've got a ride here and still have questions about Dimensions I wish to ask you, and I'll also answer any...viable questions that you have as well. You can also affirm with your destiny, but I'm sure I will not be anything close to a hindrance towards your goals."

Noah patted the shimmering golden purple scales of the Dragon Phoenix below him who shuddered, the Dimensional Royalty before his eyes becoming covered by a golden light as a myriad of silver gold lotuses began to bloom around her body- giving off immense waves of destiny as seemed to be looking for something!
She came out of her trance soon after as the lotuses faded, and she actually nodded her head as she floated back towards the draconic head where Noah sat calmly.

Her eyes were staring up towards the glacial cold seas that led to the unknown, the visage of Noah beside her placing his hands on the vibrant scales of the beast they were on as flourishing Dimensional Essence surged and wrapped around it.
HUUM!

With a sandy golden glow, the restrictions loosened in the surroundings as a flaming Dragon Phoenix carrying two beings moved towards the Chains of Reality arching upwards- Noah beginning his ascension towards the depths of the Grotto Sanctum that would reveal many things as this time, he had a beauty by his side!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1831
paragraphs: While Noah began his ascension deeper into the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, other beings also reached the first floating landmass as the True geniuses overcame the trials and also moved forward.

Across the outer ring where the Chains of Reality leading to the first Land masses were located, the chains leading from them all seemed to be pulled up from a single central region, showing that when one ascended even further- the geniuses that had been exploring and meeting opportunities separately would soon be able to meet!
The Scions of different Lineages of the Main Reality.
The hidden geniuses that others didn't even comprehend the power of!
And...whatever lay waiting in this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.
In the Dimensional Holy Land.

Surges of multicolored Essence wrapped around Noah's main body that was seated on the Throne, his eyes fluttering as his eyelids began to open heavily as if they were golden gates that held behind them splendrous grandeur.
WAA!
A burst of light bloomed from his eyes opening as he rose from slumber, the third Infinite Dream ending as over 10,000 new Realities were assimilated into the Infinite Reality!
This included 2 unique Realities that were currently forming into their own domains the size of hundreds of Cosmos in a region of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.

But Noah's attention wasn't so much on this as it was on the other gains of the Infinite Dream, with the number of True Stars of Conquest exceeding 5,000 once more as yet another bold action could be taken.
While just waking up from slumber, Noah's first action was a domineering one.
"Take the Dictum Emperor to TABOO."
HUUM!
The incandescent light of Thousands of True Stars of Conquest flashed as they began budding to form a new Seed of TABOO!

At the same time, Noah breathed out while checking the vibrant state of his body that was being packed with essence constantly, the Infinite Reality Passages continuing to nourish him as even though his Aspects of Existence couldn't take any more essence- all of it was being stored in Noah's body!
Until he affirmed that he truly couldn't exceed the limitations anymore, this essence would continue building up as even now- he was looking at new means of Empowerment.

He could Trippe Empower his Aspects of Existence and a few more things as there were enough residual True Stars of Conquest to do so- the added Prime Realities and unique Realities each adding multiple True Stars of Conquest compared to normal Emerging Realities as Noah had hundreds to spare even now.
He waited for the most opportune time to do this, with Jim not knowing exactly when this time would be as only time would tell!

But while he waited for this time to come and a new Seed of TABOO was budding, there were also changes occurring to his Infinite Reality Passages now that the changes of the Infinite Reality were gradually stabilizing.
The Infinite Runic Ecriture of Modus Operandi...would evolve based on the state of the Infinite Reality!
The Infinite Reality Passages and the rotation of one's origin that stemmed from this Modus Operandi would also undergo their own changes.

Noah rose from the throne he had been slumbering in this whole time as he gazed above him where vibrant massive stellar mountain-like Passages gushed essence onto him endlessly- these passages currently undergoing expansion as if they weren't massive already!
This wasn't all as their multicolored allure was beginning to dim while a sandy gold brightness began to permeate and brighten up along their massive mountain-like bodies.

The dense and massive sandy golden light of Dream Essence clustered around Noah's Infinite Reality Passages as the changes were computed and then quantified before Noah's eyes, the essence raining down from the radiant Reality Passages coming down with much more fervor!
<The Infinite Runic Ecriture of Modus Operandi is undergoing changes as the Reality it is based on has achieved an unquantifiable state.>
<The Infinite Reality Passages birthed by the method of operation of the Gorumandizing Dimensional Reality have been heavily influenced by the essence of the Dream Dimension.>
HUUM!

Golden Essence burst and coiled like draconic snakes across the 50 Infinite Reality Passages, causing the 'skies' above the Dimensional Holy Land to be painted with utmost splendor as any beings might fall to their knees if they were to see it!
Yet Noah gazed at it all with a profound gaze of elation as this was what his soul looked for the most.
The sense of wonder at finding and unlocking unimaginable things!
The glory of opening paths and truths others could only dream of!
