bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1842
paragraphs: Legions of LEGENDS from the Ancient Times, and they all seemed to be bolstered and surrounded by the dreadful and deathly Essence of the Niflheim Dimension!
The center of this all was a mesmerizing cluster of Legions of Kun Pengs.

They took the majesty of dragons and phoenixes as their bodies were hybrids of Celestial bird species and dead sea fish- their feathered wings made up flames erupting beside them as ferocious crimson purple flames rolled around their beaks.

The splendorous tail similar to a fish stretched out behind them as among the Legions of Kun Pengs, there was a variation in colors as they burned from gold to purple to crimson, with extra tails of flames erupting around it.
Each of them were massive as uniquely, liquefied essence surged around their bodies as if it was innately attracted to them!
Their eyes shone of a profound light of brutality as Noah affirmed all these beings to be at the Primogenial Strata, with a few massive Kun Peng Commanders standing powerfully at the Beta Strata.
Beta Strata!
A stage of beings where even in his most powerful True Form, Noah wouldn't be able to deal half of the damage they could dish out with a movement of their limbs.

It wasn't so much of a problem of them having at minimum 100 Million Damage Values- with many far exceeding this number as this was just a numerical distinction, but it was the fact that this was an entirely different and greater Strata.
There was a suppression when someone of a higher Strata faced a lower Strata!
This was why Noah didn't consider those in the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy his enemies anymore unless they were limited Breakers.
The discrepancy wasn't as large when looking at the Primogenial and Beta Strata, but it was still there!
So when Noah saw the masses of Beta Strata Ancient LEGENDS...
THUMP!
His heart beat felt ever clear as his destiny buzzed.
"Hmm?"
And at this moment, it buzzed with most activity as his eyes arrived at the very center of the Legions of terrifying enemies before them.
His eye lids vibrated as he realized he had been wrong!
The masses of millions of Ancient Legions were not all LEGENDS.
There was a single existence that defied this truth as they wondrously were positioned at the very center of this army, and they didn't shine with the allure of a Reality.
Yet, one wouldn't be able to truly link this being to the Firmaments of Ascendancy due to the unique aura he released!
This was because his overbearing aura...ridiculously seemed no less than the unbelievable Beta Strata LEGENDS!!!
It was an existence that sat on a blinding red and gold throne of flames, his visage untainted and holy as his eyes carried a magnetizing and endless grandeur!

He was in humanoid form while he sat on the Throne in the midst of multiple magisterial Beta Strata Kun Pengs and tens of thousands of Primogenial Strata ones, his aura unique amidst these massive and daunting Legions as one of his eyes shone with a blinding crimson light while the other released a terrifying purple light of Royalty.

A radiant multicolored crown floated above him as it resoundingly shone with the vibrant ecritures of <INTERNUNCIO EMPEROR>, a deathly gray light surrounding it as the Niflheim Dimensional Essence surged around these two words with intensity!

The gaze of this being spanned across the transparent barrier as it was held by a single being- the visage of Akaris shockingly getting brighter and brighter as past Legions of Primogenial and Beta Strata LEGENDS...the gaze of these two beings clashed!

Their eyes shone with vibrant luminosity as all the existences around them seemingly didn't matter in their eyes, the terrifying Kun Peng sitting on the far away throne holding a calm expression as his eyes flashed with a golden light an instant later, actually turning to the right of Akaris as his line of sight came to land on one other being.

Akaris also followed this line of sight as with her gaze remaining unperturbed, she saw the existence upon the fiery throne also lock his gaze onto none other than the dark haired tyrannical existence that was known as Alexander King.
Amidst this shocking situation, one could see a genuine smile on this being even in the face of great danger and one could even say- certain death!
When Noah met the eyes of this terrifying monster, his eyes shone with radiant light while his origin buzzed with possibilities.
An astounding enigma had appeared before his eyes and the eyes of many beings!
The cold Reality settled in the minds of all Pure-Blooded Primordial Geniuses here.

The number of Pure-Blooded Primordials that had entered this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum were in the few millions as a majority stemmed from the Adjudicator and Obsidian Adjudicator Legions, with a portion made up of Will Bearers and other non cohesive groups.

Most were still in the first region as they bore the heavy weight of restrictions, with less than half making it up the first Chains of Reality and onto the floating land masses that held Grotto Nacres and a few Undead Champions!

As for those who had gone further ahead and crossed the glacial seas by spending much of their Essence of Reality and TABOO authority...it was less than 1% of all the Pure-Blooded Primordial Geniuses that had entered this Domain.
This was the reason for the shock and despair!
This so called Unexplored Grotto Sanctum was no land of opportunity.

It was instead a land of death that they had walked right in- this whole thing seeming to be a scheme from the enemies before them as they had somehow found a way to pull the destinies of profoundly powerful Geniuses here!

What exactly made this possible? How had these terrifying existences fooled a portion of the geniuses of Pure-Blooded Primordial Bloodlines into thinking that a glorious Destiny was possible to attain in such a place?!
The answer, as always, was hidden bare before everyone's eyes.
<The Heart of Destiny has unveiled all secrecy as it awaits a new owner.>
WAA!
A dazzling golden star had been descending as all veils were wiped away by it.
Whether one knew what it signified or not didn't matter!
Another set of dazzling words that seemed to fluctuate from crimson to gold painted the skies as it caused the hearts of many Pure-Blooded Primordial Geniuses to tremble.
<The Emperor reigning Supreme in the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest shall lay claim to the Heart of Destiny.>

paragraphs: <The Emperor reigning Supreme in the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest shall lay claim to the Heart of Destiny.>
The Unexplored Grotto Sanctum unveiled itself as nothing other than a domain termed as the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest.
But the message that this Grotto Sanctum revealed its identity with caused the destinies of many beings to surge as they finally saw why they were all drawn here!
An immeasurable treasure that most of them didn't even know the origin of nor what its uses were.
But the Emperor reigning Supreme in the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest would attain it!
Yet when one gazed at the millions of Primogenial and Beta Strata Commanders that painted the other side of the transparent barrier...was this even a feasibility?
It didn't even seem like they would be escaping death the moment that the thin transparent barrier faded!
Life and death.
For many Pure-Blooded Primordial Geniuses, this would be decided today.
And frankly...it was not looking at all in their favor!
The Seed of TABOO for the Dictum Emperor went towards completion as Noah's piercing gaze through destiny became even sharper.

His clone was facing an utterly perilous situation in the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest as if Noah didn't wish to lose it, he would either have to break into the Realm of Reality right away...or he could seek another path!
After talking with his Infinite Reality and peering through Destiny, he saw that among a few possible paths- a single one shone with the most brilliance of possibilities.
"Dr. Hall, huh"
Noah uttered the name of one of the beings that was nurtured in his Infinite Reality as his main body appeared above the vast skies of the past Blue Planet.
The events of the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest would break in the next few seconds or minutes, and Noah had to make his decision on the course of action he would take before that period of time ended!
Due to that...
"Extend the authority of the Dimensional Holy Land."
BZZZZT!

The brilliant allure of gold flashed as the liquefied seas of essence in the skies of the past Blue Planet surged, the Domain of the Dimensional Holy Land being extended here along with its Time Dilation effects!
A time dilation of 20,000:1.
A single second passing in the outside Realities and Dimensions equated to 20,000 seconds in this area!
That was over 5 hours with the passing of a single second.
For Noah to come to a decision and carry it out...time would not be a problem.
Dr. Hall brushed the locks of his golden hair as he sat in his office, the chair he reclined on releasing wisps of verdant light as it soothed his body.
This was one of the few times he was on a break in his office located on the 500th floor where only the most important personages in the field of Medicine resided in.

He was staring at his status panel that showed his Cosmic Filament Realm, his progression having been ridiculous recently as the Quasi-TABOO Edict of the <Origin of Nature> allowed him to optimize his Origin in unbelievable ways, to the point that when he absorbed the Sacred Herbs that were freely available to all inhabitants and the palpable liquified seas of essence around him- the essence absorbed in his origin very easily formed Cosmos as Hall controlled them in such a way that he easily induced the birth of 10 more cosmos from the singularity of a single one!

He was currently pondering on different ways to improve himself after coming across so many changes due to the now vibrant dimensional essence when his status panel shockingly faded as a vibrant blue text box arose before his eyes.
<The Tyrannical Emperor calls upon his Vassal.>
HUUM!
The voice and words that he attributed to the system buzzed in his mind as Hall nearly fell out of his chair in surprise and shock!
Besides his Frost Diamond Mahogany desk, a vibrant blue portal formed as Dr. Hall felt his heart nearly leap out of his chest, his mind buzzing as he breathed out to calm himself down.
Why would the Emperor be coming down to call upon little old him?
This thought buzzed in his mind as he calmed himself down, rising up as forgot he still wore his blue scrubs- his legs heavy as he went towards the shimmering blue portal.
SHAA!

Dr. Hall passed through the portal and found himself in an expansive room lined up with golden glass walls, his eyes trembling as he instantly recognized the surrounding metropolis outside the clear golden class as he realized he was inside the building that many lucky Vassals on the land that used to be on the blue planet gazed to every day!

It was an immeasurably tall skyscraper that rose from a castle at the center of these lands, its height going past the clouds and reaching the stars as it was the building that those closest to the Tyrannical Emperor frequently moved around in!
The concentration of essence was utterly dense here as one would always be swimming in liquefied seas of essence, and now- the sandy gold light essence permeated heavily in the atmosphere.

Dr. Hall stopped gazing at the scene outside as he focused on the room where the aura of a pristine being could be felt, his eyes shaking as they landed on a man sitting on an executive seat at the head of a golden table made from the bones of a Ninth Firmament Beast.

The man's very skin shone with a stellar hue as vibrant Cosmos could be seen swirling around, his body uniquely adorned in a sleek black suit and a white slim-fit shirt that was unbuttoned at the very top.
His form and visage looked Cosmic as Dr. Hall stared for a few seconds in stupor, collecting himself soon after as he came to his knees and called out seriously.
"Emperor!"
WAA!
A Vassal greeted an Emperor as Noah looked at this scene curiously, with him not normally talking to his people in this manner as he waved his hands while speaking out.
"Rise and be at ease. We have a significant amount of time...but we are still in somewhat of a hurry so we have to move things along."
His words caused Dr. Hall's eyes to flash with light as this exceptional being nodded, piecing many things together as he replied with a serious face while rising.
"What can I help you with, Emperor?"
"Mmm, I heard you have a unique Quasi-TABOO Nomological Edict. Something that can aid me in a conundrum I've been facing..."
WAA!
Dazzling waves of destiny shone as a Vassal and his Emperor conversed, strings of unseen karma buzzing chaotically as it was the prelude to a shocking action that would redefine Reality!

paragraphs: <Well, you wouldn't have any squabbles about losing one clone, right?>
Lavalliere's voice rang out in Noah's Will while he began to converse with Dr. Hall, the act of multitasking being an easy thing for him as he replied calmly.
"It is still a mystery whether I will be losing a Clone."
<Well, unless you become a LEGEND right now, which you don't seem to want to do...the other path you are seeking is still filled with unknowns.>
She spoke in a matter of fact tone as Noah didn't address this, instead asking about something else.
"You know of the Heart of Destiny?"
The Heart of Destiny!
The Treasure that drew in Noah and many others as something that would greatly aid them on their path to becoming a True Emperor so long as they attained it.
"You can go ahead and eat up Loot for .25 Uses."
He spoke out calmly even before Lavalliere requested it as wondrously...
The number was even greater as it seemed the subject involved was too heavy!
Noah's will vibrated with power as he gave his consent, feeling his Expansive Space get a little lighter as he remained firm while listening to Lavalliere.

<First, it seems like the Ancient Races that took refuge in Dimensions are making their moves against the Primordials- with this Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest being a plot targeting the upcoming geniuses that would have the best chance to attain the seat of a True Emperor. What made it possible to draw everyone in while even masking everything is multifactorial, with many components coming into play as one is the Niflheim Dimension, and the other is...the Heart of Destiny.>
WAA!

<Across the Ages, treasures like these have been attained by individuals as among those who took the seat of True Emperors...many had treasures like this. The Heart of Destiny, the Heart of Karma, the Heart of Fate, the Heart of Fortune, and even the theorized to exist but never before seen...the Heart of Reality.>
A grand and shocking session of unveiling secrecy began at this moment with Lavalliere as at the same time, Noah discussed the mysteries of the Aspects of Existence with Dr. Hall!

Dr. Hall felt his very soul buzzing with euphoria as his eyes were bathed by the Essence of the Origin of Nature, this evolvable Edict even making its advancements right now as he was permitted to gaze upon the visage of the Emperor.
"This is just..."

He had been hesitant at first as he gained the knowledge about the intricacies of the Aspects of Existence and exceeding their limitations, and the progression of Cosmos into a Reality through the resonance of one's Aspects of Existence to bring about the Primogenial Strata where one's cerulean liquified soul bathed their body and Origin.

Dr. Hall was astounded by the Royal Cosmos that were larger than his own and many others, their vibrant light being heavy and oppressive as 1 Trillion of them were swirling majestically while their stellar gaps were filled with rivers of condensed golden essence that seemed capable of forging another trillion if not more!
Then there was the Aspect of the Body.
'How is that even possible?!'

Dr. Hall couldn't hide his shock as he saw the body wrapped by many Physiques, but nothing was as vibrant as the tightly coiling tendrils of Dimensional Essence that even with the current stage of Origin of Nature- Dr. Hall still couldn't see through it!
These were the intricate mysteries of the Mythical Natural Born Dream Physique as even a Quasi-TABOO Edict couldn't fully see through its mysteries.
The Aspect of the Body of the Emperor seemed heavy and immovable as a mountain, but the Soul...
HUUUM!
Dr. Hall nearly felt like his eyes were being burnt when he stared as his tear ducts couldn't help but release a few drops.
"Glorious."
This was the only word he could say at this scene.

Adorned in the sleek black suit, Noah's stellar form released wisps of splendor as he also broke down the unique concept of <Origin of Nature> with the Primordial Eye of the Pioneer, gradually learning it for himself as with the relationship he had to his Vassals, there were many ways for him to attain their concepts!

Yet destiny still shone brightly when he stared at the Vassal before him as the path forward wasn't even something he had to actively seek- with his destiny told him this being would illuminate it for him as with the intricacies of Fate, Destiny, Fortune, and Karma- just Noah attaining the Edict of the Origin of Nature could be considered Dr. Hall illuminating Noah's path forward.
But would there be more?
"What do you think?"
Noah's voice shook Dr. Hall out of his stupor as his eyes became those of utter focus.
His essence moved to wrap around the body of his Emperor freely as he isolated the aspects of the Body and Soul as he focused on the Origin.
It had already exceeded the Limits that Dr. Hall and all others would face as it stood at 1 Trillion! It couldn't go any further. It couldn't do anything.

So what solution could there be for this when his Emperor had tried False Grotto Nacres and real ones? When the ridiculous essence of his Reality Passages did nothing? When devouring the realities of others did nothing?
What solution could there be?!
The Essence of the Origin of Nature permeated outwards as countless thoughts crossed Dr. Hall's mind.
Countless possibilities.
Countless paths!
And yet...he shook his head at all of them.
Time passed as he pondered some more.

After some time, the waves of destiny pulsed with anticipation as Dr. Hall found himself unconsciously walking towards the vibrant Tyrannical Emperor, coming to stand right in front of him as his hands uncontrollably rose to land on the stellar chest.
BZZT!

The essence of the Origin of Nature sank into the Tyrannical Emperor as the vibrant Cosmos within his Origin were studied deeply, Dr. Hall's inquisitive gaze checking to see what mysteries and ways he could come up with!
His eyes gradually brightened up as after going through many calculations, he shockingly arrived at one.
It seemed like a solution, and yet at the same time- it seemed like it wasn't!

Dr. Hall breathed out as after an unknown amount of time, he realized he had actually been studying the figure of his Emperor this closely as he moved back, gazing at the being in front of him with difficulty as he spoke his next words very slowly!
"There are no paths to exceed the current limitations based on the foundation you have built.
His golden hair glimmered silently as with slight hesitation, he continued.
"When trying to build an even greater structure..."
BZZZT!
Dr. Hall spoke with a thoughtful expression as his mouth was even trembling while he spoke.
"...you have to destroy the previous one."

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1845
paragraphs: <No.>
, m This was the first thing Noah heard as destiny began to buzz around him with a ferocity he hadn't come across before in his entire life!
Destroy it.

He couldn't continue forward on this path as it had reached its absolute limitations, and he had to destroy it as what could be built after that...was something unique to him as he would decide the Limitations!

<It is dangerous and filled with unknowns. The destruction of one's Origin is death. Even if you get lucky and you truly are someone with a shocking Destiny, whether you succeed or not is like the flip of a coin. Why take such a risk with what you've already achieved?>

A sense of frustration and anger could be felt from Lavalliere as she had seen a path already established and filled with glory, and she didn't want it threatened with many unknowns surrounding a new path!
It couldn't even be considered a path as one didn't even know if there was doom or opportunity at the end of it.
And all this...came even after Lavalliere had explained a little about the object that had pulled so many geniuses into the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest.

The Heart of Destiny, the Heart of Karma, the Heart of Fate, the Heart of Fortune, or even the unverified Heart of Reality. Unheard of treasures that would grant one a shocking sense of power as it was a mystery how and why the Ancient Bloodline Race that owned it would relinquish ownership and use it as a tool to pull in a portion of the geniuses of Pure-Blooded Primordials.
So long as Noah could break into the path of Reality and enter the Primogenial Strata...he might just be capable of withstanding the Legions of millions of LEGENDS!
But even this was merely a possibility as the existences in the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest were too monstrous.

Apart from the Beta Strata LEGENDS that couldn't even be matched, all the Pure-Blooded Primordial Geniuses still faced heavy restrictions all around them as it further reduced their battle power, this entire ordeal truly being unscalable!
"And that is precisely why I seek another path. It is not just for this event...but for myself."
Noah spoke calmly to Lavalliere as when he thought of the idea Dr. Hall had brought up, his heart couldn't help but begin to burn with a radiant light.
He didn't want to be limited by established norms.
He wanted to establish his own norms.
If there were restrictions and norms set by others, he would just break them!
Lavalliere didn't reply as she seemed to be lost in her own thoughts, seeing that her words were not at all getting through to Noah.
In the expansive room inlaid with golden glass walls, Dr. Hall was looking at Noah with a firm gaze as he repeated himself again.
"Destroy not every part of you...but your Origin. If you can redefine your Origin, the limitations of your Body and Soul would follow!"
Yes.
Noah was beginning to understand this freely as he pulled upon the Origin of Nature and its singular skill.

Dr. Hall had truly only specialized in this single Edict, and his edict had further specialized as due to its ridiculous effects- it only held a single skill! It was a concept that truly focused on the extremes as the single skill it held was termed <The Eye of Nature>.

An eye that broke down the fundamental truths and nature of Reality as depending on the rank of its Edict...one might eventually even be able to peer into the Natural Laws of Reality with relative ease! It utilized very few Units of the Essence of Reality and Mana for the utility it provided, but this was what Dr. Hall had brought to fruition by making it so that his concept held no other skills as it only focused on this!
It was a stupendous concept to have risen not from Noah, but a Vassal in his Infinite Reality.
And as the idea cemented itself, Noah used <The Eye of Nature> to view his Aspects of Existence as he saw the interweaving of his Body, Soul, and Origin.

He recalled his Samsara Universal Dao Origin Trait that had the theorized effect of making his Origin to be his Body, with the level of authority of this Trait being superseded by the classification of the Aspects of Existence as the Body and Origin were distinguished separately while Noah cultivated!
But..they were still connected.

Even before resonating them to form a Reality and becoming a LEGEND, one's Aspects of Existence were still connected as in the case of Noah- they were even more closely connected due to abilities like Sanguine Adequation.

If one were to boldly say they would destroy all their Aspects of Existence for the purposes of reforming them, then of course only death awaited them as that was essentially what Noah did when he eradicated his Enemy!
But if he could destroy and reform his Origin...he could define his own limitations.
And since his Origin was connected to his Body and Soul, the Limitations of these aspects would also slowly be refined!
But still...it was the destruction of one's Origin.
An irrevocable action.
Something that might even lead to true death!
"But...it is a glorious path."
Noah nodded as he replied to Dr. Hall whose eyes trembled when he saw the determination of the Tyrannical Emperor.
He even swallowed hard as a thought crossed his mind.
'I didn't just propose an idea that might kill the Emperor, right?'
A dangerous undertaking was brought to fruition as it occupied Noah's mind, millions of thoughts being computed constantly as he planned for it and so many possibilities!
If he did destroy his Cosmic Filament Origin, then what would be the newly built Origin to replace it?
From destruction came rebirth...but what would take the center stage for Noah if not his current Origin?
BZZT!
Destiny buzzed as gloriously, at this same period of time...the Seed of TABOO for the Dictum Emperor bloomed to fruition.
Noah's eyes blazed with a golden light that illuminated everything around him and even caused Dr. Hall to be pushed back, his expression serene as his magnetic voice rang out.
"I see."
He could see the unknown path forward.
It was filled with risk, but as always...there would not be any rewards if one didn't take risks!
And...the answer had actually been there all along.

When his Infinite Reality became a Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, his Modus Operandi was elevated further as due to his Primogenial Casuistic Origin- the Reality he would be able to form when he became a LEGEND was termed <Paramount Kainos Dimensional Reality>.
A Dimensional Reality!
Yet at this moment in time, Noah only held an Origin that had the Aspect of a Reality...and nothing to do with a Dimension!
"Let's change that."
HUUUM!
Essence began to surge and rile up around him as his goal shockingly became...shattering his Primogenial Casuistic Origin.
An Aspect that had broken the limits and reached 1 Trillion Cosmos!
His body illuminated as it rose, Noah going through millions of scenarios in his mind as at this moment, he voiced out two words that were directed to multiple entities.
"Get ready."
WAA!
The words were meant for the Infinite Reality, RUINATION, and Lavalliere.
The words were also meant for the stern Dr. Hall who would be the only other witness to a shocking event.
Lavalliere remained silent amidst all this as inevitably, her Will sighed as she gazed out into the unknown.
Seeds of Reality, False Grotto Nacres, and genuine Grotto Nacres bloomed around Noah as he prepared.

Above the vast skies, 50 dazzling mountainous Infinite Reality Passages appeared as the masses on the expanded blue planet gazed up in utter shock- these stellar multicolored Passages extending out in the vast stars!
The Tyrannical Emperor breathed out as with his gaze becoming more piercing due to the newly elevated Dictum Emperor...he forged forward without so much as a hesitation.
While gazing at the dazzling 1 Trillion Royal Cosmos, he gave out the command.
"Break."

His will was undeniable as when he commanded his own Origin to shatter, the dazzling multicolored Cosmos didn't delay in so much as a second as cracks spread over every single one before an instant later...
CRACK!

But even this was merely a possibility as the existences in the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest were too monstrous.

Apart from the Beta Strata LEGENDS that couldn't even be matched, all the Pure-Blooded Primordial Geniuses still faced heavy restrictions all around them as it further reduced their battle power, this entire ordeal truly being unscalable!
"And that is precisely why I seek another path.
It is not just for this event...but for myself."
Noah spoke calmly to Lavalliere as when he thought of the idea Dr.
Hall had brought up, his heart couldn't help but begin to burn with a radiant light.
He didn't want to be limited by established norms.
He wanted to establish his own norms.
If there were restrictions and norms set by others, he would just break them!
Lavalliere didn't reply as she seemed to be lost in her own thoughts, seeing that her words were not at all getting through to Noah.
In the expansive room inlaid with golden glass walls, Dr.
Hall was looking at Noah with a firm gaze as he repeated himself again.
"Destroy not every part of you...but your Origin.
If you can redefine your Origin, the limitations of your Body and Soul would follow!"
Yes.
Noah was beginning to understand this freely as he pulled upon the Origin of Nature and its singular skill.
Dr.
Hall had truly only specialized in this single Edict, and his edict had further specialized as due to its ridiculous effects- it only held a single skill!
It was a concept that truly focused on the extremes as the single skill it held was termed <The Eye of Nature>.

An eye that broke down the fundamental truths and nature of Reality as depending on the rank of its Edict...one might eventually even be able to peer into the Natural Laws of Reality with relative ease!
It utilized very few Units of the Essence of Reality and Mana for the utility it provided, but this was what Dr.
Hall had brought to fruition by making it so that his concept held no other skills as it only focused on this!
It was a stupendous concept to have risen not from Noah, but a Vassal in his Infinite Reality.
And as the idea cemented itself, Noah used <The Eye of Nature> to view his Aspects of Existence as he saw the interweaving of his Body, Soul, and Origin.

He recalled his Samsara Universal Dao Origin Trait that had the theorized effect of making his Origin to be his Body, with the level of authority of this Trait being superseded by the classification of the Aspects of Existence as the Body and Origin were distinguished separately while Noah cultivated!
But..they were still connected.

Even before resonating them to form a Reality and becoming a LEGEND, one's Aspects of Existence were still connected as in the case of Noah- they were even more closely connected due to abilities like Sanguine Adequation.

If one were to boldly say they would destroy all their Aspects of Existence for the purposes of reforming them, then of course only death awaited them as that was essentially what Noah did when he eradicated his Enemy!
But if he could destroy and reform his Origin...he could define his own limitations.
And since his Origin was connected to his Body and Soul, the Limitations of these aspects would also slowly be refined!
But still...it was the destruction of one's Origin.
An irrevocable action.
Something that might even lead to true death!
"But...it is a glorious path."
Noah nodded as he replied to Dr.
Hall whose eyes trembled when he saw the determination of the Tyrannical Emperor.
He even swallowed hard as a thought crossed his mind.
'I didn't just propose an idea that might kill the Emperor, right?'
A dangerous undertaking was brought to fruition as it occupied Noah's mind, millions of thoughts being computed constantly as he planned for it and so many possibilities!
If he did destroy his Cosmic Filament Origin, then what would be the newly built Origin to replace it?
From destruction came rebirth...but what would take the center stage for Noah if not his current Origin?
BZZT!
Destiny buzzed as gloriously, at this same period of time...the Seed of TABOO for the Dictum Emperor bloomed to fruition.
Noah's eyes blazed with a golden light that illuminated everything around him and even caused Dr.
Hall to be pushed back, his expression serene as his magnetic voice rang out.
"I see."
He could see the unknown path forward.
It was filled with risk, but as always...there would not be any rewards if one didn't take risks!
And...the answer had actually been there all along.

When his Infinite Reality became a Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, his Modus Operandi was elevated further as due to his Primogenial Casuistic Origin- the Reality he would be able to form when he became a LEGEND was termed <Paramount Kainos Dimensional Reality>.
A Dimensional Reality!
Yet at this moment in time, Noah only held an Origin that had the Aspect of a Reality...and nothing to do with a Dimension!
"Let's change that."
HUUUM!
Essence began to surge and rile up around him as his goal shockingly became...shattering his Primogenial Casuistic Origin.
An Aspect that had broken the limits and reached 1 Trillion Cosmos!
His body illuminated as it rose, Noah going through millions of scenarios in his mind as at this moment, he voiced out two words that were directed to multiple entities.
"Get ready."
WAA!
The words were meant for the Infinite Reality, RUINATION, and Lavalliere.
The words were also meant for the stern Dr.
Hall who would be the only other witness to a shocking event.
Lavalliere remained silent amidst all this as inevitably, her Will sighed as she gazed out into the unknown.
Seeds of Reality, False Grotto Nacres, and genuine Grotto Nacres bloomed around Noah as he prepared.

Above the vast skies, 50 dazzling mountainous Infinite Reality Passages appeared as the masses on the expanded blue planet gazed up in utter shock- these stellar multicolored Passages extending out in the vast stars!
The Tyrannical Emperor breathed out as with his gaze becoming more piercing due to the newly elevated Dictum Emperor...he forged forward without so much as a hesitation.
While gazing at the dazzling 1 Trillion Royal Cosmos, he gave out the command.
"Break."

His will was undeniable as when he commanded his own Origin to shatter, the dazzling multicolored Cosmos didn't delay in so much as a second as cracks spread over every single one before an instant later...
CRACK!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1846
paragraphs: A foundation that to other beings, millions of years worth of work would be required in order to forge it.
1 Trillion Royal Cosmos within a vibrant Origin as it was even after a Limit was exceeded!
Even the most astounding geniuses would waver before even thinking about taking on this step, but Noah had taken it with ease.

This was due to his own strong will and mentality...as well as the fact that he hadn't spent millions of years getting where he was today as he didn't form a great level of attachment. Another factor was the wondrous Nomological Edict of the Dictum Emperor reaching TABOO as it allowed Noah to more easily see his path forward, where even with the great level of danger involved...he saw a ridiculously golden possibility that exceeded anything he had come across so far!
So he sent down a command that his Origin obeyed, and 1 Trillion Royal Cosmos buzzed as they began to grow fissure until...
CRACK...BOOOOM!

Every single hard-forged Royal Cosmos burst and exploded into countless shimmering fragments as Noah's figure blew up like a balloon, his stellar visage fading as the only thing left behind were glimmering shards of Royal Cosmos!

The force was so disastrous and shocking that even his Body was nearly ripped apart, but the many Physiques he had forged tightened and held everything together akin to unbreakable ropes as everything was kept in place!

Noah's eyes trembled in a ferocious expression as even he couldn't keep his calm, his very Aspects of Existence being racked with unbearable pain as even someone like him who had gone through millions of years of dreams hadn't come across anything like it.
But even while feeling this tremendous pain...Noah gritted his vibrating teeth as his eyes released beams of luminous light.
It was good that he felt pain!
It meant that even as he shattered one of the very foundations of his life, he was still alive.
But...it didn't seem like it would be this way for much longer.
HUUUM!
After nearly exploding but being contained, his body turned dim as one could see countless shards of shattered Royal Cosmos floating listlessly.
Dr. Hall stared at this scene as the Eye of Nature focused with intensity, his heart trembling as he saw the light within the body of the Emperor dimming!
The destruction of one's origin was equivalent to death- this remained to be true!

But just before he faced true death and utter destruction, Noah had to use his Aspects of Soul and Body that were listlessly seeking for a direction to keep the mere wisps of his Origin alive for him to cause something reality breaking to come to fruition.
For this, he needed a small amount of time...as well as an overabundance of Destiny, Fate, Karma, and Fortune.
The radiant body of the Unnamed Kainos Emperor that was always bright with the luster of stars was turning entirely dim at this moment when his Primogenial Soul mustered its will and called out.
"Flourishing Fate, Flourishing Fortune, Flourishing Karma."
WAA!

The Essence of Reality that was contained in the shattered Origin moved listlessly, the surging rivers of essence coming down from the Infinite Reality Passages inducing them to activity while providing even more essence- this being one of the few sources of light that still illuminated the visage of the Tyrannical Emperor as it allowed shocking abilities to be cast!
"A Touch of Fate, A Touch of Fortune, A Touch of Karma!"

Utter glorious radiance flashed out as while targeting the particular fate of succeeding in forming a new Origin, Noah utilized the capabilities of the Nomological edicts of the Opulent Emperor, Pathfinder, and the Causal Nexus Emperor.
A radiance of white, green, and gold permeated out with vibrant wonder as the shattered remains of his Royal Cosmos began to buzz just slightly.
Slightly.
It wasn't enough!
To defy set laws of reality itself, just this was not enough!
So the Tyrannical Emperor recalled the words of his mother as he called out.
He wasn't alone.
"My people..."
RUUUMBLE!
The area Noah was in trembled as Dr. Hall felt his very Soul tugged upon as a brilliant green line erupted from him and connected to Noah.

He wasn't the only one as across the vast Gourmandizing Infinite Reality, countless existences felt their souls pulled upon as vibrant green strings of karma erupted out- causing countless stellar green lines to shoot out across this vast domain and have it all surge towards Noah!
Karma.
Cause and effect!

It was an abstruse concept that was hard to grasp and much less utilize, and Noah called upon it as even if he couldn't consider himself a complex user of it, he could still call upon the boundless karma his Vassals had incurred with him to push forward the success of what he wanted to do.

Boundless light blazed down on his body that was continuing to dim, the vibrating debris of Royal Cosmos oscillating ever faster at this moment as wondrously, their constant impact with each other caused them to be ground down to glittering stellar dust!
Dust that at this moment began to slowly rotate and converge towards a single point- a center that would be the birth of Noah's new Origin.
But...it was unbearably slow.

The slower it was, the dimmer the fine stellar dust of his past Royal Cosmos became as if it continued at this pace, everything would perish before it could even come together to birth something new from the destruction!
And this was when Noah made one more move.
Something that had granted him a level of confidence when the idea of the destruction of his Origin came to light- it was the wonders of the TABOO Nomological Edict of the Dictum Emperor.
"Author's Viewpoint."
Noah's consciousness buzzed as everything seemingly came to a halt.
His vision changed.

His viewpoint became entirely something else as when his 'eyes' opened, he could see his body and its fading life force even as the stellar dust of his old Cosmos were converging towards one central point!

The authority of TABOO had propelled the authority of Author's Viewpoint to a ridiculous level as depending on what Noah did, the cost could go up to tens of millions of Units of the Essence of Reality.
But right now, he just needed one last piece after utilizing Fate, Karma, and Fortune.
Destiny would seal the deal as before Noah's eyes, a golden scroll unfurled along with an incandescent pen!
As his Tyrannical will watched on, the pen began to move- his voice coming out at the same time as it pulsed with shocking authority.
"I shall write and dictate from here on out..."

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1847
paragraphs: "I shall write and dictate from here on out..."
The Dictum Emperor took on the role of an Author of his own events and progression as the dense Essence of tiny burst out!
<...the residues of Royal Cosmos surged with activity as the glory of Destiny flourished brightly...>
Every stroke took hundreds of thousands of the Essence of Reality, his Infinite Reality Passages gushing down with Essence that was utilized right away as the process flourished.

The stellar dust became bathed with destiny as they converged with rapid speed, everything being sucked in towards one point with shocking haste while the multicolored stellar essence from the Infinite Reality Passages washed down!
But apart from all this...one could also see three distinct seas of light that became more perceptible over time.
It was...the conceptual materialization of his traits that were branded to him.
Protagonist.
Samsara Universal Dao Origin.
Infinite Mana.
These three Traits were currently being anchored in place by his soul as they also came to life at this moment, surging into the point of convergence as the Dictum Emperor continued!
<...The remnants of the old shall act as the foundation of the new, their speed hastening towards a brand new path...>
BZZZT!
At a shocking speed, the glittering stellar dust came together as even though it stemmed from 1 Trillion Royal Cosmos, they were all collected into one central point in the blink of an eye!
A Singularity.
A point of immense and incalculable density appeared as it shone with blinding radiance at this moment.
THUMP!
Then, it began to pulse like a heart.
And a heart needed its nourishment.
After the stellar dust of the Remnant Royal Cosmos formed it, the cluster of essence that had been stored and formed this whole time without having a place to go began to be drawn into it.
But uniquely, it wasn't all types of Essence...but a single essence!
<...Dream Dimensional Essence paves the way forward to establish itself at the very core...>
THUMP!

The point of immeasurably dense mass pulsed as surging sandy waves of golden green essence leaked out from every part of Noah's figure, his Body lighting up at this moment as the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique came to life.

Coils and tendrils of Dream Essence began to rush out from the countless cells that made up his very blood and body, the Dimensional Essence that was placed there before being taken out as pure Dream Essence was the only thing surging in towards the dense golden mass!
Author's Viewpoint remained active as a golden pen continued to write on a golden scroll under the banner of the Dictum Emperor!
<...The very Essence of Reality rushes out next as what shall be formed from the broken Cosmic Filament is not a replication of a Dimension, but also that of a Reality...>
THUMP!
After the golden sandy waves of essence sank in and continued to do so, glimmering multicolored Essence of Reality rushed in next as the golden dense mass shone with a shocking luster!
Yet the Dictum Emperor was not done.
<...and what ties it all together...Mana.>
THUMP!
The golden scroll buzzed and furled itself as Noah couldn't spare any more Units of the Essence of Reality.
Everything from his Reality Passages was being sucked into the dense golden mass that at this moment, boundless waves of cerulean blue Mana surged from the dense golden mass itself!

This was because the conceptual materialization of this Trait was sucked into this Singularity, and boundless waves of Mana were released from it as this...was the force that Noah required to accomplish everything.
As it ballooned out within the dense golden mass, glorious radiance erupted out as with Mana paving the way forward and filling everything...the dense golden mass exploded out.
The Singularity...erupted into boundless specs of light as wondrously its explosive force was contained and controlled.
It expanded out in a circular fashion as the specs of light formed into a dazzling Dimensional Barrier!
THUMP!
A circular Dimensional Barrier that an instant later, layers of vibrant golden sand began to proliferate inside of it as it seemingly formed a floor.

A circular floor of glorious Dimensional Essence all around as it shone with increasing radiance- its fruition causing unknown and unseen fluctuations to erupt from Noah at this moment and spreading out past this location- past the very Infinite Reality itself as they continued outwards into the unknown!
And the moment that this golden floor was formed...
HUUM!
Massive golden Cosmos began to rise from the proliferating golden sand as something fantastical was born.
<The Dream Dimensional Reality Seed has been born.>
Something terrific came to be as its base was a Dimension with features of a Reality, and its uniqueness didn't just end here as there was much more to come!

Its explosive force was contained, but its effects didn't just end there as they racked across Noah's Body and Soul, tendrils of exceedingly condensed golden light beginning to proliferate changes onto his other Aspects of Existence as well!
The destruction and rebirth of the Origin would also go on to affect the Body and Soul.
And so the Dream Dimensional Reality Seed began to pulse with shocking light as its changes only just began!
This was his Origin.
This was...
"My own path..."
HUUM!
His very own established path!
And he went even further as his domineering will moved, setting certain parameters that would unfold into pure wonders!
The moment he chose to destroy his Origin, his destiny had illuminated a shocking path forward as he moved to achieve it.
It was a path that he wanted to walk on his own as he didn't want to rely on the definitions of others.
He didn't want to be restricted by the progression of Cosmos to Reality, and then from Reality to what...Grotto Haven?!
No.
He would have an even more glorious path.
<The Realm Progression of the Unnamed Kainos Emperor has been defined.>
<After the budding of the Dream Dimensional Reality Seed, the Paramount Kainos Dream Dimensional Reality shall be born.>
WAA!

<When the Paramount Kainos Dream Dimensional Reality has reached sufficient saturation and growth, a second Dimensional Reality Seed shall be born as the type of Dimension to be established can be chosen and applied.>
<The pathway of the Unnamed Kainos Emperor has been defined up to the attainment of 9 unique Paramount Kainos Dimensional Realities.>
His pathway was defined like so!

Not from Cosmos to Reality to Grotto Haven- with him destroying his Cosmos and planning to form a Paramount Kainos Dream Dimensional Reality for his first layer of progression, and he established 9 Layers to go through as he wanted to mimic the 9 Dimensions out there!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1848
paragraphs: A foundation that consisted of 9 Dimensions!

It was a daring and profound path as to accomplish it all would be undoubtedly nigh impossible, with him needing to freely use and attain the Essence of Dimensions as freely as the Dream Dimension to establish the Second Layer of his Realm up to the Ninth Layer.
Up until he held 9 Dimensional Realities under his Origin!!!
His thoughts were wild, but the rewards to come were even wilder as the prompts were just beginning to come down.
<You have taken a non-established path that goes against the very Natural Laws of Reality.>
<The resources required to advance through your path are innumerable.>
<You have attained the Absolute Empyral Passive Skill- [Resonance of Nature]>
<You have attained the Absolute Empyral Passive Skill- [Tyrannical Conquest of the Self]>

Absolute Empyral Passive Skills!

<Resonance of Nature>:: Due to your unique flourishing Origin that is a perfect harmony of the Aspects of a Dimension and Reality, you can more easily become in tune with the nature of space around you. The Natural Laws of Reality become easier for you to grasp over time as the Decretum of a Dimension becomes perceptible to you and gradually becomes easier to grasp. Each Dimension has a single Decretum that is followed, and learning the ways to influence and utilize a Decretum will grant one qualification of ownership for the vast Domains of a Dimension...

<Tyrannical Conquest of the Self>:: You have transcended your very limits and conquered your past self, this passive ability allowing for you to break even more established realities relating to you and all the concepts around you. As a Pioneer of your own path, this passive ability will direct you towards the optimum possibilities and paths forward as you forge something unique to you that no others can claim...
THUMP!
The beat of his heart was clear.

With every beat, he felt as if a circular wave of authority erupted with him at the center...and this wave of authority resonated with his surroundings as an even denser wave of unknown authorities and wonders rushed back to him
THUMP!
His mind felt vibrant and clearer soon after as the composition of space and time around him became pristinely clear!

Weaving within them and unseen to his eyes were thick tendrils of gray light that interleaved over everything, but he couldn't fully grasp or even hold on to them as they faded as quickly as they appeared!
This unreachable sense of authority...were the Natural Laws of Reality.
And ever so subtly, Noah could more easily begin to grasp them as on top of this was something termed <Decretum of a Dimension>!
THUMP!
Noah's body felt the wondrous sense of Resonance as every part of him felt connected and vibrant, all the processes occurring within his body becoming ever faster through <Resonance of Nature>.
This wasn't to even mentioned the wonders of the <Tyrannical Conquest of the Self> as Noah brought himself to focus on the profound and ever faster changes blooming within him.

Noah felt his very being beginning to bubble with ridiculous power as the authority of <Resonance of Nature> descended, his Dream Dimensional Reality Seed beginning to surge profusely as vibrant golden Cosmos filled with Dream Essence bloomed.
<The Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos have begun to proliferate within your Origin.>
<The unique Dream Dimensional Essence of your Origin surges to your Soul and Body as they begin a transformation.>

Prompts of utter grandeur rose before Noah's eyes as within his Origin, dense and extremely massive golden Cosmos formed from the sandy golden essence on the circular floor of his Origin- these cosmos being dazzling and blazing with power as they seemed tens of times larger than Royal Cosmos!

This scene was reflected in the eyes of a single being- a being whose soul was also vibrating and shaking as his already ridiculous Nomological Edict of the Origin of Nature was able to see the destruction and formation of a one of a kind of Origin.
It was something unbelievable to come across as if it had been anyone else in the Infinite Reality, they wouldn't have even been able to understand what they saw.
But Dr. Hall uniquely had the qualifications!

He watched the birth of the Dream Dimensional Reality Seed as he saw the ridiculously oversized cosmos begin to form, his eyes locked onto it all as he barely noticed that at this moment- Infinitely small wisps of the Natural Laws of Reality began to surge towards him.
It was a surreal and impossible situation that was only made possible due to what Noah had done- due to the shocking birth of the Dream Dimensional Reality Seed!

Under the gaze and scrutiny of the Eye of Nature from two different beings watched as within seconds, millions of massive golden Cosmos were slowly forged as Noah's body was continuously bugging with more and more power.

The formation of a single one of these Cosmos was so great that with a mere few million formed, nearly half of the conserved essence Noah had spread throughout his body from the Nourishment of his Infinite Reality Passages and much more was already eaten up.
The cost to build a single Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos was ridiculous as its boons had to be astounding!
Outside of Noah's body, the Seeds of Reality, False Grotto Nacres, and Genuine Grotto Nacres began to shine as Noah's will called upon them and pulled them towards his body.
At the same time, his Body and Soul which were undergoing transformations due to the Dream Dimensional Reality Seed began to buzz with activity.
<The Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique continues its 11th Cycle of Refinement.>

paragraphs: Destiny flourished gloriously as the shackles that had bound him...what was termed Absolute Shackles that couldn't be exceeded after one already exceeded the Limits once...Noah ripped all these apart as the source was his new Origin!

His Body and Soul were transforming into something wondrous as their past barriers faded, Noah's body once more having the space to continue refining his shocking Physiques as this...would also pave way for an even larger number of Infinite Realities Passages.
And at this moment, it wasn't just the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique that was undergoing refinement.

When Noah had finished his 10th Cycle and unlocked this physique, he was given the chance to refine all these other Physiques once more as he actually couldn't do this because his Body had reached the 'Absolute Limit' at that point!
Now, as his very self resonated with the surrounding nature as his Body and Soul underwent shocking transformations due to his Origin...all these Physiques were free to move once more.

The Burgeoning Limit Breaking Extreme Physique, the Chassis, Relegator, Arcadian, Mana...boundless ecritures of these Physiques colorfully surrounded Noah's body as he illuminated everything around him.

The changes occurring were too profound as they would take some time in the area covered by the authority of the Dimensional Holy Land while in the outside Realities and in the tense situation in the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest...barely an instant had even passed!
Lavalliere was utterly silent as she watched the profoundly shocking changes occurring around Noah.

He had managed to do what everyone would consider the impossible as when she gazed at it, she would normally brush it off and merely tell him that she stood corrected...but she couldn't do that at this moment.
Yes, she was wrong. But she truly wished she hadn't been proven wrong. She wished Noah hadn't even attempted this dangerous risk even though it now seemed to bloom into a terrific opportunity!
The 9 Dimensions and the vast Realities were separate...and yet interconnected in intricate ways.
There were heavy restrictions on the 9 Dimensions for a reason.
Existences across the vast Realities went into the 9 Dimensions to establish Hegemony for a reason!
The existence who had ended the Last Era by doing what he did...part of the reasons were the existence of the 9 Dimensions!
Thus, there were many intricacies to be mindful of when one did anything that linked itself with the 9 Dimensions.
For Noah to have his future Reality be included with the Dream Dimension was already a serious enough matter.
For Noah's Infinite Reality to have the capability to devour the Lands of Dimensions was already dreadful enough!
But for him to replicate the concept of 9 Dimensions for his Realms of Progression?
This was a path of no return.
It would undoubtedly draw...them.
And it would draw them in with certainty- the existences that these barren lands could not compare to.
Lavalliere felt like sighing but at the same time, she couldn't even bring herself to.
She remained silent.
Even with her breadth and knowledge of history, she did not know how all of this would play out.

The Chains of Karma, Fate, Fortune, and Destiny bound her tightly as when she felt these chains that seemed to be her deadliest enemies and her closest friends, she felt a sense of comfort as she only watched on.
Noah's Realm of Progression...was much different and distinct from the norms of Cosmic Filament Realm to Reality and then to Grotto Haven.

This concept rose within his mind as he watched the flourishing Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos be born in his Origin, his Body and Soul that were undergoing somewhat less profound Transformations proceeding smoothly as new prompts were bound to rise soon.
But there were many wonders and questions for his new Realm of Progression.
He didn't even know what stage he would be comparable to when he finished fully forging his First Layer- the Paramount Kainos Dream Dimensional Reality!
What would his Third fully forged Paramount Kainos Dimensional Reality be equivalent to? Alpha Strata? Above Alpha?
Everything one knew was turned upside down as he had to find the correlation between the stages of his Realm of Progression to the common Realms of Progression of Reality.

This was because intricate questions like him forging his Second Paramount Kainos Dimensional Reality would mean he held two Dimensional Realities...would that classify him among the ridiculous powerful existences in the Grotto Haven stage that was above all 4 Stratas of Reality? The answer was of course, no!
He couldn't define his stage of Progression with the meaning of everyone else.
He had to study.
He had to learn!
He had to understand this new path he had set himself on closely as what it came with...was boundless glory.

As his False Grotto Nacres and genuine Grotto Nacres burned along with Seeds of Reality and the flourishing Dream Essence and other sorts of Essence from the Infinite Reality Passages came down, his Origin was budding more and more Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos as it reached a sufficient point with 100 Billion of these glimmering Cosmos formed...and prompts rose when this point was slowly passed.
Mind you...Noah had only reached 100 Billion Cosmos while absorbing a portion of the Quintupled Nacres and Seeds of Reality when in the past- he had already formed 1,000 Billion Cosmos!
But the new Origin required so many more resources to move even a single step as the Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos were simply too dreadful.
Their description was still being formed as Noah studied their birth and wonders, but their boosts overall when looking at Noah's new Origin displayed themselves at this moment.
<Your Reserves of the Essence of Reality have been elevated to the Maximum of 5 Million.>
<All your sources of Essences are undergoing Complete Refinement as they can soon be utilized to nurture selected abilities to become REIFIED.>
<Your Dream Dimensional Reality Seed grants a base boost of 5,000 True Dimensional Dream Damage Values to all abilities.>
<Your Affinity to the Natural Laws of Reality has risen greatly.>
<Your Affinity to the Natural Laws of Reality has risen greatly!>
That wasn't a grammatical mistake where two sentences were repeated twice.

The prompts came down one after another as rivers of the Essence of Reality were lovingly rushing towards Noah, this paradoxical relationship continuing where the more one broke the natural laws and exceeded limitations...the more Affinity they attained to the Natural Laws of Reality!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1850
paragraphs: Two prompts about Noah greatly increasing his Affinity to the Natural Laws of Reality came as this wasn't all!
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age has risen greatly.>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age has risen greatly.>
It was just the shocking tip of the iceberg as Noah's ecritures around his crown burned with sandy gold flames, shocking radiance erupting out as too many changes bloomed.
First was the ridiculous reality of his doubling of the maximum Reserves of the Essence of Reality, and then there was the base 5,000 True Dimensional Dream Damage and Defense Values boost!

This was much more than double the base Values that he had prior to this, with the aim of reaching the golden number of 100 million Damage Values of Peak Primogenial Strata LEGENDS...being in the grasp of Noah's hands when he laid out his strongest attacks and forms.
This...was just from the proliferation of the Dream Dimensional Reality Seed.

He had yet to even form his first layer and establish a genuine Dimensional Reality from this Seed as the changes that would occur then...would the untouchable Beta Strata with its oppression be that unreachable?
Would Noah who wasn't even following the Realms of Progression of all other beings even face the oppression of stages?!
Too many thoughts and questions buzzed as Noah's eyes landed on his crown.

The vibrant words of <ETHEREAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR> floated serenely as brilliantly sandy gold flames blazed around them, the crown washing down sparkling lights of authority as Noah had attained a full distinction and title for himself.
Where would the authority of the Kainos Emperor cluster in next? What would it do?
The answer didn't take long to show itself as the feat Noah has achieved was too great this time around.
In terms of distinguishing himself...he could be considered to have exceeded any possible peers with his actions!
And the authority he gained was astounding as it now showed exactly what came after a vibrant solidified throne with one's distinction.
BZZZT!
The floating multicolored crown above Noah's head wondrously rose up even higher, and it then shockingly began to move behind him as it fixed itself into place a few meters away!
Thereafter, it blazed with golden light as if it was anchored to a new space.

The immense waves of authority that Noah had attained then weaved in a wondrous way as Noah's will saw one twinkling glow of lights appear near and below the anchored crown behind him as this crown retained the very peak spot!
Twinkling glow of lights that specifically anchored themselves into different positions that when one looked at it...they could see that these lights were forming the backbone of....
"A Throne..."

The boundless Kainos authority surging out formed points of light that formed the backbone and structure of a fantastical throne- a Throne that would require immense achievements to complete in the future as at this moment in time, Noah had already begun forming its backbone!
And the point at the very peak of this unfinished throne...was a glimmering crown that swirled with <ETHEREAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR>.
It was a wondrous sight to see.

So wondrous when one realized that all the beings that Noah had come across so far had not displayed this level of Authority- even the 4 terrifying Alpha Strata LEGENDS outside of the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest did not show it as all 4 merely had <EMPEROR>!

<Surpassing the distinction of a crown and into a throne is nearly impossible for those with a single ecriture, their achievements required being too enormous as many rarely achieve it. Someone like you with triple ecritures on your crown had a guaranteed chance of forming the authority of the Throne...but not this quickly, and not with such progress.>
Lavalliere spoke to Noah in a calm and mild tone compared to always as this was the first time she spoke to him after she advised him not to do what he did.
She didn't mention anything about Noah's ongoing breakthrough as Noah didn't bring it up either!
He knew that with what he was currently doing, there were unseen mysteries behind it all as they would propel shocking events in the future.
But he still did it as he expected to shoulder whatever else was coming due to this glorious path.

<Continuing to form the structure of the Throne will be even harder as taking the authorities of existences with mere solidified crowns or one or two-word ecritures are negligible, since eradicating them isn't really an astounding feat for you to achieve.>
Lavalliere finished her words as Noah gave a light nod, gazing at the backbone of the Throne that had gained a few points of lights on as his body surged with majestic waves of essence once more.
<Your Primogenial Strata Soul was affected by the authority of the Dream Dimensional Reality Seed, mutating to become a Dimensional Soul Sea.>
<The strength of your soul has exceeded its shackles as the Maximum number of Ascendancy Halos has been raised from 30 to 60.>
WAA!
Noah's thoughts buzzed with wildness as his Soul was the first to experience the transformation!
From a Primogenial Strata Soul and into a Dimensional Soul Sea, what should have been a blue liquefied mass turned into the grandeur of gold as his very being was illuminated by a celestial glow.

A Sea dense with the authority of the Soul raged as it coiled with Dimensional Essence, its waves raging and constantly expanding as the breadth that Noah could reach far exceeded the Primogenial Soul!
The power he could wield and the level of concepts that he could withstand had vastly increased as Noah felt like he could take in hundreds of TABOO concepts with ease when he had such a soul.
And that wasn't all that changed with his soul becoming a Dimensional Soul Sea.
<You can now alter Dimensional Damage Values to become Dimensional Soul Damage Values.>
Soul Damage.
The most abstruse type of Damage that existences could barely grasp or defend against...and Noah could now utilize a unique type of Dimensional Soul Damage!
It was bolstering his strength greatly as soon after, the last aspect of his Existence took a step forward.
<Your Primogenial Strata Body was affected by the authority of the Dream Dimensional Reality Seed, mutating to become a Dream Dimensional Body>
<An Innate Dimensional Barrier equivalent to the True Dimensional Defense Values achievable in your strongest form wraps around you.>
HUUM!

A shimmering golden layer of light painted his skin as he seemed like a celestial king of a forgotten era, his eyes opening to release luminous rays of light as he gazed at himself and what he had just attained in preparation for surviving Legions of Primogenial and Beta Strata LEGENDS!
A Dream Dimensional Reality Seed that was waiting to bloom into a Paramount Kainos Dream Dimensional Reality.
A Dream Dimensional Sea.
A Dream Dimensional Body!

His three Aspects of Existence had turned to become pure wonders after these actions as the moment Noah saturated his new Origin and strengthened the Soul and Body to the Limit...he would resonate them to achieve the First Layer- the First Dimension!
Thereafter...what could his enemies do but despair?!
<Your Dream Dimensional Reality Seed grants a base boost of 5,000 True Dimensional Dream Damage Values to all abilities.> Corrected to <...5,000 True Dimensional Dream Damage AND Defense Values>

Lavalliere spoke to Noah in a calm and mild tone compared to always as this was the first time she spoke to him after she advised him not to do what he did.
She didn't mention anything about Noah's ongoing breakthrough as Noah didn't bring it up either!
He knew that with what he was currently doing, there were unseen mysteries behind it all as they would propel shocking events in the future.
But he still did it as he expected to shoulder whatever else was coming due to this glorious path.

<Continuing to form the structure of the Throne will be even harder as taking the authorities of existences with mere solidified crowns or one or two-word ecritures are negligible, since eradicating them isn't really an astounding feat for you to achieve.>
Lavalliere finished her words as Noah gave a light nod, gazing at the backbone of the Throne that had gained a few points of lights on as his body surged with majestic waves of essence once more.
<Your Primogenial Strata Soul was affected by the authority of the Dream Dimensional Reality Seed, mutating to become a Dimensional Soul Sea.>
<The strength of your soul has exceeded its shackles as the Maximum number of Ascendancy Halos has been raised from 30 to 60.>
WAA!
Noah's thoughts buzzed with wildness as his Soul was the first to experience the transformation!
From a Primogenial Strata Soul and into a Dimensional Soul Sea, what should have been a blue liquefied mass turned into the grandeur of gold as his very being was illuminated by a celestial glow.

A Sea dense with the authority of the Soul raged as it coiled with Dimensional Essence, its waves raging and constantly expanding as the breadth that Noah could reach far exceeded the Primogenial Soul!
The power he could wield and the level of concepts that he could withstand had vastly increased as Noah felt like he could take in hundreds of TABOO concepts with ease when he had such a soul.
And that wasn't all that changed with his soul becoming a Dimensional Soul Sea.
<You can now alter Dimensional Damage Values to become Dimensional Soul Damage Values.>
Soul Damage.
The most abstruse type of Damage that existences could barely grasp or defend against...and Noah could now utilize a unique type of Dimensional Soul Damage!
It was bolstering his strength greatly as soon after, the last aspect of his Existence took a step forward.
<Your Primogenial Strata Body was affected by the authority of the Dream Dimensional Reality Seed, mutating to become a Dream Dimensional Body>
<An Innate Dimensional Barrier equivalent to the True Dimensional Defense Values achievable in your strongest form wraps around you.>
HUUM!

A shimmering golden layer of light painted his skin as he seemed like a celestial king of a forgotten era, his eyes opening to release luminous rays of light as he gazed at himself and what he had just attained in preparation for surviving Legions of Primogenial and Beta Strata LEGENDS!
A Dream Dimensional Reality Seed that was waiting to bloom into a Paramount Kainos Dream Dimensional Reality.
A Dream Dimensional Sea.
A Dream Dimensional Body!

His three Aspects of Existence had turned to become pure wonders after these actions as the moment Noah saturated his new Origin and strengthened the Soul and Body to the Limit...he would resonate them to achieve the First Layer- the First Dimension!
Thereafter...what could his enemies do but despair?!
<Your Dream Dimensional Reality Seed grants a base boost of 5,000 True Dimensional Dream Damage Values to all abilities.> Corrected to <...5,000 True Dimensional Dream Damage AND Defense Values>

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1851
paragraphs: In a region of the past Blue Planet, Noah floated serenely while Dr. Hall was blessed with the sight of his transformation- the single concept this being owned guaranteed to go through a change soon enough as he was among those who gained greatly from today's actions!
As for Noah's current state...

His past purple-blue stellar luster had faded as his body carried an astonishingly denser golden color, the Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos in his body caused one to see him as a stellar existence whose body was made up of countless golden blue astral bodies.
His strands of hair alone carried astonishing valiance and power as his eyes were akin to luminous jewels of stellar clusters!

False Grotto Nacres and genuine Grotto Nacres were being swallowed along with Seeds of Reality as billions of these ridiculous Cosmos were being forged constantly, Noah seeing how much more loot he had to get as building even a single one of the Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos seemed to cost him immeasurably more essence and loot compared to his past Origin.
Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos!
Noah's terrifying will focused on these radiant stellar wonders filled with Dream Essence as their description finally came.

<Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos>:: The integral components of a Dream Dimensional Reality Seed that will spark the resonance to form a Paramount Kainos Dream Dimensional Reality when a sufficient number is reached. Being ten times as vast as Normal Cosmos, they carry 50 times as much power. The Haki of the Emperor has already permeated through them as they allow the Origin to release a sense of Realm Oppression against weaker Origins. Currently considered weak Origins: Primogenial Strata and below...
Wondrous and astounding Cosmos- these were the stellar bodies Noah had to forge in the hundreds of billions!
They made it so that the Primogenial Origins of LEGENDS...were considered weaker as they would face a Realm Oppression.
Since it didn't have clear quantification, Noah had to figure out exactly what this oppression would entail...but the arduous task of forging these Cosmos with droves of loot still remained!
"But there is always a way forward..."
Noah's jewel-like eyes blazed with light as he thought of the millions of LEGENDS in the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest.
That right there was boundless loot.

He had to have the strength to take it...but all those existences and him using any of the 3 chances to bring to light Resplendent Treasure Caches should give him all he needed to fully saturate his Dream Dimensional Soul Sea, Dream Dimensional Body, and Dream Dimensional Reality Seed!

Thereafter, he would resonate his Aspects of Existence and proceed forward as he wondered just who he could rival in the Stratas of Reality, and exactly what layer he had to reach to match existences who had formed multiple Realities- those at the Grotto Haven stage!
He had many things along the way apart from Loot to get him there.

As he thought of this, Noah gazed above him where at this moment, the 51st and 52nd Infinite Reality Passages formed sequentially and with utter ease- 2 Million Units of the Essence of Reality being burnt up to make it happen as his Physiques finished their refinement.
Particularly the Cycles of one Physique that continued to show its wonders!
<The Eleventh Cycle of the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique has been completed.>

<More Runic Ecritures of DREAM begin to surround you as the completion of the 11th Cycle Increases your Maximum Reserves of Dream Essence to 550,000,000. The current DREAM Ecritures allow for the passive daily generation of 275,000,000 Units of Dream Essence.>
<The Maximum Number of Reality Passages your body can hold has been raised to 520.>

His body buzzed with arcs of golden dream essence as the Mana Physique and all others also went towards their completion, his strengths steadily rising as now...he only needed a stage to measure himself.
How drastically would his strength increase be with 60 Innate Ascendancy Halos and 10 artificial ones? With his three Aspects of Existence that each held the terrifying aspect of a Dimension?!
As a second was about to pass outside the Infinite Reality, he would soon know.

At the same time as Noah forged forward with his body slowly building up Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos, the figure of a crimson existence bathed with ecritures of gold stared at dazzling natural treasures that vibrated with the Essence of the Mirror Dimension.

It was the visage of RUINATION who at this moment in time waved her hands, causing the many dazzling stellites stemming from a Dimension to swirl around her- and this wasn't the only thing as near her, one could also see a resplendent bone.

A bone that Noah had attained in a Forgotten Reality that had traces of Commander Feng- it was the Kun Peng's Bone that could be utilized during the forging of Relics, and it was now under the control of a Relic that wished to upgrade itself even without bothering her master!
Aside from this, one could also see the TABOO Interchangeable Dimensional Material that shone with a deathly crystalline glow floating around RUINATION.
Her gaze was firm and filled with longing as she felt like she would be left behind if she did not exceed everything about herself.
So...
HOONG!

Crimson gold flames from her very core erupted as they began to burn the materials around her, the Dimensional Essence from three Dimensions shockingly prevalent here as there were also the dense seas of Dream Essence in the surroundings that were also pulled in!
Past many folds of spacetime continuum, in the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest.
Barely a second was about to pass after the Heart of Destiny had descended and erased away all falsehoods.
The gray mist was first as the wall blocking the two sides was next, and what came after that was the unveiling of everything else!
This...included the authority of the Emperors who hid their authority.
The luminescent light of the Heart of Destiny descended.
The surroundings of a few beings like Akaris and Ezekiel buzzed as many eyes landed towards them, but these beings were not even paying attention to themselves.
Their eyes...were actually on another being entirely!
