bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1852
paragraphs: When the dazzling star that represented the Heart of Destiny descended, many veils were torn down!
Part of these veils...were the authorities of Emperors.
Many weren't hiding their authority or didn't even have the capability to, but a few beings had their authority placed under a veil!
The forefront was the visage of Akaris.
With her pairs of wings even on her feet, her body glimmered with authority as above her head, no crown could still be seen.

Instead, it was further behind her as it took the highest point of a construct that still couldn't be made out- mostly due to the fact that one could only see two points of lights to the left and right of the spinning crown behind her!
A spinning crown that held ecritures much different compared to what everyone else held...it was a wondrous and vibrant <SHIELD OF DAWN>.
The allure of incandescent gold surrounded it as it didn't state anything about the distinction of an Emperor.
It was instead something as abstruse as <SHIELD OF DAWN> spinning around her!

And others might not know the meaning of why her crown was behind her, but those more knowledgeable realized that even though only two points of light existed- she had somehow already begun working on the authority of her Throne!
What did she do...to be able to bring this to fruition? Why did the ecritures around her crown read like so?!
There were many questions, but no time for answers as she wasn't the only one that the eyes of many terrifying beings glanced over when authorities were unveiled.

Another being was in the far back among the throngs of Pure-Blooded Primordials, but the grandeur revealed from him was astounding as even the visage of Nefertiti that was beside him gazed up in shock.
<AEQUITAS DIMENSIONAL E>
Surrounded by waves of pristine purple light, it was a Three Word Distinction.
An existence with the distinction of an Emperor!
One who regularly just showed a solidified crown with no ecritures above his head!
As his authority was revealed, he seemed unphased as his eyes now revealed regal purple light, gazing towards a location that many eyes were locked onto at this moment.
Because even as he and Akaris had their shocking authorities revealed, all eyes weren't on them.
They were on a being that floated close to the transparent barrier that had begun to thin.
The one being that stole the show.

His dark hair shone with scintillating light as no crown could be seen above it- its grandeur actually moved back as it floated at the highest point of a backbone of a throne that had many more points of light than the one Akaris adorned!
The ecritures that dazzled the eyes of all beings flowed serenely and with shocking dominance.
<ETHEREAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR>.
With glory and majesty, this distinction revealed itself as it seemed to vibrate with regality, giving off a tremendous sense of pressure that forces others to look down before its visage!

But the eyes of the even more perceptive beings were vibrating with shock and disbelief as milliseconds before this, they could have sworn they had only seen <ETHEREAL DIMENSIO EMPEROR> as milliseconds later, the vibrant ecritures had filled up before the points of light that showed a hazy backbone of a Throne formed!
What did this mean?
That this being had done something to cause a blooming of authority that completed his distinction and also began to form the backbone of a throne?!
It was unbelievable.
It was incomprehensible!
The eyes of Ezekiel released bright regal purple luster as he locked onto Noah.
The bleeding figure of Emperor Aegon trembled as his mind couldn't even form coherent thoughts!
Katelyn's silver glazed eyes constricted as she realized this being she had been with recently still had too many layers that she didn't even imagine.

Off in the distance, the visage of Genevieve developed a stern expression, but her eyes held a trace of dauntlessness as she gazed from Noah and to the stretches of lands that held Beta Strata Commanders and Primogenial Strata LEGENDS, her thoughts wild and unknown!

Too many beings focused on the visage of the ETHEREAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR at this moment as the eyes of Beta Strata LEGENDS burned with a domineering light on the other side of the barrier, a being situated on a dazzling throne while surrounded by magisterial Kun Peng Beta Strata LEGENDS also turning his gaze in his direction once more.
When the Kun Peng upon the Throne saw Noah's vibrant authority, he actually rose up from the incandescent throne and smiled.
Smiled!
This was because his purpose here was a cluster of many ideals, but one of the central ones was to erase truly powerful genius Primordials.
An existence at the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy who had already begun the backbone of his throne and one more who had just begun...it was more than what he could have hoped for.
One thing to note was that even as this being saw this...he did not turn fearful.

After rising a little akin to show recognition and a sense of respect, he sat back down as an instant later, the Legions of Millions of LEGENDS around him buzzed as a terrifying pressure began to emanate from them!
The Heart of Destiny had descended as all falsehoods were unveiled, and this included the thin transparent barrier that was now fading.
When it was entirely gone, a bloody massacre would begin.

But without even understanding the shocking authorities that some Pure-Blooded Primordials released from their side, most of the Primordials still faced despair in their hearts as even if there were a few astounding geniuses...weren't they still in the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy?
How could they withstand millions of Primogenial Strata LEGENDS? Or the terrifying races of Beta Strata LEGENDS that led them?
Their despair was further cemented when they gazed at their destinies...they saw them getting immeasurably dark.

Yet amidst all this despair, the existence that had talked to Alpha Strata LEGENDS as if they were equals rose ever higher as her luminous eyes were pulled away from Noah once more- going towards the far away existence across the thinning barrier as she spoke.
"I chose to come here due to the pull of the Heart of Destiny, even though I foresaw a 20% chance of survival and Fortune."
WAA!

Her pairs of wings began to burn with golden light as shockingly, space ruptured as the Essence of Reality itself began to be drawn towards her body...and started to form an incandescent set of multicolored armor!
"I had confidence even with that 20%...but due to certain unexpected factors..."
Her gaze passed over the astounding visages of Ezekiel and Noah who was gazing at the millions of LEGENDS with a profound and undiscernible gaze as she nodded with even more wonder.
"This percentage is increasing."
With an 80% chance of failure and death, this being had stepped into the unknown that now held Millions of LEGENDS.
Just...what power did she have to rely on that when she gazed at the endless enemies around them, she didn't fear for her life?!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1853
paragraphs: Noah's will was moving and computing things at shocking speeds as the situation continued to unfold before him.
The authority above Ezekiel and Akaris.
The possibilities for this battle.
Everything played before his eyes as his Main Body in the bounds of the authority of the Dimensional Holy Land finished the preparations!

Apart from the continuing process of finishing the refinement of multiple Physiques and forging of the Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos, there was the adaptation to the TABOO authority of the Dictum Emperor.
Noah's will quickly perused through its wonders that he would utilize from here on out as he pulled up its prompts.
<The Quasi-VENERABLE Ancient Bloodline of the Celestial Grimoire has been unearthed by the Dictum Emperor.>
<The Authority of Author's Viewpoint has been greatly increased.>
<The abstruse mysteries of Destiny become ever so clear to your eyes.>
Two simple unlocking and elevation of concepts!
Author's Viewpoint he had already utilized its expanded authority as it aided Noah in forming his Dream Dimensional Reality Seed.
Then there was the newly unlocked Quasi-Venerable Tier Bloodline.
Celestial Grimoire!
It was a racial Bloodline that had many mysteries, with its abilities being entirely based on the destiny of the existence as Noah saw a particularly terrifying skill amongst its capabilities.

<Recorder of History>:: The Celestial Grimoires were known for being the keepers of history as everything that occurred around them was recorded to the smallest details. When they were sufficiently powerful enough, they could even record the thoughts and memories of those around them. The cost of this ability can vary depending on the usage, with history being written down passively without any cost while peering to obtain the history of others will cost depending on the power of the target...
Recorder of History! Its uniqueness was very similar to other usages of Author's Viewpoint, but it was much more straightforward and with its own intricacies.
So Noah went forward to understand it!
While his Main Body underwent its shocking changes, a True Sanguine Clone in the Dimensional Holy Land called upon the form of the Celestial Grimoire.
SHIING!
Amidst the forming seas of Dimensional Essence, rays of golden light weaved from Noah's body as he gradually changed.
From the humanoid appearance, his body unfurled in size and became even larger as he covered the golden skies with a titanic form- a form of an ancient looking black and gold book!

It's four edges held sharp corners shining in gold while an enormous clasp held it closed, with a pair of black and gold wings erupted from the back of this Grimoire as it released a unique atmosphere that Noah hadn't formed before.

His will and aura vibrantly surged as the enormous clasp on him opened, the Celestial Grimoire opening at this moment to show variations of white and gold pages as vibrant waves of destiny surrounded it.
While unfurled, Noah's will surged as he focused on History.
Not the current history of this location, but the History of an existence he was looking at in the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest!
From the eyes of Alexander, Noah silently tugged upon the wisps of Destiny as clear gold words began to bloom on his pages.

The Essence of Reality and Dream Dimensional Essence could be seen dancing atop the Celestial Grimoire as they were about to make the shocking actions viable- with Noah having dense reserves of them at this moment as it allowed him to pay the high cost due to the target he selected!
The existence sitting amongst the throngs of Primogenial and Beta Strata LEGENDS.
HUUM!
<...The thin barrier of light distinctly began to fall...>
The thin barrier of light distinctly began to fall.
On the other side of this barrier, surrounded by Millions of LEGENDS that formed Legions from many Races- an existence sat on a blinding red and gold throne of flames.

The majestic forms of many Kun Peng surrounded him as his crown glimmered with the ecritures of <INTERNUNCIO EMPEROR> as Dimensional Essence surrounded them...and yet this being wasn't a three-word Emperor with the distinction of <DIMENSIONAL>!
Yet when he gazed at the Pure-Blooded Primordial Geniuses and the terrifying distinction of a few in particular...he couldn't help but have his eyes release an astounding flash of destiny.
He was surrounded by multiple Beta Strata LEGENDS who led their Legions, and yet his aura was no less than theirs while he still remained at the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy.
Why was this?
For one to understand this, they had to understand the existence situated upon the crimson gold throne of flames.
His aura and might were powerful to the extent that the level of danger was no less than Beta Strata LEGENDS...because he bore a great weight!
He was Valdez Tepez, the INTERNUNCIO EMPEROR- and he shouldered a glorious purpose.
As he saw the fading transparent barrier of light that had veiled the dangers waiting for the Pure-Blooded Primordial Geniuses until they had arrived here, his hand raised.
HUUUM!
The many Legions of LEGENDS buzzed with power and might as his hand was akin to a signal, waiting for it to thunder down as this would commence the slaughter!
With his hand raised, the golden glint of the Heart of Destiny flashed in his eyes as a memory played in his heart.
It was a memory from an immeasurably far away land- in the depths of the Niflheim Dimension.

Glacial mountains rose across the skies as cerulean stormy rivers ran below, the Domain of their Lineage having managed to etch themselves deep into this Dimensional through forming an alliance with the Royalties within it!
The ferocious and fiery Kun Pengs coiled their flames in these glacial lands as Valdez recalled the voice of his Father before he was handed an extremely heavy burden.
"Tepez...among those left untouched by the Empyral Deceiver, our Lineage is among the minority."
The Empyral Deceiver.
One of the many titles of a being that rose from unknown and understandable means as he went on to leave a mark others couldn't even dare to imagine!

Recorder of History!

From the eyes of Alexander, Noah silently tugged upon the wisps of Destiny as clear gold words began to bloom on his pages.

The existence sitting amongst the throngs of Primogenial and Beta Strata LEGENDS.

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1854
paragraphs: The distinction of the Empyral Deceiver!
The gaze of his father was difficult when he spoke of this, but he continued nonetheless.

"But we still shoulder our own purpose and our own burden. And since I have a few million years left...I shall merely burn them all to pass down a great power to you, as well as a great burden. It will be a semblance of what I've achieved throughout my life, but for you- it should be a defining feature to stand out against your peers. Receiving this from me...also means receiving the will of the Great Commander who first stood against the Empyral Deceiver."
As his father had said this, his Life Line began to burn as his very Essence clustered towards one part of his body- his hand!
A hand that detached from his body and floated towards Valdez!
"Will you carry this torch, my son? Will you do your part in the cogs of destiny to restore things to how they once were? To reduce and eliminate the forces of the Empyral Deceiver?"
BZZZT!
The deathly Essence of the Niflheim Dimension poured in at that time as it swallowed his father's very heart and origin.
But what had been taken to be passed down could not be returned.
Valdez had taken the golden glowing object that had turned into a Skeletal hand with 5 golden bony digits that shone with astounding incandescence!
He had withstood immense pain as it replaced his very own bones and assimilated into him with the final life blood of his own father.
This was the hand that he currently rose in the air in this immaculately built Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest.
This was where much of the terrifying aura was clustered in, with the weight of this hand being immeasurable!
With it, he would achieve all means and goals.
To carry out the will of the Great Commander that was the first to stand against the Empyral Deceiver!
With such a weight and backing behind him, his hand thundered down.
It was the signal for the start of a bloody war in this isolated space!
Waves of resplendent essence erupted out on the side of the Pure-Blooded Primordial Geniuses as most had already pulled upon their authority and fused with their Ascendancy Halos.
Most...but not all as some weak minded Primordials still gazed on in despair at the army of Millions of LEGENDS!
They knew and accepted the hard truth that against such a force, they would not be making it out of here alive today.
SHIING!

In many areas of the glacial earth, waves of Resonance were reverberating out as many broke into the stage of a LEGEND- when even the bloodied figure of Aegon slowly healed as he chose to break through among the prolific geniuses!
But there still remained a few beings that chose to stay at the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy.
Ezekiel.
Akaris.
Juliette.

And even the visage of Katelyn who had left Andur's head and floated towards the direction of her sister- sensing the perilous dangers to come as her body also buzzed with Dimensional Gateways to call out her Mirror Beast LEGENDS!

In the skies, Reality Passages of all sorts of colors and wonders brightened up the surroundings, but even their appearance was enough to point out the true disparity and despair as when one looked above the Legions of Primogenial and Beta Strata LEGENDS...the skies were dense with countless clusters of Reality Passages!
So many more times above theirs collectively as dense seas of nourishment and Essence seemed to be gushing down onto the enemy Legions.
Yet the hearts of a few remained steadfast as among those standing closest to the thinning barrier, Noah floated serenely as his body erupted with dazzling Ascendancy Halos.
He had the vast majority shine with a golden light as at first, 30 erupted.
But then gradually...
BZZZT!

The buzzing waves of essence erupted out as 40...50...60 Ascendancy Halos undulated up and down over his body as they were reflected in the eyes of many- eyes that constricted in shock once more as Noah fused with his Halos!
He was...at the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy, right? So why could he pull out the 60 Halos that was an authority only privy to LEGENDS?!

There wasn't even time for one to be surprised as wings of aurora erupted from behind Noah, taking on the Arch-Royal Human True Form at this moment as he looked like an ancient humanoid whose very body pulsed with seas of essence.
His eyes were luminous as he gazed forward while staring into the depths of the enemy, locked onto the Kun Peng situated upon the Throne of flames who released his hand at this moment.
'Valdez Tepez...'
HUUUM!

The identity of this being was finally discerned as Noah thought about what he read through the Celestial Grimoire, his heart pulsing with destiny as it seemed there were many more intricacies he had to understand about this current situation!
But there was no time for this.
The hand that bore a heavy weight descended.
The masses of Legions surrounded by the Niflheim Dimensional Essence surged as at that moment, the transparent barrier entirely faded.
And then...hell descended!
ROAAAAAAR!

<Chaos Hounds>, <Virulent Drakes>, <Abyssal Gigantomachia Undead>, <Celestial Moon Nymphs>, <Celestial Sharks>, <Deep Sea Eldritch Krakenoids>, <Reality-Eater Ants>, <Glacial Mushroom Emperors>, <Three-Headed Ogres>, <Oblivion Ursidae>, <Moon Luminoids>, and <Kun Pengs>...these vibrant and powerful races surged out.
Wills and bellows surged and roared out as the moment the transparent barrier faded, hundreds of Primogenial LEGENDS of the Ancient Races appeared towards the beings closest to the erased barrier.
Their bodies pulsed with power and activated abilities that caused space to tremble, our gaze becoming focused on a few specific figures of this unfolding battle.

The forthcoming events occurred all at once, but they revolved around a few distinguished beings as the one to be targeted first purely because of her authority, distance, and because she was the most vocal and known enemy against them...it was Akaris.

A cluster of tens of Reality-Eater Ants and Moon Luminoids surged around her as they terrifically released waves of oppressive Primogenial auras, REIFIED abilities beginning to form behind them as blank personification were awakened!
Tens of LEGENDS dishing out REIFIED abilities.
By all means, it was enough to shred apart any lone Primogenial Strata LEGEND, much less an existence at the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy.
Yet Akaris gazed on coldly while adorned in an armor built by the very Essence of Reality.
In her eyes, everything seemed to be moving at an extremely slow pace!

As she gazed at the REIFIED abilities forming with each of them buzzing with 50 Million+ Damage Values, she breathed out multicolored mist as her eyes flashed with activity, an abstruse authority surging with her gold iris as she uttered calmly.
"Analysis."
HUUUM!
A wave of authority erupted from her as wondrously, it was not a Dao or an Edict.
And yet...its might left behind even a TABOO concept as a shocking show was about to begin!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1855
paragraphs: Amongst the Primordials, there were many options and paths to take for what one filled their soul with.
The Daos one learned took space within their Soul.
Nomological Edicts took their own space in the Soul as the higher Tier an Edict was, the more powerful a being's soul strength had to be in order to continue it or even more Edicts like it!
The strength of the soul was crucial as among a few things, there was also the concept of constructs that were built with Epitaphs within one's soul that could also occupy their space.
These...were Systems.

Some focused a great deal of their soul power on concepts of Daos and Edicts while supplementing any areas they lacked with constructs of Systems, and then others chose to rely on their constructs even more if they could create ones that were unique enough!
And then...there was Akaris.
"Analysis."
While her body was adorned with incandescent armor from the very Essence of Reality, she faced the REIFIED abilities of tens of Primogenial Strata LEGENDS confidently!
ROAAR!
Reality-Eater Ants and Moon Luminoids.

The Luminoids looked like crooked humanoids made of stellar moons, their eyes releasing beams of light as behind them, Moons took fork and personification as they opened their cold eyes, silver chains being released from them ferociously.
Meanwhile, the Reality-Eater Ants manifested a blank-faced stellar Ant behind them that opened its jagged orifice to release billowing shards of destroyed Realities!

The attacks were utterly disastrous as they caused the extremely stable space in the surroundings to tremble, undoubtedly carrying over 50 Million True Reality Damage Values for each of them as this was no beginner LEGEND attack that most were used to.
Yet Akaris had remained in the same spot as she uttered <Analysis>.

An instant later, her gold iris erupted and spun as of it was an isolated appendage- locking onto every attack thrown her way as soon after, it released a pulse of terrifying authority that caused the terrifying attacks to freeze before they even neared her!
Time slowed in her eyes.
Not even a microsecond had passed.

Her golden iris spun maddeningly as from her vision, she could see the countless lines of Mana, Essence of Reality, Essence of Edicts, and even the Essence of the Niflheim Dimension coiling around the thrown attacks!

The authority that had pulsed from her eyes covered all of this in an instant as it then interweaved itself onto the very make up of these attacks, golden Runic magic circles covering all of them as their colors all changed to reflect gold.
Thereafter, her visage floated gloriously as she uttered while her golden eyes shone with coldness.
"Enhance. Rebound."
The maddening debris of ejected rivers of Reality cast by the Reality-Eater Ants. The Chains from the Moon Luminoids.

All of them instantly turned gold in the eyes of others a moment after they were cast as right after, the REIFIED wills of these abilities had their blank irises change to the unique iris of the existence with the distinction of the SHIELD OF DAWN!
Then, these altered Reified abilities bore their wills against the beings who cast them as in shock- the Reality-Eater Ants and Moon Luminoids had their own attacks returned to them.
And what was even more dreadful...
BOOOM!
Was the explosive force that was undoubtedly much higher than what they had cast out!
Even more terrific, the targets of these rebound attacks were the beings who cast them as they focused on a third of the tens of LEGENDS surrounding Akaris.

The concentration of these attacks that were enhanced uniquely smashed onto these enemies with fervor as amidst the wreckage of burning destroyed Realities and chains of silvery light, a few LEGENDS dropped from the skies.
"Mmm...come on now."

Akaris breathed out as if she had just finished stretching, her multicolored Armament shining with waves of splendor as while she remained floating in the skies, her hands beckoned towards the remaining enemies around her!
Analysis, Enhance, and Rebound.
She had dealt with the attacks of tens of Primogenial LEGENDS in this manner as she even redirected them to greatly wound a third of these LEGENDS and even eradicate a few!
The maddening light that had somehow broken down the skills of others and turned their attacks was a profound authority that many beings recognized as their gazes became stern.
It contained an astounding authority that stemmed from Akaris's very soul, but there was also something else mixed in. It was...the undeniable authority of a Natural Law of Reality!
The region she was in boiled with power and resplendence as all around her, Primogenial LEGENDS rushed forth into the ranks of the Pure-Blooded Primordials.
"Survive!"
The branches of a myriad of Infinite Willow Trees erupted out to try and cover the skies in one area.
"We are Destined!"
WAA!
In other areas, the majestic Reality Ursidae and Kun Peng moved as their bodies glowed of radiant glory, many of the newly advanced LEGENDS grouping up together to withstand the coming enemies!
"Haha...let them come! We shall grow stronger through battle!"
In another area, the visage of Juliette glowed with astral splendor and stellar flames erupted around her, the geniuses of the Astral Bloodline grouping up around her for the sake of survival.
Even though she still held a trace of her laid back smile, one could see the somberness in her eyes as she erupted out whole moving forward.
"If we die, we die. If we survive...boundless destiny and glory awaits!"
Radiant flames surged out boundless essence gushed from above, the Primogenial Strata LEGENDS continuing to proliferate into the ranks of the Pure-Blooded Primordials in a matter of microseconds.
Until soon enough, a group of vibrant Celestial Sharks led by a Kun Peng appeared before the visage of Ezekiel who was still gazing at everything coldly.
While at the 9th Firmament of Ascendancy, groups of powerful Primogenial Strata LEGENDS surrounded him as wondrously, he didn't even spare them a glance!
His gaze was elsewhere.

His eyes were locked onto the swarmed visage of a single existence that held the distinction of the ETHEREAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR- an existence that currently had the largest number of Primogenial LEGENDS clustered around him!
He wanted to see how the scene there would play out, but...
"There are some fools blocking the way."
WAA!

His voice echoed out grandly as his sight was covered by the Kun Peng and the following Celestial Sharks whose bodies held different variations of the ecritures of <EMPEROR>, shockingly not putting them in his eyes as in the next instant- a Royal purple radiance erupted out.
A radiance that buzzed with a maddening light of Dimensional Essence!

"Survive!"
The branches of a myriad of Infinite Willow Trees erupted out to try and cover the skies in one area.
"We are Destined!"
WAA!
In other areas, the majestic Reality Ursidae and Kun Peng moved as their bodies glowed of radiant glory, many of the newly advanced LEGENDS grouping up together to withstand the coming enemies!
"Haha...let them come!
We shall grow stronger through battle!"
In another area, the visage of Juliette glowed with astral splendor and stellar flames erupted around her, the geniuses of the Astral Bloodline grouping up around her for the sake of survival.
Even though she still held a trace of her laid back smile, one could see the somberness in her eyes as she erupted out whole moving forward.
"If we die, we die.
If we survive...boundless destiny and glory awaits!"
Radiant flames surged out boundless essence gushed from above, the Primogenial Strata LEGENDS continuing to proliferate into the ranks of the Pure-Blooded Primordials in a matter of microseconds.
Until soon enough, a group of vibrant Celestial Sharks led by a Kun Peng appeared before the visage of Ezekiel who was still gazing at everything coldly.
While at the 9th Firmament of Ascendancy, groups of powerful Primogenial Strata LEGENDS surrounded him as wondrously, he didn't even spare them a glance!
His gaze was elsewhere.

His eyes were locked onto the swarmed visage of a single existence that held the distinction of the ETHEREAL DIMENSIONAL EMPEROR- an existence that currently had the largest number of Primogenial LEGENDS clustered around him!
He wanted to see how the scene there would play out, but...
"There are some fools blocking the way."
WAA!

His voice echoed out grandly as his sight was covered by the Kun Peng and the following Celestial Sharks whose bodies held different variations of the ecritures of <EMPEROR>, shockingly not putting them in his eyes as in the next instant- a Royal purple radiance erupted out.
A radiance that buzzed with a maddening light of Dimensional Essence!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1856
paragraphs: Purple.

This was the one thing that many would come to associate with the visage of Ezekiel as a regal purple light suffused throughout his body as it locked onto the Kun Peng and Celestial Sharks swarming him!
Before their REIFIED abilities could form, this surging purple light pulsed and condensed into an authority that was held tightly within Ezekiel's hands.
It was...
BZZZT!
The convergence of the dense Dimensional Essence into a massive, magisterial purple greatsword.
"Sword of Avalon."
Ezekiel uttered out softly as a sharp sword formed.

It was twice the size of his body as it wasn't just a coagulation of Dimensional Essence. Pulsing at its depths and beginning to leak out from the blade- a dangerous authority that also didn't fit into an Edict, Law, or Dao bloomed as it entirely had its source from a Dimension!

It cut apart the surrounding space and any authority it came across as Ezekiel's body became wrapped in coiling purple tendrils of the same Essence, disappearing from his location and flashing right before the majestic Primogenial Strata Kun Peng as he swung down.
Swung down a massive sword that actually held traces of a Decretum of a Dimension!
It was the regal and kingly Dimensional Essence from none other than the Avalon Dimension.
BOOOOM!
The whole area around him splintered into purple waves of glory as crimson gold True Blood bloomed, Ezekiel's visage facing multiple Primogenial Emperors coldly as the crown above him began to spin.

Further behind him, Nefertiti bit her lips at this scene as her gaze was firm- her body already showing the illusion of a Reality as she was among those that knew they would have a 0% chance of survival if they didn't even break through!
She bit her lips as amidst Ezekiel beginning to swing the Sword of Avalon, she saw him turn towards her with his kingly and majestic eyes as he gave a light nod.
A nod that caused her heart to turn tumultuous as it meant the end of a deal she had made with him many years ago when the two of them met.
'Have you already found what you were looking for?'
She was disheartened that he really stood by his words without even delaying them, an aurora of winged lights stretching out behind her as she prepared to face some of the swarming enemies as well!
But...
"Sister!"
The voice of the Dimensional Royalty buzzed in her ears as Katelyn came to arrive before her.
The silver haired Dimensional Royalty appeared before her with valor and power as Nefertiti couldn't find the words to say in the midst of all this.

With her bronze skin glinting in the dreary light, her dazzling black hair flowed down on her shoulders as Nefertiti wanted to reply coldly or with anger, but with the threat of death...many more unneeded emotions faded away.

Katelyn saw the hesitation from her sister as her heart eased, choosing to stand beside her to fight against the coming Legions as her authority was already flowing out with Dimensional Gates opening around her body!
But in the next instant...
SHAA!
At speeds that even Katelyn could barely follow, a figure flashed forth.
She tried to move and release her shocking authority as she saw the mixture of insecurities, fear, and uncertainty from Nefertiti, but her sister didn't even feel that the enemy had locked onto her!

The Essence of the Niflheim Dimension silently permeated as an instant later, a claw had already cleanly gone from the back and to the front of Nefertiti's body. Her expression still didn't change as if she didn't even feel it! This was how fast this claw was as it was buzzing with a maddening light not possible in the Primogenial Strata- over 100 Million Damage Values bursting out at that moment and turned the body of this existence to crimson gold mist.
A Beta Strata Chaos Hound LEGEND appeared.
Who said that only Primogenial Strata LEGENDS would surge towards them?
Who said that the Beta Strata LEGENDS would stay in the back and watch things unfold?

Even the powerful Beta Strata LEGENDS moved with speed as they already appeared in the midst of the Pure-Blooded Primordials, and many had already perished as all those targeted by them so far turned into a cluster of crimson gold misty light!
Nefertiti...was no exception.

Katelyn had a blank expression as she stared at the spot where Nefertiti used to be, the Beta Strata Chaos Hound before her having its crimson gold eyes flashing with a deadly light as before it made another move...
BOOOOOM!
A horrid Dimensional wave of essence pushed its figure back as the small figure of Katelyn erupted out!

Tears freely flowed from Katelyn's eyes as her skin splintered and cracked, radiant silvery feathered wings erupting behind for miles as silver Runic lines began to surge over her skin- a crystalline transparent armor beginning to form over her as it was a Dimensional Royalty taking on their shocking form!
Shocking waves of essence pulsated outwards as this region...merely became another part of this bloody battlefield.

The Ancient Races within the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest did not give a break nor did they falter, all their forces moving like unstoppable waves as at this juncture, the enormous obsidian skeletal hands of the Abyssal Gigantomachia Undead Beta Strata LEGENDS also moved!
The only one who had yet to make a move...was the Kun Peng in human form situated upon the Throne of flames.

His eyes were constantly shifting from the visage of Akaris, Ezekiel, and Katelyn as lastly...they came to lock onto the swarmed figure of Noah who was floating stably while shining with an aurora of radiant wings behind him.
His gaze was steady as his body was undulating with contained pressure and power that was ready to spill out at any moment!

Around him, the Primogenial Strata LEGENDS had topped over 100 as REIFIED skills bloomed from then in a shocking fashion- each one carrying tens of Millions of Damage Values as towards all of this...the Tyrannical Emperor opened his luminous eyes as he spoke out slowly, billowing Dream Dimensional Soul Damage Values erupting out with his mere words.
"Emperor's...Haki."

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1857
paragraphs: For understanding the scene that was about to unfold, one needs to gain an understanding of exactly where Noah's power theoretically stood at this moment.

His power fluctuated depending on the True Form he took as if he took on his strongest Ascendant Unnamed Kainos Emperor True Form, he attained a multiplier of 2,500 per 10 Ascendancy Halos as for his 60 Halos he was currently using...this would be 15,000!
A 15,000 Multiplier!
But...this form had a high cost as Noah could only keep it active for a short period of time, so he wouldn't pull it out right away.
There was the normal Unnamed Kainos Emperor True Form that granted 1,250 per 10 Ascendancy Halos, making Noah's full multiplier in this form be 7,500.
Then, there was the Pure Arch-Royal Human form that Noah currently sported.
Radiant white wings erupted behind him as his fair skin scintillated with stellar light, his dark hair waving in the skies filled with LEGENDS as he uttered out <Emperor's Haki> while in this form!
His power didn't just stem from the current form he took that granted a 750 per 10 Ascendancy Halos for a total of 4,500, but also from something else that his Main Body was currently doing.

Back in the lands under the authority of the Dimensional Holy Land, Noah's main body was ceaselessly using his accumulated resources to build more Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos, expand his Dream Dimensional Sea, and strengthen his Dream Dimensional Body as more and more Physiques were refined!
But while doing all of this...Noah was also currently sitting on an incandescent throne.

Shimmering with waves of golden dreamy essence and cerulean blue Mana, the Throne of Unnamed Tyranny floated grandly above the lands of the old Blue Planet as multicolored waves of power occasionally crossed its astounding visage.
Noah sat on this throne for one reason and one reason only.
It was due to a prompt that had appeared when his Unnamed Kainos Emperor reached TABOO some time ago!
<The Throne of Unnamed Tyranny has been elevated as...all cast abilities are granted True Dual Enhancement...>
True Dual Enhancement.
It was an authority brought about whenever Noah sat on his throne, and his True Sanguine Clones...could take on this authority.
It meant that whatever Damage Values stemming from the cast abilities of the True Sanguine Clones after undergoing the multiplier of his Ascendancy Halos...would go on to further be doubled!
Thus, the current Reality came to be.
Just to utter the word based on the nearest targets around him, the cost was high as 1 Million Units of the Essence of Reality burned.
"Emperor's Haki."
WAA!
His eyes opened as the over 100 Primogenial Strata LEGENDS around him felt like they weren't moving at all.

From his body, billowing stormy waves of golden Dream Dimensional Soul Damage Values erupted in all directions- their passage turning the surroundings gold as the REIFIED abilities shot out by the blank personifications came to a halt!
The little sentience they had...became utterly shredded and disconnected as even though these beings were somewhat surrounded by the Niflheim Dimension.

The Dream Dimensional Soul Damage Values were so dense and destructive that they lulled REIFIED Abilities to sleep, Noah's Haki that carried his domineering will smashing into the bodies of the multiple existences from Ancient Bloodlines as his will carried horrific Damage!

Just from the measly 4,500 Damage multiplier of his current True Form, his base Damage Values of 5,000 from his Dream Dimensional Reality Seed and the over 3,000 Base Damage Values from all his Physiques...allowed him to attain 36+ Million Damage Values.
Over 36 Million!
Mind you, a LEGEND'S base attack was 5 Million- and Noah had yet to even resonate his Aspects of Existence!
And still, he went further ahead with his ridiculousness as due to the effect of the Throne of Unnamed Tyranny...this Damage Value was doubled.

72+ Million Dream Dimensional Soul Damage Values was what his billowing Haki that painted the skies gold sent out- this Area of Effect ability smashing into the nearby LEGENDS and affecting them the most as it was bound to be the deadliest attack carried out so far.
This was because the Damage Values was a rare one that was focused on the Soul, and then it was further a Dimensional Soul Damage!
None of the beings nearby had sufficient protection against such a unique Damage as it seamlessly shattered their Innate barriers and sunk into their souls.

An action whose result was made obvious an instant later as the buzzing and vivacious group of over 100 Chaos Hounds, Moon Luminoids, Oblivion Ursidae, and Celestial Sharks that were closest to Noah...had their bright eyes turn dim as their bodies began to listlessly fall towards the barren glacial earth below!

Those slightly further away moved back as their foreheads split open and nearly cracked, the intensity of the Emperor's Haki dying down the further it went as this area of effect ability still injured a few hundred more of the Ancient Races that were rushing over!
Their eyes buzzed with shocking light and somberness as they watched the unbelievable scene that had come about from an existence uttering two words.
Akaris had killed a few dozen with her unique means.
Ezekiel was swinging through Sword of Avalon and cutting down all those before him steadily as he seemed unphased.
And then Noah...merely spoke once as over a hundred LEGENDS had their souls irreparably shattered as they dropped from the skies like mere flies!
His visage and gaze became the focus of the eyes of many as the massive Beta Strata Abyssal Gigantomachia Undead turned their flaming sockets towards his direction.

His dazzling dark hair and toned muscles that shone with astounding radiance was ingrained into the minds of all beings here, and yet he seemed unphased while a ridiculous number of prompts blasted his mind- showing the downfall of ridiculous levels of Loot, Concepts, and Bloodlines from over 100 LEGENDS!
Take that in for a moment.

A single cast of his ability that released his domineering will somehow managed to dish out over 72 Million Damage Values- Soul ones at that, and he caused the downfall of existences that had lived for millions if not billions of years.
He...who was merely an F Rank Hunter over a year ago!
He...who was just on the first stages of his journey!!!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1858
paragraphs: As Noah conducted an action worthy of the highest accolades, his gaze was valiant and that of sharp Tyranny as his eyes released beams of terrific light.
This was because with this single move, the eyes of multiple Beta Strata LEGENDS focused on him.
So...
"Not enough."
HUUM!
His current form and strength were not enough.
He didn't grow complacent at the ridiculous fact that he had just killed over 100 Primogenial LEGENDS in a single move as his will gave a command.
'Take the form of the Unnamed Kainos Emperor.'
Cerulean blue and gorgeous gold erupted along with multicolored splendor as his current True Form changed!

His dark hair buzzed as it turned into blue gold flames that burned the very surrounding space, his many Ecritures being hidden as the surging blue of MANA and the gold of DREAM could at times be seen flashing in and out of Existence due to how many of these ecritures there were.
Massive golden wings of sandy light erupted from his back as they began to form surging cyclones of Dream essence!

His whole body...looked like a celestially built muscular visage as his skin was painted with a hue of gold Runic markings, his eyes painted liquid gold as seas of Dream essence began to surround this area and turn it into a terrific domain.

Fluttering loose golden shirt and pants covered him with utmost majesty as he adorned the form of the Unnamed Kainos Emperor that could actually take on many different looks since it was the accumulation of all of Noah's Bloodlines.
This time, he merely allowed it to be more humanoid to match a Royal Human as even with that, his visage was unlike any other that a Royal Human could display!
A form with a 1,250 Multiplier for every 10 Ascendancy Halos.
With 60 Halos, this was a multiplier of 7,500 as when applied to the mere base Damage Values of 8,000 without putting into account anything else...Noah's attacks reached 60+ Million Damage Values.
And after the True Dual Enhancement from the Throne of Unnamed Tyranny, this Value spilled over 100 Million!
It spilled over to the territory of Beta Strata LEGENDS!
Before he even utilized this strength, he was given a taste of just what would be possible with the masses of LEGENDS here.
With it, he could definitely finish forging all the Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos and expand his Dimensional Soul Sea to the utmost while refining his Dream Dimensional Body!
The taste of loot for just over a hundred LEGENDS falling...was too maddening.
[+6,400 Primogenial Blood Pearls have been obtained...] DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+640,000 Physique Refining Pearls obtained.]
[+6,400 Liquified Soul Dews have been obtained...] DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+6,400 Liquified Soul Seas have been obtained.]
[+6,400 Seeds of Reality have been obtained...] DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+6,400 False Grotto Nacres have been obtained.]
[+12,500,000,000 Trillion Skill Points obtained...] DING! The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+1,250,000 Reality Resource Points obtained.]
<The effects of Absolute Looter are applied.>
<You have attained the TABOO Edicts of Lunar Emperor, The Deep, Three-Headed Emperor, Plasmic Chaos....>
<The Olden Bloodlines of the Chaos Hound, Celestial Shark, Oblivion Ursidae, and Moon Luminoid have been attained.>
This was for merely over 100 Primogenial Strata LEGENDS.
What would the number be for the Millions that lay waiting out there for Noah? What would the Beta Strata LEGENDS grant?!

His Expansive Space was glittering with grandeur as multicolored crystalline treasures filled it to the brim, with all of these not even having been Quintupled yet as when it came to Loot, Noah planned to alternate from these types of Loot to Loot Crates as he moved down LEGENDS!
His current Damage Values were already ridiculous enough to achieve this, but this...still wasn't the most maddeningly ridiculous aspect of him just yet.
There was also...the Innate Dimensional Barrier surrounding his body.

A Barrier that granted a Defense Value based on the strongest form he took- and that was based on the Ascendant Unnamed Kainos Emperor True Form that granted the 2,500 multiplier for every 10 Halos for a ridiculous 15,000x multiplier with the current 60 Ascendancy Halos!

When taking into account the VITALITY ecritures that had grown into 205 swimming in Noah's Blood that now granted a base boost of 2,050 and the 3,000 from his Physiques and 5,000 base defense values granted from his Dream Dimensional Reality Seed...Noah's base defense Values had easily spilled over 10,000.
Under the 15,000 multiplier, he gloriously had an Innate Dimensional Barrier of 150 Million Defense Values!
His defense alone exceeded Peak Primogenial Strata LEGENDS as the only worries he had...were the Beta Strata LEGENDS that could dish out hundreds of millions of Damage Values.
But...this was just accounting for the Innate Dimensional Barrier. He still hadn't called upon his Defensive Skills!
He still...had not even called out his REIFIED abilities as the number at this moment was more than just Ascendant Reality Fireball.

Ascendant Reality Sever, Ascendant Illuminating Soul Star, Bloodfied, Ascendant Lich's Armament of Devotion, Ascendant Celestial Lich's Smite of Retribution...all of these stellar abilities had finished their REIFICATION after Ascendant Reality Fireball as it was a foregone conclusion which ability would be used first to fully start the decimation of thousands of LEGENDS.
It was...

REIFIED <Ascendant Reality Fireball>(5/5):: An ability that has undergone the process of REIFICATION and attained individuality as The Saintess of Fiery Damnation. Calling upon her requires 500 Trillion Units of Mana and 1,000,000 Units of the Essence of Reality as she remains on the field for 5 Seconds to decree fiery judgment. The ability can currently deal 1,000 Base True Reality Damage Values and 500 Dimensional Damage Values with its independent attacks, with the variations of fiery justice being innumerable as it is perfect for mass immolation...
His surroundings were empty as the Primogenial LEGENDS swarmed a few more paces away, not moving forward as they began to circle him in the thousands.
And then from their folds...Beta Strata LEGENDS of these magnificent Ancient Races began to step out!
It was a formation to utterly and brutally decimate the enemy as who could stand against multiple Beta Strata LEGENDS, much less thousands of Primogenial Strata LEGENDS?!
HOOONG!
From the distance, the Sword of Avalon could be heard buzzing as a regal existence tore across dozens of LEGENDS- his goal apparently being this shocking location!
The Luminous eyes of Akaris and the eyes of a hidden figure were among many gazing at the swarms of LEGENDS surrounding Noah who at this moment...went forward to utter a few words once more.
"Ascendant Reality Fireball."
The bleak skies changed color.
A massive Infinite Reality Passage appeared as tens more bloomed beside it, one of these Passages shining with a particularly deadly light as the Saintess of Fiery Damnation opened her glorious eyes!

sentences.text: As Noah conducted an action worthy of the highest accolades, his gaze was valiant and that of sharp Tyranny as his eyes released beams of terrific light.
This was because with this single move, the eyes of multiple Beta Strata LEGENDS focused on him.
So...
"Not enough."
HUUM!
His current form and strength were not enough.
He didn't grow complacent at the ridiculous fact that he had just killed over 100 Primogenial LEGENDS in a single move as his will gave a command.
'Take the form of the Unnamed Kainos Emperor.'
Cerulean blue and gorgeous gold erupted along with multicolored splendor as his current True Form changed!

His dark hair buzzed as it turned into blue gold flames that burned the very surrounding space, his many Ecritures being hidden as the surging blue of MANA and the gold of DREAM could at times be seen flashing in and out of Existence due to how many of these ecritures there were.
Massive golden wings of sandy light erupted from his back as they began to form surging cyclones of Dream essence!

His whole body...looked like a celestially built muscular visage as his skin was painted with a hue of gold Runic markings, his eyes painted liquid gold as seas of Dream essence began to surround this area and turn it into a terrific domain.

Fluttering loose golden shirt and pants covered him with utmost majesty as he adorned the form of the Unnamed Kainos Emperor that could actually take on many different looks since it was the accumulation of all of Noah's Bloodlines.
This time, he merely allowed it to be more humanoid to match a Royal Human as even with that, his visage was unlike any other that a Royal Human could display!
A form with a 1,250 Multiplier for every 10 Ascendancy Halos.
With 60 Halos, this was a multiplier of 7,500 as when applied to the mere base Damage Values of 8,000 without putting into account anything else...Noah's attacks reached 60+ Million Damage Values.
And after the True Dual Enhancement from the Throne of Unnamed Tyranny, this Value spilled over 100 Million!
It spilled over to the territory of Beta Strata LEGENDS!
Before he even utilized this strength, he was given a taste of just what would be possible with the masses of LEGENDS here.
With it, he could definitely finish forging all the Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos and expand his Dimensional Soul Sea to the utmost while refining his Dream Dimensional Body!
The taste of loot for just over a hundred LEGENDS falling...was too maddening.
[+6,400 Primogenial Blood Pearls have been obtained...] DING!
The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+640,000 Physique Refining Pearls obtained.]
[+6,400 Liquified Soul Dews have been obtained...] DING!
The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+6,400 Liquified Soul Seas have been obtained.]
[+6,400 Seeds of Reality have been obtained...] DING!
The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+6,400 False Grotto Nacres have been obtained.]
[+12,500,000,000 Trillion Skill Points obtained...] DING!
The effects of Loot Multiplier are applied...[+1,250,000 Reality Resource Points obtained.]
<The effects of Absolute Looter are applied.>
<You have attained the TABOO Edicts of Lunar Emperor, The Deep, Three-Headed Emperor, Plasmic Chaos....>
<The Olden Bloodlines of the Chaos Hound, Celestial Shark, Oblivion Ursidae, and Moon Luminoid have been attained.>
This was for merely over 100 Primogenial Strata LEGENDS.
What would the number be for the Millions that lay waiting out there for Noah?
What would the Beta Strata LEGENDS grant?!

His Expansive Space was glittering with grandeur as multicolored crystalline treasures filled it to the brim, with all of these not even having been Quintupled yet as when it came to Loot, Noah planned to alternate from these types of Loot to Loot Crates as he moved down LEGENDS!
His current Damage Values were already ridiculous enough to achieve this, but this...still wasn't the most maddeningly ridiculous aspect of him just yet.
There was also...the Innate Dimensional Barrier surrounding his body.

A Barrier that granted a Defense Value based on the strongest form he took- and that was based on the Ascendant Unnamed Kainos Emperor True Form that granted the 2,500 multiplier for every 10 Halos for a ridiculous 15,000x multiplier with the current 60 Ascendancy Halos!

When taking into account the VITALITY ecritures that had grown into 205 swimming in Noah's Blood that now granted a base boost of 2,050 and the 3,000 from his Physiques and 5,000 base defense values granted from his Dream Dimensional Reality Seed...Noah's base defense Values had easily spilled over 10,000.
Under the 15,000 multiplier, he gloriously had an Innate Dimensional Barrier of 150 Million Defense Values!
His defense alone exceeded Peak Primogenial Strata LEGENDS as the only worries he had...were the Beta Strata LEGENDS that could dish out hundreds of millions of Damage Values.
But...this was just accounting for the Innate Dimensional Barrier.
He still hadn't called upon his Defensive Skills!
He still...had not even called out his REIFIED abilities as the number at this moment was more than just Ascendant Reality Fireball.

Ascendant Reality Sever, Ascendant Illuminating Soul Star, Bloodfied, Ascendant Lich's Armament of Devotion, Ascendant Celestial Lich's Smite of Retribution...all of these stellar abilities had finished their REIFICATION after Ascendant Reality Fireball as it was a foregone conclusion which ability would be used first to fully start the decimation of thousands of LEGENDS.
It was...
REIFIED <Ascendant Reality Fireball>(5/5):: An ability that has undergone the process of REIFICATION and attained individuality as The Saintess of Fiery Damnation.
Calling upon her requires 500 Trillion Units of Mana and 1,000,000 Units of the Essence of Reality as she remains on the field for 5 Seconds to decree fiery judgment.

The ability can currently deal 1,000 Base True Reality Damage Values and 500 Dimensional Damage Values with its independent attacks, with the variations of fiery justice being innumerable as it is perfect for mass immolation...
His surroundings were empty as the Primogenial LEGENDS swarmed a few more paces away, not moving forward as they began to circle him in the thousands.
And then from their folds...Beta Strata LEGENDS of these magnificent Ancient Races began to step out!
It was a formation to utterly and brutally decimate the enemy as who could stand against multiple Beta Strata LEGENDS, much less thousands of Primogenial Strata LEGENDS?!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1859
paragraphs: In the core of the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest, time was moving extremely slowly for the existences embroiled in battle as even microseconds passed slowly for them.
Yet in their eyes, things still happened at high speeds as within less than a second, drastic changes could have occurred in the battle!
But some events took the spot light and eyes of all beings.

An event like now where one existence surrounded by thousands of Primogenial Strata LEGENDS from a distance and Beta Strata LEGENDS that were coming forward...such an existence brought down constructs that caused all others to gaze upwards just for a brief moment.
It was...the grandeur of his Reality Passages.

Massive and vibrant with the colors of gold, blue, red, purple...every single color one could think of, 50 immensely huge mountainous Reality Passages bloomed with such dominance and authority that all those shining in the skies were forcefully pushed aside and dimmed at this moment!

Nearby Reality Passages felt a shocking level of suppression as they dimmed and heavily reduced their essence generation to their masters, and some dimmed entirely in the face of these titanic Passages!
Even more dreadful was that within a few of these massive mountains, indistinct figures of massive existences could be seen swimming in the dense Essence.

At this moment, one of them was called upon as the centermost Reality Passage glowed with splendor, a blazing face filled with gem like eyes opening the Passage even more as she floated out with Pure glory!

Tendrils of crimson gold hair flowed down to its shoulders as a crown made of stellar flames domineeringly burned above her head, fiery gold robes hiding her curvaceous figure that sported fiery stellar wings.
Behind these wings, circular rows of multicolored stellar balls of flames bloomed as they seemed like endlessly burning condensed Realities!
The crimson gold gem like eyes of this massive being- the Saintess of Fiery Damnation...went on to gaze upon the masses at this moment.

Her face held exceeding majesty and regality that shockingly began to be etched with a devilish and chilling smile, where one could see her Fiery red lips open to release steam as a light of excitement could be seen when this Saintess gazed at the masses of LEGENDS!

Yes. Excitement! Her face showed such an expression as she wasn't like any of the REIFIED abilities shown so far, the eyes of many turning stern as they felt like they were facing a powerhouse and not an ability.

A powerhouse that at this moment pointed her fingers, the Fiery circular rows of flames behind her buzzing and shining gloriously as they stayed where they were. And instead, the Saintess of Fiery Damnation raised her fair crimson hands as she pointed with her finger towards the area where multiple LEGENDS clustered around Noah.
She then spoke lightly in a voice that dazed the souls of weaker beings.
<Nuclear.>
With eyes of increasing excitement...countless massive balls of flames that seemed to number in the thousands began to bloom from her index finger.
...BRRRRRR!
With a ridiculous speed that would put bullets to shame, thousands of hellish masses of essence erupted out as they shone with the maddening golden light of Dimensional Soul Damage!
Their speed was great, but what did the Saintess of Fiery Damnation mean by <Nuclear>?
BOOOM! BOOOOM!
Hellish Nuclear Ascendant Reality Fireballs.

They exploded into raging circular storms of nuclear cataclysm as they covered multiple LEGENDS with the explosion of a single one, and the Saintess of Fiery Damnation was waving her index finger that was shooting out thousands of streams of these hellish nuclear balls of flames constantly- and she even seemed to be doing it faster as one could see the light in her jewel like eyes increase with excitement!
Excitement and ecstasy were shockingly apparent on her face as she actually dealt out horrific damnation to all of Noah's nearby enemies!
<Mmm...Poison.>

The golden orange balls of flames shooting out from her index finger changed colors as they were painted with a hue of Virulent green soon after, their explosive force leaving behind ravaging Dimensional storms of poisonous energy that decimated any beings that somehow manages to survive the over 100 Million Dream Dimensional Soul Damage Values, the ravaging effects of Virulent poison dripped into their souls to do the rest.

Even more ecstasy shone on the face of the Saintess of Fiery Damnation when she saw the horrific scene of Primogenial LEGENDS being ripped apart below her by the hundreds, her index finger continuing to shoot out Fiery hellish fireballs even faster!
BRRRRRR!

The sound permeated the whole area as its stunning effects were unmatched, Noah's mind buzzing with information and countless memories as Primogenial Strata LEGENDS began to now fall by the hundreds from the mere cast of a single skill.
From the mere cast of Fireball!
<Haha!>
The Saintess of Fiery Damnation brought down he'll while laughing, the toll of deaths reaching something that the powerful Commanders of the Ancient Races couldn't ignore.
OOOM!
At this moment, two made a move as their hundreds of Realities Passages surged, their bodies releasing profound power as REIFIED skills shot forth.
The ones to make a move were a Glacial Mushroom Emperor and...none other than a Commander Kun Peng!
SHAA!
The illusion of a blank faced Mushroom opened its eyes soon after as it spread countless pink spores that formed into a cloud to shield the oncoming endless rain of Fireballs onto their Legions.
Then the illusion of a massive three legged bird formed behind the Kun Peng Beta Strata LEGEND as it spewed out horrific gold lava like flames towards Noah's REIFIED ability!
At the same time, two other Beta Strata LEGENDS shot out from Noah's left and right side, and two more surged up directly towards him.
6 Beta Strata LEGENDS were actually actively moving against a single 'Ninth Firmament' existence at this moment.
Existences capable of hundreds of millions of Damage Values surged towards him as REIFIED skills already formed and were ready to decimate everything in their path!!!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1860
paragraphs: THUMP!
Noah's heart thumped clearly as he knew very well his own power and his limitations.
He had just spilled over 100 Million Damage Values as Beta Strata LEGENDS...could easily dish out this same Damage, or a few Hundred Million.

He could defend against 150 Million innately with his Dimensional Barrier as due to it being Dimensional in nature, the number of True Reality Damage Values he could withstand was even greater as much more damage had to be dealt in order to break it!

So for him to survive an assault against multiple Beta Strata LEGENDS, he had to be actively moving and evading them while testing their defenses and how well they could defend against his Dream Dimensional Soul Damage Values- this type of unique Damage being his main weapon as even with this, it was bound to be extremely dangerous.
So the first thing was defense and more crowd control abilities.
But as Noah's Origin buzzed and he was about to call out a second Reified ability...
OOOOM!
Massive golden white waves of light surged all around as everyone's eyes felt the flash of many pairs of wings of light!

An instant later, the visage of none other than Akaris appeared to Noah's right as her body released boundless waves of a unique power, the very Natural Laws of Reality surging around her as she took an infinitesimally small period of time to first gaze at Noah in an indescribable look before gazing at the Beta Strata LEGENDS that were rushing forward.

There was no point of communication or any words said as she simply stood upon the path of a Beta Strata LEGEND, her armored body beginning to release incandescent light as the ecritures of SHIELD OF DAWN around her crown buzzed with fervor!
She spoke out lightly as the surrounding uncontrollable essence of Natural Laws of Reality began to buzz.
"Shield Maiden."
HUUUM!

Pure golden splendor bloomed as massive waves of light surged out before being pulled in to form the hazy image of a golden white shield coiling with tendrils of the essence of the Natural Laws Reality- a shield that Akaris grasped in her hands and surged forward with it to clash with an incoming Oblivion Ursidae Beta Strata LEGEND!
A forward clash...against a Beta Strata LEGEND!
But this wasn't all that occurred during this same period of time.
ZIING!

A flash of regal purple erupted out as a dozen Primogenial Strata LEGENDS were cut through, a glorious existence clad in purple regality and wielding the Sword of Avalon appearing towards Noah's left side where a Three-Headed Ogre was surging forth!
His gaze was filled with majesty and Royalty as with utmost focus on the upcoming Beta Strata LEGEND, He breathed out while calling lightly.
<King's Guard>.
The Decretum of a Dimension erupted.

Boundless purple light bloomed as a massive purple great shield bloomed on his left hand, his eyes releasing cold radiance and splendor as with a Sword of Avalon and a shield buzzing with the Decretum of a Dimension, this being went to face the coming Three-Headed Ogre who scoffed with anger as crackling beams of light coagulated into a REIFIED ability above him!
The Beta Strata LEGENDS to his right and left seemed to be covered as there were still two coming straight at him, and two more that were moving against the Saintess of Fiery Damnation.
Noah's mind buzzed as to him, time nearly came to a halt.
THUMP!

Everything occurring around him fell under his gaze as the effects of <Resonance of Nature> were pervasive and prevalent even now, with the boosts they granted being something that Noah realized even he underestimated.
A circular blast of essence silently shot from him at the center as he could feel many things.
The massive weight of the Decretum of a Dimension carried around Ezekiel.
The sharpness of the surging Natural Laws of Reality that Akaris was somehow able to pull around her!

The wrath of Katelyn far away as she transformed into a shocking Dimensional Royalty, the reality around her shattering into countless Mirrors as her hands reached out to the still present bloody mist that used to be Nefertiti.
Bloody mist that she twisted her hands and pulled into a single mirror that reflected countless more shocking images beginning to unravel!
THUMP!
He could feel it all as his soul seemed to resonate with everything.

He felt like he could closely feel the surging and immovable natural laws that he could only pull wisps of to make his Seeds of TABOO, but at this moment- he felt like he could do something else with them!

As he saw Akaris and Ezekiel pull upon Natural Laws and a Decretum of a Dimension, Noah's eyes focused on the 4 Beta Strata LEGENDS as he left behind any worries about whether he could defend against their hundreds of millions of Damage Values or not.
Under this unique state of Resonance, he called upon his abilities.
<Ascendant Lich's Armament of Devotion>.
WAA!
<Ascendant Celestial Lich's Smite of Retribution>.
<Ascendant Reality...Sever>.
BOOOOM!
Essence exploded out madly as three Infinite Reality Passages surged and crackled with maddening light!

The existences they held within were called upon as this wasn't all- the most dreadful thing was that as they stepped out, wisps of essence of the Natural Laws of Reality began surging into them as it caused their splendor to become even more glorious.
<An Astounding Achievement!>
<You have become more perceptive to the Natural Laws of Reality as you can now begin incorporating them to your moves, reducing their resource cost and greatly elevating their power!>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age has risen slightly.>
Such information buzzed in Noah's mind as three REIFIED abilities were called out.

And even though it was cast last, one ability surged out with most speed and valor as shining with purple, blue, and gold, Sever stepped out of the Infinite Reality Passage as its sharp eyes opened to lock on to the Beta Strata LEGENDS before Noah.
Thereafter...
A scene of glory and one worthy of utmost remembrance bloomed!

<Shield Maiden>:: Brought forth by an authority even the user doesn't fully understand, this ability pulls in the surrounding essence of the Natural Laws of Reality to form a domain of protection. It is supplemented by the Natural Laws of Reality as there is no requirement of the Essence of Reality to cast, with the only price to pay being the erosion of one's soul from calling upon essence they neither know nor understand through unique means. The Domain of protection can withstand a range of 100-500 Million True Reality Damage Values depending on the remaining strength of the user's soul...

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1861
paragraphs: In an area of the Infinite Reality under the authority of the Dimensional Holy Land.
Dazzling scenes were occurring throughout, but some were more wondrous than others as the one in current focus wasn't even Noah.

It was of something connected to him that had an intense longing- a longing that was finally achieved after it utilized the Bone of a Kun Peng, an Interchangeable Dimensional Material, and many more materials from the Mirror Dimension with the aid of the Infinite Reality to change itself!
Noah didn't even touch it as at this moment, RUINATION had advanced herself and taken on a stellar form.

Gone was her crimson skin and golden inscriptions as dazzling hands with a silvery complexion slowly unfurled, silver golden feathered wings erupting behind her as crimson gold hair draped over her bare skin. Her eyes carried boundless silver, gold, and black colors as within them, one could see the dazzling essence of Three Dimensions!

Mirror, Dream, and Niflheim Essence could be seen swirling maddeningly in her eyes as she had achieved a terrifying feat after her advancement, her exceedingly beautiful expression becoming firm at this time as she put her hands on her chest and began to glow.
<Emperor's Ruined Blade of Oblivion>.
WAA!
A glow bloomed out and gradually changed her form as from humanoid, she shockingly reformed into a massive silver gold greatsword with an incandescent obsidian hilt!
The dazzling Ecritures of DREAM, MIRROR, and NIFLHEIM surged around the greatsword the moment its form was taken as its sharpness was enough to cut the surrounding space.

The <Emperor's Ruined Blade of Oblivion> flashed a single time as a Mirror appeared before it, the massive blade sinking into it and disappearing as it came to another region under the influence of the Dimensional Holy Land where the visage of Noah could be seen sitting on the Throne of Unnamed Tyranny.
He gazed upon his treasure in form of a massive and radiant blade as its voice rang out in his mind.
<Master>.
The treasure that wanted to be of more use to its Master.
Its auxiliary uses were already so dreadful enough, but it now focused on even more offensive aspects as it took on the form of a deadly weapon right away!
Noah's eyes flashed while gazing at RUINATION as he nodded, waving his hands forward as he allowed an incandescent Atlatl of Reality to also flow over beside RUINATION!
"Come to me in the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest."
WAA!

His command reverberated out as RUINATION released a dazzling silver glow that also wrapped the Atlatl of Reality, with the both of them turning towards a mirror light that actually formed in Noah's chest as they sunk into him!
...and then, there was silence.

The authority of RUINATION was abundant as even after she 'left', her aura could be felt constantly surging around Noah as she had access to his Expansive Space, continuing her passive task of multiplying his loot as after her upgrade, she was doing it by a factor of 6!
The allure of loot surged into Noah's Expansive Space and formed mountains as soon after, these mountains were duplicated into even grander ones by a newly upgraded Relic.
There were TABOO Relics, and then, there was RUINATION!
In the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest.

Noah's chest slowly began to revolve with a silvery light as three skills were cast at once with two requiring resources to do so, and the last one was the most destructive skill that actually required nothing for Noah to cast even after it became REIFIED.
Their details were glorious to the eyes!

REIFIED [Ascendant Reality Sever] (5/5): Born from a concept of extreme speed and mortality, the Assassin Emperor of Severance is called upon as every single one of his attacks has a chaining feature that allows it to strike up to one hundred nearby enemies as with every chain, the damage increases by 1.5%. Every time an enemy is hit by his attacks, the Saintess of Fiery Damnation makes a brief appearance for a microsecond to lay down judgment. The ability can currently deal 1,000 True Reality Damage Values and 1,000 Dream Dimensional Damage Values as it has no resource cost, allowing for the chaining effect of the attacks of the Assassin Emperor of Severance to continue repeating on the same enemy or multiple nearby enemies until their Origins perish or the construct of the ability becomes disrupted....

REIFIED <Ascendant Lich's Armament of Devotion>(5/5):: The REIFIED Visage of the Arch Lich Ra'Zan appears behind the caster as they are graced with the Lich Emperor's Armament of Devotion, a celestial armament made from the vast Legions of the Arch lich that provides 3,000 True Reality Defense Values, 2,000 Dream Dimensional Defense Values, and 20% Strata Vitality Regeneration every microsecond. It requires 1,500,000 Units of the Essence of Reality to cast and 150,000 Units of the Essence of Reality to keep active every microsecond. So long as the Lich Emperor's Armament of Devotion isn't breached and bypassed, it will remain at its optimum state for multiple attacks as the bony visage of death embraces you...

REIFIED <Ascendant Celestial Lich's Smite of Retribution>(5/5):: The Celestial Lich descends as its Legions of Undead are summoned as an amalgamation of a weapon, transforming into an enormous Celestial Bone Legion Sword that rains down Retribution into a single target with a Dream Dimensional Damage Value of 3,000, and then a secondary Smite of 1,000 Area of Effect True Reality Damage Values as the Celestial Bone Legion Sword transforms into a Celestial Necrotic Ring of Death that swirls for 3 microseconds against all enemies...

Glorious Abilities as Sever alone added another base 2,000 Damage Values, with Noah's defensive ability of Armament of Devotion adding a whooping 5,000 Defense Values on top of his already ridiculous Innate Dimensional Barrier!

The single cast of Lich's Armament of Devotion was enough to layer Noah over 300 Million Defense Values after experiencing True Dual Enhancement- Values of Dimensional nature that were even much harder to pierce through as with his Innate Dimensional Barrier, his Defense Values alone spill over 500 Million!

And with Sever, Noah was now bound to deal over 250,000,000 Damage Values per hit after True Dual Enhancement, with this damage only increasing thereafter as if he chained it up to 50 Times....the damage would far exceed 500 Million.
This was because with every chain, the damage was further increased by 1.5%.

And on the subsequent chain, the newly enhanced damage- not the base one that Noah started with on the first chain, would get that same boost as this process continued for as many chains as Noah managed to make!
Then there was the Smite of Retribution that dished out a single target and an area of effect damage over an extremely vast distance that would equate to over 300 Million Damage Values.
Simply put, they were utterly dreadful to cast out as Noah had done all three at once!
BZZZT!
