bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1862
paragraphs: Noah's surroundings were painted with a glorious allure of white and gold as halcyon bone Armament began to wrap around him, an enormous visage of a Celestial Arch Lich Ra'Zan rising behind him as he was wrapped in a radiant gold cowl and wielding a flaming gold skull staff that shone with holy radiance!
Radiance that washed over him seamlessly as his whole figure became covered in the Lich Emperor's Armament of Devotion that would prevent damage from his enemies!

At the same time, a massive golden white bone Sword pierced across the skies as it was titanic in size, with the visage of the enthroned Arch Lich Ra'Zan sitting on a throne of golden bones pushing it down with immense weight and terror. Its size was so massive as it nearly reached the height of the three Abyssal Gigantomachia Undead, these beings having their eyes blazing with deathly flames as their titanic obsidian weapons rose to defend this descending Lich's Smite of Retribution.

It was a shocking effort to see Beta Strata LEGENDS already in their True Forms scramble to oppose the attacks of a single being as the Primogenial Strata LEGENDS of the Ancient Races in their own True Forms could defend against him!
A mere Ninth Firmament existence!
But his defensive skill and the massive sword were only the attacks that were easily seen and prevented.
There was the Assassin Emperor of Severance who had already begun to move.

His figure was moving silently as he adorned a purple robe crackling with Aether, the illusory image of multiple shattered crowns tied to this robe being visible to Noah as the face of the Assassin Emperor of Severance was shrouded in brilliant darkness!
In his hands, an incandescent scythe could be seen as it flashed with a maddening light of mortality!

This scythe within the hands of the Assassin Emperor of Severance was moving at rapid speeds as in the single microsecond, it had always silently cut across the bodies of over 10 Primogenial Strata LEGENDS as even they didn't know they were already hit.

Only the eyes of the Beta Strata LEGENDS saw a glimmer of a purple gold light chaining between their people as it was getting progressively stronger while it did so- so much stronger that if it continued so, this light might be enough to threaten even them!
"Disrupt it!"
WAA!

A Kun Peng Commander from afar spoke as his eyes shone with coldness, but the Assassin Emperor of Severance waited for no one as he weaved across the Primogenial Strata LEGENDS, where another 10 were chained once more after a microsecond as only now did the first existence that this REIFIED Sever touched feel the brutal effects.
The first existence that the Scythe of the Assassin Emperor passed through was a Chaos Hound.

The body and Destiny of this being buzzed just once as before he could even realize what had occurred, over 250 Million Dream Dimensional Soul Damage Values wrecked his Aspects of Existence to nothingness as his body exploded into a shower of bloody mist!
This was only the first chain of Sever as after this being was hit and perished so quickly, a crimson gold light flashed as a smaller image of the Saintess of Fiery Damnation bloomed.

An image of a Saintess that gazed at the bloody field in ecstasy as an instant after, her fair index finger pointed out around her as dazzling balls of flames erupted out to smash and eviscerate nearby Primogenial Strata LEGENDS!
BOOOOOM!

On the second existence that the Assassin Emperor of Severance passed through, a similar scene repeated as the existence was decimated instantly while a miniaturized Saintess of Fiery Damnation arose to bully any surrounding LEGENDS to death- this scene repeating for the first microsecond as nigh instantaneously, 10 small Saintesses of Fiery Damnation arose.

And such a scene repeated for the second microsecond that followed as when one looked at the battlefield from the skies, they would only see a zigzagging flashing purple gold light that evaded Beta Strata LEGENDS while pulverized Primogenial ones, going on to chain to 49 existences in less than 5 microseconds as its movements were too fast for the unprepared Beta Strata LEGENDS to catch it!
And all of them scrambled against this single being as his abilities were enough to make him a one man army- his movements alone wiping out thousands!
With every being that fell from Sever, the brief appearance of the Saintesses of Fiery Damnation would erase a dozen more Primogenial Strata LEGENDS.
If they were cognizant of this dominating ability and realized it had to be disrupted early, maybe it wouldn't have gotten to this.
But they realized it a few microseconds too late.

They allowed the Assassin Emperor of Severance to silently move across 49 existences before a Beta Strata LEGEND appeared before him, his body now becoming vibrantly visible to all for no reason other than the fact that he had accumulated too much essence and his 50th chain....could deal too much damage!

So much more damage as one must not forget that Noah had undergone an epiphany and infused wisps of the Natural Laws of Reality into his three recently cast abilities- their Damage and effectiveness being even more dreadful.
For the 50th chain, the target was not a Primogenial Strata LEGEND as the Assassin Emperor of Severance knew he could not evade the Beta Strata LEGENDS that had appeared before it.

After avoiding them all this time since they held a chance of disrupting the dominance of Sever, the Assassin Emperor of Severance this time turned into a flash of purple gold light while thundering straight towards the Beta Strata LEGEND.

A LEGEND...whose expression changed as his body bellowed with power, a yell blooming from him powerfully as he felt the unbelievable cluster of power surge towards him- the incandescent scythe causing his soul to vibrate in disharmony!
Who was this unnamed Beta Strata LEGENDS that Noah targeted for the last chain of Sever?

Adorned with the Lich's Armament of Devotion, Noah's eyes reflected a golden sheen of the Dictum Emperor as through them, he could see a hazy light around the many existences moving across the battlefield.
Some had hazy golden lights that were barely distinct, while others had vibrant golden lights that shone like the sun!
This was a sight granted to him as his proficiency in Destiny rose, and it told him of the enemies he had the highest chance of killing.
The vast stretches of Primogenial LEGENDS shone bright gold.

This ferocious Beta Strata Chaos Hound with glistening dark scaly fur and a draconic head that shone with the illusory light of Reality...shone with a grandeur of gold the moment that the Assassin Emperor of Severance chained for the 49th time!

So Noah commanded it to surge forth as with billowing 500+ Million Dream Dimensional Soul Damage Values and non-quantified changes brought about through him infusing wisps of the Natural Laws of Reality into it...the purple gold scythe of the Assassin Emperor of Severance swung down on a Beta Strata LEGEND.

The individuality this REIFIED skill had gained was cold and callous as its eyes radiated purple gold beams of Aether, its voice ringing out in the battlefield for the first time as it stated a word that was also a sentencing.
<DEATH>.

[Multipliers for Black Tier Ascendancy Halos correction]:: The Base multiplier granted every 10 fused Halos is 500, with there being differing additional boosts depending on the True Form. Example- For 60 Halos, Noah's current Unnamed Kainos Emperor form has an additional multiplier of 7,500(1250 per 10 Halos), while the base multiplier for fusing with 60 Black Tier Ascendancy Halos is still retained as it is 3000(500x6) . Total multiplier= 10,500!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1863
paragraphs: When the 50th chain of the Assassin Emperor of Severance landed on a Beta Strata LEGEND, so did the Lich's Smite of Retribution clash against the massive Abyssal Gigantomachia Undead- and the molten flames of three legged Reified bird tried to drown the Saintess of Fiery Damnation.
But the attention of many couldn't help but be taken by the swing of the Scythe of the Assassin Emperor of Severance!

It buzzed with danger as it targeted a Chaos Hound whose body glimmered brightly, Chaotic stellar seas bursting from its body as its reified defensive skill couldn't even rise up in time due to the speed of the attack.
The Assassin Emperor of Severance called for Death.
The 50th chain smashed down.
And like a blinding sun of destructive Aether exploding, the force was mighty!
BOOOOOM!

Over 500 Million Dream Dimensional Damage Soul Values smashed into the Olden visage of this being as it was an utterly dreadful type of Damage to take up close- and this included the unknown changes brought about by Noah infusing wisps of the Natural Laws of Reality...and even the full effects of his Infinite Reality Passages that hadn't been fully quantified yet.
It was made even worse when one wasn't prepared for it, its unique aspects wrecking across the very Strata of its enemy as there was even a reality that was maddening to understand.

The reality that this damage was taken in full as there wasn't any Realm Suppression between Noah who was the attacker at the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy and the Beta Strata LEGENDS who had achieved the second stage in the Realm of Reality!
No Realm Suppression!
What did this mean?

Others may not know, but Noah knew that under his current Origin, the Primogenial Strata LEGENDS would actually face a level of suppression from him as they were considered a weaker Origin, with the Beta Strata actually being seen on the same level as his current Dream Dimensional Reality Seed.
This...was before he even broke through to form his genuine Paramount Kainos Dream Dimensional Reality!
"GAAAH!"

The Soul of the Beta Strata LEGENDS cried out painfully and with horror as its barriers of defense were shredded apart, its crystallized soul becoming bathed and ravaged with essence that was dimming everything about it.
Crystallized!

After the liquified soul sea of the Primogenial Strata, LEGENDS had to become capable enough to turn this vast sea into a crystalline form as it was extremely hard for a Crystallized Soul to be destroyed.

And yet it was nearly so at this time as the incandescent manifestation of this being soul nearly had everything about it sapped! The Beta Strata LEGENDS was on his last legs, but he barely held on from falling to eternal slumber from the ravaging Dream essence!
But...the attack of the Assassin Emperor of Severance was twofold.
From the 50th Chain, the Saintess of Fiery Damnation rose as her devilishly beautiful face was filled with unbound happiness.
Her fair hands reached out to the damaged body of the Beta Strata LEGENDS as with laughter that would be remembered by all...
BRRRRR!

Hundreds of Fireballs bloomed as they were the last nail of the coffin, the figure of the Beta Strata LEGEND imploding and becoming immolated as it burst into a shower and chunks of bloody flames an instant later!
The field of battle slowed.
Akaris and Ezekiel turned to gaze at this shocking scene.
The Beta Strata LEGENDS they faced did the same and their faces became grim and filled with rage!
The Aspects of Existence that made up a Beta Strata LEGEND...perished at this moment from a mere Ninth Firmament existence.
Utter silence pervaded the surroundings as even those in the midst of attacks found themselves coming to a lull!
Amidst all this, a voice filled with tyranny thundered in the ears of all as the perpetrator of this event spoke out.
"Merely of the Beta Strata, nothing much!"
WAA!
A domineering voice that didn't put the distinguished beings that was just killed in its eyes!
A voice with anger inducing words that didn't just complement the astounding scene, but also a signal for an explosive force against the Legions of Millions that observed this scene!
It was the major turning point of the many powerful existences from these vast ancient Legions turning their heads towards a single being!
A being that after eradicating a Beta Strata LEGEND, his eyes shone with glory as he saw a half Black and Gold Randomized Loot Crate rise.
A being whose eyes shone as he watched the Assassin Emperor of Severance...go towards the 51st Chain.
This was because Sever was never stopped after the death of this Beta Strata LEGEND! It could continue!

The scythe on the Assassin Emperor of Severance pulsed with even more power as it tore towards another Beta Strata LEGEND that had been rushing towards it, but would it really be left alone after all this?
"Preposterous!"
BOOOM!
The visage of a mighty Kun Peng descended beside a Moon Luminoid that was about to be hit with another Chain of Sever.
<Vajra Luminescent Emperor>
DING!
A REIFIED ability instantly formed above the Kun Peng as an enormous humanoid golden statue sporting a fat belly and tout muscles bloomed, his hands massive as they covered the skies.

This golden statue blankly opened its eyes as its hands moved at ridiculous speeds, intercepting the coming Assassin Emperor of Severance as the targetted Moon Luminoid also released a radiant eclipsed moon to block off any paths of retreat!
BZZZZT!

The abilities clashed as a horrific metallic sound boomed while smashing into the golden hands of the Vajra Statue. The eclipsed moon came from behind as it also released a ring of silver light that constricted the Assassin Emperor of Severance even further.
With valiance and power, the body of the enormous Kun Peng illuminated gold as it roared out- the Vajra Statue it called out shining with an even brighter luster!
"BREAK!"
WAA!
With the effort and might of two Beta Strata LEGENDS, the Assassin Emperor of Severance sneered as its body began to fade.
For the first strike of Sever, it could only claim a few hundred Primogenial Strata LEGENDS and one Beta Strata.
This...was the might of an ability that had no resource cost for Noah!
It was a shocking show of power, but also an action that signified the clustering of attention of many powerful beings unto Noah.
SHAA!
The auras of multiple Beta Strata LEGENDS rose as tens of thousands of Primogenial Strata LEGENDS moved behind them.

More Kun Pengs, Moon Luminoids, Three-Headed Ogres, Chaos Hounds, Mushroom Emperors....over a dozen Beta Strata Commanders appeared one after another around the periphery of the existence adorning the form of a human with radiant wings and stature of glory.
The Legions of millions...seemed to all be focusing their gazes towards a single spot!

But the attention of many couldn't help but be taken by the swing of the Scythe of the Assassin Emperor of Severance!

It buzzed with danger as it targeted a Chaos Hound whose body glimmered brightly, Chaotic stellar seas bursting from its body as its reified defensive skill couldn't even rise up in time due to the speed of the attack.
The Assassin Emperor of Severance called for Death.
The 50th chain smashed down.
And like a blinding sun of destructive Aether exploding, the force was mighty!
BOOOOOM!

Over 500 Million Dream Dimensional Damage Soul Values smashed into the Olden visage of this being as it was an utterly dreadful type of Damage to take up close- and this included the unknown changes brought about by Noah infusing wisps of the Natural Laws of Reality...and even the full effects of his Infinite Reality Passages that hadn't been fully quantified yet.
It was made even worse when one wasn't prepared for it, its unique aspects wrecking across the very Strata of its enemy as there was even a reality that was maddening to understand.

The reality that this damage was taken in full as there wasn't any Realm Suppression between Noah who was the attacker at the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy and the Beta Strata LEGENDS who had achieved the second stage in the Realm of Reality!
No Realm Suppression!
What did this mean?

Others may not know, but Noah knew that under his current Origin, the Primogenial Strata LEGENDS would actually face a level of suppression from him as they were considered a weaker Origin, with the Beta Strata actually being seen on the same level as his current Dream Dimensional Reality Seed.
This...was before he even broke through to form his genuine Paramount Kainos Dream Dimensional Reality!
"GAAAH!"

The Soul of the Beta Strata LEGENDS cried out painfully and with horror as its barriers of defense were shredded apart, its crystallized soul becoming bathed and ravaged with essence that was dimming everything about it.
Crystallized!

After the liquified soul sea of the Primogenial Strata, LEGENDS had to become capable enough to turn this vast sea into a crystalline form as it was extremely hard for a Crystallized Soul to be destroyed.
And yet it was nearly so at this time as the incandescent manifestation of this being soul nearly had everything about it sapped!
The Beta Strata LEGENDS was on his last legs, but he barely held on from falling to eternal slumber from the ravaging Dream essence!
But...the attack of the Assassin Emperor of Severance was twofold.
From the 50th Chain, the Saintess of Fiery Damnation rose as her devilishly beautiful face was filled with unbound happiness.
Her fair hands reached out to the damaged body of the Beta Strata LEGENDS as with laughter that would be remembered by all...
BRRRRR!

Hundreds of Fireballs bloomed as they were the last nail of the coffin, the figure of the Beta Strata LEGEND imploding and becoming immolated as it burst into a shower and chunks of bloody flames an instant later!
The field of battle slowed.
Akaris and Ezekiel turned to gaze at this shocking scene.
The Beta Strata LEGENDS they faced did the same and their faces became grim and filled with rage!
The Aspects of Existence that made up a Beta Strata LEGEND...perished at this moment from a mere Ninth Firmament existence.
Utter silence pervaded the surroundings as even those in the midst of attacks found themselves coming to a lull!
Amidst all this, a voice filled with tyranny thundered in the ears of all as the perpetrator of this event spoke out.
"Merely of the Beta Strata, nothing much!"
WAA!
A domineering voice that didn't put the distinguished beings that was just killed in its eyes!
A voice with anger inducing words that didn't just complement the astounding scene, but also a signal for an explosive force against the Legions of Millions that observed this scene!
It was the major turning point of the many powerful existences from these vast ancient Legions turning their heads towards a single being!
A being that after eradicating a Beta Strata LEGEND, his eyes shone with glory as he saw a half Black and Gold Randomized Loot Crate rise.
A being whose eyes shone as he watched the Assassin Emperor of Severance...go towards the 51st Chain.
This was because Sever was never stopped after the death of this Beta Strata LEGEND!
It could continue!

The scythe on the Assassin Emperor of Severance pulsed with even more power as it tore towards another Beta Strata LEGEND that had been rushing towards it, but would it really be left alone after all this?
"Preposterous!"
BOOOM!
The visage of a mighty Kun Peng descended beside a Moon Luminoid that was about to be hit with another Chain of Sever.
<Vajra Luminescent Emperor>
DING!

paragraphs: Blue and gold bounced off of Noah as his eyes held boundless coldness and tyranny even while the powerful Kun Peng that had stopped Sever bellowed out!
"Long distance attacks focused on this creature. Whatever move he makes and whatever skill he casts- intercept it!"
"HO!"
Bellows of affirmation came as the skies became littered with incandescent lights.

The Reification of Fiery concepts, glacial abilities, thunderous storms of Reality, constructs of massive weapons...many REIFIED abilities began to bloom as the remaining Pure-Blooded Primordials shuddered before they could even celebrate the shocking feat of one of their geniuses.

Noah gazed at this all as his Smite of Retribution pushed back an Abyssal Gigantomachia Undead while a storm of bones erupted from it to cover a wide region that killed hundreds of Primogenial LEGENDS!
He watched as his Saintess of Fiery Damnation was unphased under the attack of a Kun Peng as she laughed and rained down endless balls of flames!
He looked at the Beta Strata LEGENDS clumping up against him and the countless attacks beginning to rise as his voice boomed out across the battlefield with boundless tyranny.
"What great Emperors you are."
WAA!
Ascendant Reality Sever was cast once more as the eyes of Beta Strata LEGENDS focused on it to disrupt it.
"To be scrambling before me like this..."

His voice built up like a crescendo as when he saw the countless REIFIED abilities from Primogenial Strata LEGENDS flying towards him, his Reality Passages above glimmered with light as his Origin did the same- releasing a light of suppression that these Primogenial LEGENDS could not overcome!

Towards their advance and actions, Emperor's Haki was infused in Noah's last words as he used his billowing will and suppression of his unique Origin and Reality Passages to counter thousands of coming REIFIED abilities.
"...you are not deserving to be Emperors!"
BOOOM!
Haki bellowed out as boundless waves of gold oppressively smashed towards Noah's enemies!
And he wasn't moving alone as with his words and actions, the remaining Pure-Blooded Primordial Geniuses moved.
Akaris gazed at the unfolding scenes with utmost coldness as she held back a Beta Strata LEGEND.
She could feel the erosion in her soul getting extremely potent, and yet even more Beta Strata LEGENDS appeared at this time!
'And if this newly appearing guy can kill one, what am I waiting for?'
Her thoughts were vibrant as even though casting Shield Maiden caused her soul to become eroded, it was actually bursting with even more power at this moment.
This was because she had done something shocking to her soul.
To cast abilities while controlling the Essence of Natural Laws of Reality she didn't understand came at a great cost, but she found a way to not pay this cost.
Through her...construct- she took the erosion of her soul and turned it into a strength!
BZZZT!

Her liquified soul that she had broken the limits of vibrated as the areas of erosion burned with golden flames at this moment, releasing an essence that spread out across Akaris's body and caused her to be even more luminous.
She was a being that many didn't understand.
She was a being that even Alpha Strata LEGENDS couldn't look at in disdain!
The more she fought...the more powerful she became.
After seeing the erosion of her soul and impossibly burning this up for even more power, she could finally utilize that.
An ability that caused her to be undefeated when she sparred with Beta Strata LEGENDS!
She closed her eyes as she breathed out and called out slowly.
It was a skill...and it was also a distinction.
As for what it truly meant?
"Shield of Dawn."
The vast Realities would come to know!
...BOOOOM!
Glory bloomed with even more fervor.
From the skies, massive golden shields of light began to descend in a unique formation.
Watching this scene were many beings, with some beings in particular deserving of some of the attention.
Among the folds of space, hidden from the eyes of all beings- was an existence currently grasping an incandescent Techo Relic, a sniper's rifle that clustered with waves of TABOO.
Her body glimmered with astral light as she had taken her True form silently, her gorgeous visage being hidden from the eyes of many as she was lying in wait to deal the most destructive damage!
This was the job of a sniper.
To go in and out unseen as their targets wouldn't even know how they died!

Elora breathed out waves of TABOO as her rifle buzzed with power. Her scope uniquely wasn't locked out to any of the masses of Ancient Legions, and it was actually following someone else that remained hidden and was weaving across the Legions of Ancient Races like nothing!
The Ancient Races also weren't reacting to her as at this moment, the aura she gave off was similar to theirs.

Elora had coincidentally found her as she left the ranks of Pure-Blooded Primordials and delved into the Legions of Ancient Races like nothing- the light around this existence being extremely dark and vile unlike anything she had seen before!
An existence that was in the ranks of Primordials who was actually an operative of the Ancient Races.
"Be patient, Little Barret. We shall strike at the most crucial time for this big baddie..."
She stroked her rifle as she waited for a chance to rise.
A chance to assassinate none other than the hidden figure of Genevieve!
Towards the center of the clusters of Ancient Legions.
All those in these Legions had the dense aura of Ancient Races- something that couldn't be replicated unless one had a Bloodline corresponding to it!
And Genevieve...had something much more wondrous.
Her gaze went behind her as she saw the shocking situation unfolding around the one she chose as an enemy- Alexander King!
'No fucking way he's just a Chosen Emperor. The hell is that?'
Her mind and Destiny buzzed with somberness as she turned back to the target ahead of her sitting on a throne of blazing flames.

There were still over a dozen Kun Pengs around him as she wouldn't be able to get past them with her aura alone, so she stopped in the midst of the Legion of Abyssal Death Knights as she sent waves of a mental message.
"He gets stronger off devouring the strength of his enemies. You need to use an explosive and undeniable force right now before any more LEGENDS get their strength added to his."
WAA!
Her words were sharp and precise as the existence upon the fiery throne of flames locked onto her instantly!
His eyes shone with astounding luminosity as Valdez Tepez spoke out with regality.
"You are...."
"A representative from the Olden Alliance that has been hidden among the ranks of Primordials that whole time..."
The weaving of destiny turned tumultuous and wild as two beings from different generations got in contact!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1865
paragraphs: One stemmed from an extremely far away era, while the other was born with the potential to lead a brand new era.
At this moment, the Wills of these two beings connected as Genevieve and Valdez reached out to each other!
Valdez Tepez was looking dubiously at the visage of Genevieve and the eaves of power she released, her Bloodline undoubtedly being purer than most beings here as it could not be falsified.
"But your strength..."

"Ground down by the vicissitudes of time and Primordials while I lay in slumber. I've lost contact with others as I know not where my brethren now call home, nor who our allies are. This and more I wish to find out, but now is not the time. Alexander King...he needs to perish sooner rather than later!"
Genevieve's voice was steadfast as she repeated herself, Valdez's eyes shimmering with the flames of destiny as his thoughts were unknown.
Even after the shocking scenes shown by a few prominent existences ahead, this being had never faltered- and nor had his destiny.
He gazed silently towards the far away location that was radiating vast waves of golden lights as he spoke.
"Unless an existence is of the Alpha Strata in this Nest..."
HUUUM!
His visage, ever so slowly...began to rise from his throne of flames.
"...they can forget about coming out alive."

As he rose, the over a dozen Kun Peng Beta Strata Commanders began to buzz with activity, this being commanding great honor and respect as he seemed to be carrying an unbearable weight on his shoulders!
Incandescent golden flames began to burn around him as his hand once more rose, the Legions of Millions reacting as they all began to surge forward maddeningly like a wave.
A wave that threatened to overwhelm the puny cluster of Primordials once and for all as while this wave began to tumble out, so did its Commander.
So did Valdez Tepez!
And amidst it all, the visage of Genevieve seemed to fade in the Legion of millions!
Meanwhile, the small cluster of Pure-Blooded Primordials gazed at this all as the gazes that were just re-energized turned solemn with depreciating looks.
Many were clustered around the powerful individuals who could stand against their enemies as the largest cluster was around the figures of Noah, Ezekiel, and Katelyn.

The next largest cluster was around the Young Emperor as destiny surged around him while he commanded dozens of newly advanced Primogenial Strata LEGENDS to fight- with the Reality whether they could withstand a Beta Strata LEGEND still unknown!
Another cluster was around Juliette as Reality Ursidae and Infinite Willow Trees maneuvered around her surging stellar flames- their enemies being kept at bay!
Then there was the area where no beings neared.

This area was where the existence with the shining distinction of SACRALIZED was maddeningly exploding with power as silver feathered wings erupted behind her, her entire skin turning crystalline as her forehead had split to show a buzzing mirror crystal in the shape of an octagon!
To her left and right, horrifically powerful silver Halos of light formed- with this scene repeating below her, above her, in front of her, and behind her.
6 dazzling silvery Halos that seemed detached from Ascendancy Halos formed, their center revealing shining mirrors that showed stretches of Mirror Beasts hidden within them!
Mirror Beasts that seemed to be in the thousands...and each one blazed with a light of the Primogenial Strata.
A Dimensional Royalty.
Just what would their Lineage and power grant them access to?
It was a question many would not know the answer to as even now, Katelyn herself wasn't paying attention to it.

She was gazing at the bloody mist that remained of Nefertiti as she had absorbed it into a mirror, and her power now surged into this Mirror as it caused Reality itself to fracture and cause the blooming of over a dozen more Mirrors!
Each one showed a different scene as in some, the golden mist was replaced with body parts while in others it remained just as it was.
"AAAAH!"

She released a bellow that pushed back the Chaos Hound that had done all this as even more mirrors proliferated until finally, Katelyn came across a mirror that didn't show a bloody mist or mere body parts.
Within it, she could see the dazzling figure of Nefertiti with her eyes closed. The moment this mirror rose, Katelyn reached out for it with everything she had and pulled!
Pulled a version of reality...that was different from what had occurred previously.
BZZZT!

Shocking waves of essence surged as even the Natural Laws of Reality buzzed chaotically, Mirror Essence pervading everything here as the countless Mirrors shattered to reveal the floating figure of Nefertiti.
She seemed the same from all aspects as Katelyn's essence flowed towards her hopefully, the eyes of this figure opening as when she saw them- Katelyn couldn't help but be burdened with rage.
The eyes...were blank without any sign of consciousness.
They remained blank as they gazed forward, silver light blooming from Katelyn as she waved her hands to put this visage of Nefertiti away while turning towards the one who had done all this!

The massive Chaos Hound felt its soul and Destiny buzz as a cold chill permeated across its Aspects of Existence, the Dimensional Royalty before his eyes utterly enraged at this moment as her vast stretches of silvery wings rose, her fair crystalline hands pointing forward and calling for blood as from the 6 silvery mirror-like Halos, Mirror Beast LEGENDS began to surge out!
Shocking scenes like this were occurring all around and one after another as the unfolding battle was large in scale.
As things shifted and changed, the one who had the focus of everything at this moment was watching it all play out in slow motion.
Yes, he had managed to kill a Beta Strata LEGEND.
It was a shocking feat, but now, Dozens more were coming as the big boss of this Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest was making his move.
Noah had many tools under his belt, but it wasn't enough to withstand dozens of Beta Strata LEGENDS while dishing out enough Damage to eradicate them!
Something had to be done to make that possible.
Something like him taking on his Ascendant True Form that held a ridiculous multiplier and had shocking features like the Primogenial Ascendancy Domain.
But the time for it would be too brief!
It's cost was too high!
So how would Noah overcome this?
SHIING!
His destiny buzzed as it led him towards the newly formed Black Gold Randomized Loot Crate stemming from a Beta Strata LEGEND.
Something that only he could see that had surged into his Expansive Space, and he called out to it at this moment.
"Open."
Brilliant gold and black light surged.
A Randomized Loot Crate from an existence that had crystallized their soul.
It's wonders....
<1 Ascendant Dimensional Shard has been attained.>
Began with a bang!

Shocking waves of essence surged as even the Natural Laws of Reality buzzed chaotically, Mirror Essence pervading everything here as the countless Mirrors shattered to reveal the floating figure of Nefertiti.
She seemed the same from all aspects as Katelyn's essence flowed towards her hopefully, the eyes of this figure opening as when she saw them- Katelyn couldn't help but be burdened with rage.
The eyes...were blank without any sign of consciousness.
They remained blank as they gazed forward, silver light blooming from Katelyn as she waved her hands to put this visage of Nefertiti away while turning towards the one who had done all this!

The massive Chaos Hound felt its soul and Destiny buzz as a cold chill permeated across its Aspects of Existence, the Dimensional Royalty before his eyes utterly enraged at this moment as her vast stretches of silvery wings rose, her fair crystalline hands pointing forward and calling for blood as from the 6 silvery mirror-like Halos, Mirror Beast LEGENDS began to surge out!
Shocking scenes like this were occurring all around and one after another as the unfolding battle was large in scale.
As things shifted and changed, the one who had the focus of everything at this moment was watching it all play out in slow motion.
Yes, he had managed to kill a Beta Strata LEGEND.
It was a shocking feat, but now, Dozens more were coming as the big boss of this Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest was making his move.
Noah had many tools under his belt, but it wasn't enough to withstand dozens of Beta Strata LEGENDS while dishing out enough Damage to eradicate them!
Something had to be done to make that possible.
Something like him taking on his Ascendant True Form that held a ridiculous multiplier and had shocking features like the Primogenial Ascendancy Domain.
But the time for it would be too brief!
It's cost was too high!
So how would Noah overcome this?
SHIING!
His destiny buzzed as it led him towards the newly formed Black Gold Randomized Loot Crate stemming from a Beta Strata LEGEND.
Something that only he could see that had surged into his Expansive Space, and he called out to it at this moment.
"Open."
Brilliant gold and black light surged.
A Randomized Loot Crate from an existence that had crystallized their soul.
It's wonders....
<1 Ascendant Dimensional Shard has been attained.>
Began with a bang!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1866
paragraphs: The Randomized Loot Crates Noah could choose as loot were gorgeous constructs that could grant him a myriad of new things he didn't know of, and if they were high ranking enough, they could even grant him Loot that had appeared before in previous Resplendent Treasure Caches!
The first thing to drop from this Black and Gold Randomized Loot Crate turned out to be the glorious Ascendant Dimensional Shard that had made many impossible things probable for Noah.
And the wonders of the Black Gold Randomized Loot Crate continued.
<8 Supreme Dimensional Bloodline Shards have been attained. Attaining 10 Shards will allow for the birth of a Supreme Dimensional Bloodline.>
<The memoir 'A Dog's Life' has been attained.>
<10 Seeds of Nature that contain purified wisps of the Essence of Natural Laws of Reality have been attained.>
Pure glory and wonder bloomed before Noah as old and new loot bloomed.
The Ascendant Dimensional Shard he knew and loved, and then there were the Seeds of Nature and a memoir!
<A Dog's Life>:: Woof...
<Seed of Nature>:: A seed containing condensed Wisps of Natural Laws of Reality that can be applied to any concept.
The descriptions of the two new loot were dazzling as <A Dog's Life> was a dud containing the memories of the Chaos Hound as he crossed the Niflheim Dimension, while the Seeds of Nature...
They were something astounding!
Seeds of TABOO were accumulations of wisps of Natural Laws of Reality that could be granted to a concept to attain a TABOO Edict.
Seeds of Nature...were uniquely similar, but with one major difference. They didn't state that they were to be used to elevate an Edict to TABOO!

They merely stated that a Seed of Nature could be applied to any concept! So Noah could apply it to a concept and have it become a TABOO Edict...or he could apply a Seed of Nature to an already TABOO Edict to see what profound changes there could be.

To reach the stage above TABOO, one had to isolate the Essence of a single Natural Law of Reality into a concept. It meant being able to at least distinguish between the Natural Laws, and then only being able to pull from a single one!
So what would happen from continuing to pack wisps of Natural Laws of Reality into a concept?
This was something Noah had to find out as with this thought, he came to focus on the dazzling Ascendant Dimensional Shard.
Noah had promised himself to always keep 1 Ascendant Dimensional Shard on hand in case an extremely ridiculous ability came that he had to cut off the resource cost of.
He hadn't come across any ability that he couldn't utilize an Ascendant Dimensional Shard on, nor did he wish to come upon such abilities anytime soon.

He had attained 4 in total from the Resplendent Treasure Caches, with three being used up on Ascendant Reality Sever, Concept Corruption, and Runic Bloodline Inscription that was constantly increasing his defense!
Now, he had attained 1 more as his stock was replenished to two!
It was an answer to the current predicament that he had to utilize.

There were many high resource cost abilities that came to mind when it came to the usage of Ascendant Dimensional Shards, with something like <Empyral Mitahara> being at the very forefront as it would allow Noah to bypass the ridiculous cost of forging Empyral Bones, Organs, and Musculature- but Noah couldn't begin this now when he hadn't resonated his Aspects of Existence!
The more immediate abilities to think of was something defensive as he already had Sever that covered offense, and the ability that would allow him to take his strongest form without any cost.
Sanguine Ascendancy Domain.
Something that only powerful LEGENDS with extreme proficiency in their Halos attained, where their Halos could be fused to bring about a domain!

Noah had yet to see this with any of the Primogenial Strata LEGENDS or Beta Strata so far- and this either told one of how hard it was to achieve this state, or that it's cost was so high that even Beta Strata LEGENDS had not unleashed this power yet.

For Noah, he had the base multiplier of 3,000 by fusing with 60 Ascendancy Halos, or 3,500 if he went all out and utilized LETHE's authority as well. To top off this base multiplier would be the additional boosts of the Ascendant True Form that amounted to 15,000.
Both these multipliers put together guaranteed a range of 300-500 Million Damage and Defense Values for Noah as matching and decimating weak or average Beta Strata LEGENDS would be easy!
He would be covered offensively and in terms of powering up, but he wasn't yet covered defensively as Noah couldn't maintain the Ascendant Lich's Armament of Devotion for too long.
So the answer for him to run wild in this Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest was clear.
WAA!
In the Dimensional Holy Land, Noah floated on a dazzling Throne of Unnamed Tyranny as two Crystals floated before his eyes.
Two Ascendant Dimensional Shards!
"If I can attain some, I can attain more..."

His voice was maddeningly powerful at this moment as he was doing too many fantastical things, his throne being surrounded by False Grotto Nacres that were constantly broken down into golden liquid that surged into his Origin, Liquified Soul Seas that surged towards his soul, and Physique Refining Pearls that surged towards the musculature of his Body!

All of this was propelling his new Realm even higher as even though it was extremely hard to form the Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos, when Nkah was getting Loot from Thousands of LEGENDS...Reality couldn't help but be broken as he speedily filled his Dream Dimensional Reality Seed with the massive golden Cosmos.
Cosmos that had currently spilled over 1.5 Trillion.
Yes!

He had already surpassed the 'Absolute limitation of 1 Trillion Cosmos with his new Origin, with the requirements to form his first layer of a Dimensional Reality being too great as such a construct needed too much energy.
And yet...he was doing it.

He was continuing to forge as while thousands of microseconds passed in the Dimensional Holy Land, he knew that he would reach Saturation of his Aspects of Existence soon enough with the constant inflow of loot that continued to get Sextupled by RUINATION!

So while this occured, he prepared to sacrifice the poor souls required to keep this loot coming- his will surging out and crushing the two Ascendant Dimensional Shards as he went against his original thought of always keeping one handy.
He had yet to use a single Resplendent Treasure Cache.
There were still dozens of Beta Strata LEGENDS to form Randomized Loot Crates that would still grant a chance to attain more Ascendant Dimensional Shards!
"Go forth."
His voice boomed out as the Essence of two Ascendant Dimensional Shard surged towards two abilities...ridiculously going forward with the goal of making them cost absolutely no resource to cast!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1867
paragraphs: Radiant essence surged around the Throne of Unnamed Tyranny as it was a scene of utter glory for any who could witness it.
<Resonance of Nature> continued to be utilized by Noah as he sensed the constant push and pull of all of these essences and how they interacted with him.
, m How the Natural Laws of Reality reacted to what he was doing!
THUMP!

He continued to sense everything with clarity as he knew in the near future, his comprehension of all these things with the Resonance of Nature would allow him to exceed his limitation in Edicts and begin to understand the Natural Laws of Reality and the Decretum of Dimensions.
And now, he watched as two concepts fundamentally changed within him.
Ascendant Lich's Armament of Devotion.
Sanguine Ascendancy Domain.

They had the Limitations and restrictions like all other abilities as they had an extremely high cost, and this fundamental nature of these abilities went on to be altered by the unique Ascendant Dimensional Shards as their resource cost was nullified!
One ability provided Noah with bolstrous defense to withstand Beta Strata LEGENDS.
Another granted him his strongest form as the price was too much for him to pay for too long while also casting other skills, but this all changed at this moment!

These two abilities joined the ranks of Ascendant Reality Sever, Concept Corruption, and Runic Bloodline Inscription at this moment to become part of the 5 abilities that had complete nullification to resource cost.
OOOM!

Noah's body surged with even more radiance as his Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos continued to proliferate while his Dream Dimensional Soul continued to expand and become an even brighter gold. His Dream Dimensional Body became even more thought as it could no doubt handle 20 Cycles of the Infinite Dream Physique if not much more!
But this would take time.
Of course, the time scale would be in the Dimensional Holy Land, with the results of Noah's actions showing themselves onto the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest soon enough!
So with his actions completed, he let things run their course as a majority of his will focused on the crucial events unfolding in the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest.
The surging apocalyptic waves of Primogenial LEGENDS.
The billowing auras of dozens of Beta Strata LEGENDS surging forward!
The single existence who had risen from his throne of flames as he moved across the skies like a radiant meteor, his body painted with the aura of a monarch as his right hand....oh was it bright!
Out of everything, his hand shone with such domineering and bright incandescence as it represented part of the heavy weight he carried.
All of these beings were surging towards Noah as survival was not assured nor guaranteed the way things were right now.
Even as to the left of Noah...the Sword of Avalon pointed to the sky.

The visage of Ezekiel gazed at the radiant golden shields blooming around them and cast from Akaris as he raised his sword, his will stable and unfettered as he came to lock onto Noah's figure briefly!
His mind was free of unneeded thoughts as only a single one crossed his mind, with him knowing very well that he couldn't take it back when he made this move here!
'To die with honor...is far better than to live in disgrace. Though, I do not plan on dying...'
WAA!
<Knights of Avalon>.
The Decretum of a Dimension buzzed with glory.
Its unique ruling came down as dense purple Dimensional essence surged, slowly forming a regal illusory image of a round table that currently had a dozen existences rising!
Existences whose levels of power were utterly ridiculous as even while calling out to them with the Decretum of a Dimension, the Sword of Avalon in Ezekiel's hand was trembling!
This was what was happening around Noah.
Existences revealing their powerful cards in order to survive against the coming Apocalypse, but he didn't just plan to survive.
He planned...to be the one that brought the Apocalypse!
<Sanguine Ascendancy Domain>.
Time came to a halt.

Stemming from Noah, a massive yet sharp pillar of golden light rose up before rushing back down unto him, causing the scene of a myriad of Halos erupting from his body as they flashed with light and resonated with each other!
It wasn't just 60 at this time as Noah pulled out the 10 from LETHE as well.
Dazzling Ascendancy Halos that showed a golden grandeur of light with some dark bloomed for an instant before they buzzed and began sinking into each other seamlessly!

It occurred at an extremely rapid pace as in no time, Noah's body seemed to be surrounded by a dazzling cylindrical pillar of light that covered him entirely- this pillar giving the illusion of stretching endlessly both top and bottom as it fused into him an instant later.
As he took on his Ascendant Unnamed Kainos Emperor True Form!
HOOONG!

A maddening flash of light bloomed as the events were unfolding ridiculously fast, where due to the coming enemies- Noah finished the transformation in less than a microsecond as the shower of lights didn't continue for longer than required.
The moment it completed, a circular wave of dominion and light surged from Noah silently as it went on to cover vast stretches of land!
A Domain.
The Sanguine Ascendancy Domain!
It was silent and transparent as it was hard to say who if any beings noticed it.
As for his transformation...it could take on many forms as Noah has the Aspects of all his current Bloodlines fused into this Ascendant Unnamed Kainos Emperor True Form.
So he chose his attire and adornment as even the visual effects of the Lich's Armament of Devotion that caused a radiant golden skull Armament to drape over him was made illusory.

There was no massive aurora of wings behind his back as one could see dazzling spinning black halos spinning behind him and below the soles of his feet- feet that were adorned in black Oxford shoes, his lower half sporting sleek obsidian dress pants as a slim fitting white dress shirt hugged his muscular upper body!
The curvature of the 8 packs could be seen from the shirt as golden light vibrated over his skin from the Innate Dimensional Barrier.
His hair normally took a myriad of colors, but it was simply a sleek black at this moment.

He didn't leak wild waves of power as everything seemed contained, the only radiant thing being the Luminous light in his eyes and the small pulsing black halos that were spinning below his feet and those positioned on his back!

The figure of the reified Celestial Arch Lich Ra'Zan could still be seen behind him, Noah currently releasing a silent light of contained tyranny as he seemed like a bomb that could explode at any time!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1868
paragraphs: The vast waves of surging LEGENDS were given a show of utmost glory.

All radiance and luminosity faded as an astoundingly devilish young man appeared before everyone, a tight white shirt and Obsidian pants hugging him as miniature black halos of light spun below and behind him!

With this form active, the horrific pressure this being released seemed to all but fade away as the nearby Primogenial Strata LEGENDS breathed easier, but this didn't last long as this being raised his left and right hand an instant later.
SHAA!
His chest shone with a glorious silver light as a crimson and stellar beam of light shot out.
One went towards his left hand and one to his right- the appearance of these lights bringing down their own horrific pressure.
When the scene was clear, one could see his left hand grasping a massive silver golden sword while his right hand came to hold on to a massive golden purple blue spear of stellar wonders!
The Emperor's Ruined Blade of Oblivion and the Atlatl of Reality had arrived.

The existence wielding them had his crown spinning majestically atop a barely completed throne behind him, his visage eye catching and unforgettable as he pointed the Atlatl of Reality towards the vast sea of enemies with coldness and disdain, his voice blazing out with utmost majesty.
"Emperor's Haki."
Billowing waves of pure will and mental energy bloomed out like surging seas to meet the waves of rushing LEGENDS.
It was the same move Noah had begun with before, but it was vastly different at this moment!
This was because he now adorned 70 Halos.
Halos that had all come together to form the Sanguine Ascendancy Domain that had a few ridiculous abilities to say the least!
First was the suppression of all those under its Domain.
Second was the disruption of abilities up to the level of REIFIED ones as they could be entirely canceled!
Then...there was the Primogenial Sealing.
The capability of the Sanguine Ascendancy Domain to Lock down 2 Aspects of Existence up to the Primogenial Strata- along with anchoring them to the surrounding space!

It was truly top domineering as the nearby tens of thousands of LEGENDS in the vicinity of Noah's Domain suddenly felt their bodies come to a halt, seemingly anchored right where they stood as their Souls and Origins came under an undeniable and heavy wieght!
A weight that made it so they couldn't even lift a single ounce of essence from their own Origins or Souls.
'This....'
The thoughts of these minor characters undeserving of names turned tumultuous as their destinies dimmed entirely.
While their Souls and Origins were sealed, the billowing Haki of an Emperor in his True Form surged over them as it was purely Dream Dimensional Soul Damage Values!
With two of their strongest Aspects sealed...they were truly helpless as they couldn't do anything.

What was Noah's damage at this moment? With 70 Ascendancy Halos, the base multiplier of the Halos became 3500 while the additional multiplier due to his Ascendant Unnamed Kainos Emperor True Form that should have cost a great deal of essence but now cost 0- it granted 17,500!
This was a 21,000x multiplier as with Noah's close to 10,000 Base Damage Values in addition to the Atlatl of Reality he now held, a single attack from him was over 200 Million Damage Values.
When doubled by the Throne of Unnamed Tyranny, over 400 Million Damage Values were easily dished out.
It was...simply bullying Primogenial Strata LEGENDS at this point.
BOOOOM!
The billowing will of the Unnamed Kainos Emperor descended onto anchored and suppressed Primogenial LEGENDS as everywhere his Haki passed...the lives of tens of thousands of LEGENDS dimmed!
Tens of thousands of Primogenial Strata LEGENDS!

As for the nearby Beta Strata LEGENDS who had already seen one of their fall, they were somewhat prepared as Defensive Skills had surrounded them powerfully, but many of them still turned ashen as they gazed forward in shock!
<An Astounding Achievement!>
WAA!
<Over 10,000 Kainos Candidate Emperors have fallen under your authority at once.>
<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age has risen greatly.>
Essence raged madly as tens of thousands of Mushroom Emperors, Chaos Hounds, Moon Luminoids, Oblivion Ursidae, Virulent Drakes, Celestial Sharks, and even some Kun Pengs fell!
The backbone of the Throne behind Noah gained a few more glimmering points of light as he shone with astounding radiance.
And he seemed to just be beginning as soon after, he called out with glory while his figure began to fly forward- while he shockingly delved towards the Legions of Millions of LEGENDS.
"Sever."
And the more shocking thing...was the fact that the ashen LEGENDS that had to withstand Dream Dimensional Soul Damage floated backwards!
WAA!
Beta Strata LEGENDS...unconsciously retreated at the advancement of a single Ninth Firmament existence!
What a glorious achievement.
What glorious might and tyranny!

Noah paid no attention to this as he watched another Assassin Emperor of Severance manifest, with him being able to call out one at a time as this was an ability that was cast and then kept active while it chained.

But the Saintess of Fiery Damnation still had 5 seconds of active time as she continued to tain down fiery death, Noah now raising his left hand holding the Emperor's Ruined Blade of Oblivion as it flashed with a silver light that reflected onto the anchored corpses of tens of thousands of Primogenial Strata LEGENDS that would never wake again- their bodies all disappearing soon after.
His actions and might were Tyrannical as the wave of millions that was surging forth shockingly slowed and nearly came to a halt.
With Noah surging forward, only a few Beta Kun Pengs began to cluster with somber faces as their bodies lit up in dazzling fashions- a majestic voice booming out at this moment!
"What a glorious level of power."
WAA!
With a sense of unbound power and confidence even after seeing the recent actions, a single humanoid Kun Peng accompanied by over a dozen glorious Kung Pengs neared.
Valdez Tepez.
He came to stare at the Tyrannical and unblemished visage of Noah as he nodded with appreciation, his right hand buzzing as it rose up.
"For having such a power...it is a shame that you are on the enemy's side."
Billowing and intense fluctuations of power began to rise- a shocking clash about to bloom!
At the same time, the death of tens of thousands of Primogenial Strata LEGENDS from the Ancient Races acted as endless fuel for Noah. Fuel for his advancement- fuel for his glory!
In the Dimensional Holy Land, Noah was situated upon a throne that was now covered all around by vast stretches of mountains of False Grotto Nacres, Liquified Soul Seas, and Physique Refining Pearls.
The Loot from tens of thousands of LEGENDS was immense.
When it was further Sextupled- it just became ridiculous!
It...was enough.
"Enough for full saturation..."

His booming voice reverberated out as the endless mountains of loot brought about from the foundations of existences that had lived for millions of years...all of it surged towards him so he could achieve completion for this stage of his Realm!

sentences.text: The vast waves of surging LEGENDS were given a show of utmost glory.

All radiance and luminosity faded as an astoundingly devilish young man appeared before everyone, a tight white shirt and Obsidian pants hugging him as miniature black halos of light spun below and behind him!

With this form active, the horrific pressure this being released seemed to all but fade away as the nearby Primogenial Strata LEGENDS breathed easier, but this didn't last long as this being raised his left and right hand an instant later.
SHAA!

Billowing waves of pure will and mental energy bloomed out like surging seas to meet the waves of rushing LEGENDS.

Second was the disruption of abilities up to the level of REIFIED ones as they could be entirely canceled!

'This....'
The thoughts of these minor characters undeserving of names turned tumultuous as their destinies dimmed entirely.
While their Souls and Origins were sealed, the billowing Haki of an Emperor in his True Form surged over them as it was purely Dream Dimensional Soul Damage Values!
With two of their strongest Aspects sealed...they were truly helpless as they couldn't do anything.
What was Noah's damage at this moment?

This was a 21,000x multiplier as with Noah's close to 10,000 Base Damage Values in addition to the Atlatl of Reality he now held, a single attack from him was over 200 Million Damage Values.
When doubled by the Throne of Unnamed Tyranny, over 400 Million Damage Values were easily dished out.
It was...simply bullying Primogenial Strata LEGENDS at this point.
BOOOOM!
The billowing will of the Unnamed Kainos Emperor descended onto anchored and suppressed Primogenial LEGENDS as everywhere his Haki passed...the lives of tens of thousands of LEGENDS dimmed!
Tens of thousands of Primogenial Strata LEGENDS!

<Your Authority as an Emperor of this Age has risen greatly.>

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1869
paragraphs: Noah planned for 9 Layers of Dimensions for his new Realm of Progression.
Each layer would represent a Dimension as at this moment, he hadn't even begun the proliferation of the first layer as he only had a Seed!
A Dream Dimensional Reality Seed.
The very Essence of Nature had told him that due to his path, proceeding forward would be extremely arduous and require a tremendous amount of resources.
It should have been something that took a great deal of time to achieve!
Yet Noah...
He had taken an opportunity by its reigns as he devoured the foundations and strength of tens of thousands of Primogenial Strata LEGENDS.
The foundations of beings who had collectively lived through billions of years!

It was enough for many things as the mountains of sextupled False Grotto Nacres, Liquified Soul Seas, and Physique Refining Pearls...Noah's will surged to cover them as they were instantly lulled into his body.
Who said one had to slowly allow seas of essence to build up their foundation?
Who said that one had to slowly watch as Millions of Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos formed?
Who said that Noah couldn't watch hundreds of billions form every second!?
The mountains of loot that should have released their essence slowly were devoured at once as Noah's body trembled and bubbled.
His gloriously strong body buzzed and nearly cracked.
His strong soul shimmering with gold trembled but stood stable!
His Origin that had been forging hundreds of millions of Cosmos came to a halt before an instant later...
BOOOOM!
Hundreds of Billions of these unique Cosmos that should have been hard to form began to proliferate and bloom madly.
His golden Dream Dimensional Soul expanded and churned with majestic storms!
, m His body...had its Organs, Bones, and Musculature constantly refined to the very limits as the Mythical Natural Born Infinite Dream Physique continued its Cycles.
Above, the Infinite Reality Passages continued to form!
Everything in this location shone with radiance and maddening majesty as Noah went towards nothing but Saturation.
And when he was fully Saturated in all Aspects of Existence...there was nothing that could stop him from forming his First Layer of Dimension.
What would his enemies do then?
What confidence could existences like Valdez Tepez rely on thereafter?!
"Tepez..."
WAA!
As Noah felt the number of Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos spill over 4 Trillion, he thought of the toughest enemy to face in this Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest.
His clone that took on the form of a Celestial Grimoire spun another page.
Dazzling words began to fill Noah's mind as he continued to enjoy the wonders of <Resonance of Nature>!
<....Tepez gazed at the immensely powerful genius before him with a tinge of regret.
If only someone as accomplished as this appeared in their Race.
If only they fought to restore the honor of Nature and how things once were!
BZZZT!
Essence chaotically began to buzz around Tepez as he raised his right hand.

The waves of Millions spread left and right as they moved to circle the remaining Pure-Blooded Primordial Geniuses, the vast majority of them currently left bloody or dead as many ripped apart Infinite Willow Trees, Reality Ursidae, Royal Humans, Dragon Phoenixes, and Astral existences lay around lifeless- their crowns forever dim!

The hand that rose from Tepez told the masses of LEGENDS to focus on the remaining weaker beings as he and the Beta Strata LEGENDS around him would focus on the geniuses playing around with the Natural Laws of Reality and Decretum of a Dimension.
The battlefield came to focus.

The visage of Noah in his glorious adornment faced off against the figure of Tepez who stopped in the distance, the shrouded Assassin Emperor of Severance that had been called out earlier showing a shocking level of destruction as its conditions and Multipliers were vastly different!
But since genuine Beta Strata LEGENDS were cognizant of it now, it was shockingly intercepted on its 25th chain before it could stack too many kills!

A Virulent Drake with dark blue scales appeared as its draconic limbs shone, coming to face the scythe of the Assassin Emperor of Severance head on to make sure this dominating ability didn't continue accumulating power.
But...there was a misconception to the damage of this terrifying ability even though it had only chained halfway compared to last time.
Its Damage at the 25th Chain at this moment while cast under Noah's Ascendant True Form...was even higher than the last 50th chain of his normal True Form.
So the results...
BOOM!
Was disbelief and horror painted the Virulent Drake as over 700 Million True Dimensional Soul Damage Values smashed into him.

Under the eyes of Beta Strata LEGENDS who thought they were now prepared, this being was utterly shredded in his Aspects of Existence as his Soul was the first to fall, everything else following soon after.
A Black Gold Loot Crate bloomed and silently surged towards Noah as the eyes of the Assassin Emperor of Severance were bright, continuing forward to another Beta Strata LEGEND as it called for blood!
But...
"This is enough."
HUUUM!

The undeniable voice rang out as the Assassin Emperor of Severance found its target forcibly changed, its scythe receiving an undeniable tug that directed it towards no other place but the skies where one being stood.
One being whose right hand was shimmering with a heart throbbing light- a shocking pulling force redirecting the very Essence of Sever towards it!
The Assassin Emperor of Severance let off a light of tyranny as it took on the challenge, using the pulling force to go even faster towards the challenger.
It arrived before the hand pulling towards it in a blink as a deadly amount of Damage that average Beta Strata LEGENDS would dread erupted out!
And yet...it was different this time around.
The hand that was stretched out pulsed.

It took in the 750+ Million Dream Dimensional Soul Damage as it began to shine with soul shaking light, the eyes of the holder of this hand beginning to shine with luminous understanding as he gazed forward!
Yet the damage was still disastrous as the fair skin around this hand began to melt- revealing a shocking allure of gold that lay beneath as this was what absorbed the damage.

As the damage was absorbed, the image of the Assassin Emperor of Severance was stopped by the shocking force of this golden hand that was being revealed- only to be dissipated soon after even as its gaze remained cold and unyielding.
Just like that, a shocking ability was pulled and stopped by the dazzling right hand of Valdez Tepez!
His hand...that shone with immeasurable weight...>
WAA!
Another page of the Celestial Grimoire turned after showing the unfolding events from different perspectives as Noah's face remained calm, his full focus elsewhere.
The explosion of his Aspects of Reality reached their very summit at this moment as his Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos spilled over 9 Trillion as it forged towards a nice and even final number.
A number that would confirm he had reached....Saturation!

bundled_chapters.title: Chapter 1870
paragraphs: His Dream Dimensional Soul surged endlessly with the grandeur of gold.
His body shone with golden crystallized light as he seemed to be forged and made at the centers of Dimensional Singularities!
And not too long after as he had absorbed simply too many Physique Refining Pearls, False Grotto Nacres, and Liquified Soul Seas...
HOOOONG!
His body radiated luminous golden light all around as all of his Aspects of Existence reached Noah's own acceptable boundary from what he knew he could achieve!
<Your Dream Dimensional Reality Seed has reached full Saturation.>
<Your Dream Dimensional Soul has reached full Saturation.>
<Your Dream Dimensional Body has reached full Saturation.>
Three dazzling prompts came as they delivered to Noah the fateful news.
10 Trillion Kainos Royal Dream Cosmos.
An exceedingly vast and endless Soul Sea and an immeasurably tout body!
<Your Dream Dimensional Reality Seed grants an additional 5,000 True Dimensional Dream Damage and Defense Values.>
<Your Reserves of the Essence of Reality have been elevated to the Maximum of 10 Million.>
<Your Affinity to the Natural Laws of Reality has risen greatly.>
BOOOM!
Unfiltered and Celestial radiance erupted from Noah's body as every part of him screamed of wonder and majesty!
Even the Throne of Unnamed Tyranny he sat on became illuminated by his radiance that only continued to get brighter.
<Your Dream Dimensional Body's Innate Dimensional Barrier is now equivalent to 150% of the highest reachable Defense Values in your strongest form.>

<Your Dream Dimensional Sea can more profoundly resonate with nature, the formation of TABOO concepts becoming 1,000% faster as you gain more perception of the Natural Laws of Reality and Decretums of Dimensions.>
Shocking prompts descended before Noah's eyes as his already ridiculous Damage and Defence Values gained an additional base of 5,000!
His maximum Reserves of the Essence of Reality became 10 Million!
The Innate Dimensional Barrier around his body alone was about to become just disgusting to his enemies as the number continued to rise.
All these...were just the boons of reaching full Saturation.
<You have met the conditions to begin establishing your First Layer of a Dimensional Reality.>
Noah stared at these words serenely as the shining lights around him began to dim down.
But before they could dim entirely...
"Triple Empower all Aspects of Existence."
HOONG!
From the depths of his body, 300 magisterial True Stars of Conquest rose.
Their purpose was singular as the domineering light of Conquest went on to bathe his Origin, Body, and Soul!

The boons from full saturation further secured his power against the current enemies as their empowering might not necessarily grant quantifiable results, but their results were bound to elevate him even further as from this moment onward...he just needed to comprehend the resonance of his Aspects of Existence and break through.
Would it be something hard...or just incredibly easy?!
Noah didn't forge forward just yet as he grasped the situation around him first.
The newly appearing figure of Valdez Tepez and his astounding right hand that shone with golden incandescence!
Noah's will surged as his True Clone in the form of the Celestial Grimoire exploded with even more authority, shining words beginning to be written once more.
<...A maddeningly powerful right hand.
Valdez Tepez felt its surging strength that he had gotten control over these past years, and yet it still didn't feel like a part of him as it held something even he couldn't fully understand!
But this was the strength his father had passed down to him before he perished.
The Will that had passed from father to son as it carried down the hopes of the Great Commander!
'The Will of Commander Feng will not be reigned in by a single Primordial Genius.'
WAA!
His essence moved.
He resonated with his hand that had dissipated the enemy's attack as it now shone with blinding gold light, the weaving of tendinous Musculature tightly wrapping around each other being clear.

The entire arm seemed like it was forged from a celestial haven as it caused the surroundings to tremble, Tepez's eyes releasing rays of profundity as glorious Halos erupted and fused into his body, many of them Black in color as the magisterial form of a golden crimson scaled Kun Peng appeared!

Two massive claw like draconic Limbs were sprouting on its front sides as a long extending dead sea monstrously beautiful tail extended behind him- wings of draconian flames erupting from his back as his draconic head...it released waves of Royal majesty that couldn't be matched.

Of the two massive claw like limbs, the right one released the same terrifying terror of the prior right hand Tepez held as it now seemed even more glorious, much of Noah's authority and suppression being pushed away since the arrival of this hand!
Thereafter, Tepez only spoke lightly as his right hand flashed.
<Thousand-Armed Monumental Defiler>.
OOOOOM!
Essence surged and converged madly.

All of it spun crazily behind Tepez as it formed into the massive REIFIED figure of an existence whose race couldn't fully be made out, the only distinct thing being the fact that numerous titanic arms sprouted off the sides of this creature whose entire body was made of gold and a menacing crimson light, its head being more feminine as its seemed like the anthropomorphic mixture of a Dragon and human!
Four Crimson gold horns rose on its head as extremely sharp flaming wings shone behind it.
The waves of maddening power it released were unbelievable as when Noah gazed upon it, his eyes quantified the coming Damage Values to shockingly be close to 1000 Million.
SHAA!
The many hands of the <Thousand-Armed Monumental Defiler> surged towards Noah as they released a shocking light of despair!

Yet the Unnamed Kainos Emperor remained unfettered as he once more cast Ascendant Reality Sever, the power of this ability at this moment being even more dreadful as it easily spilled over 700 Million.

This was due to Noah's base boost being given an additional 5,000 after he reached the saturation of his Origin, where the first attack of Sever was now similar to the past 25th Chain of it this same ability!
BOOOM!

The pulsing hands of the <Thousand-Armed Monumental Defiler> smashed into the scythe of the blooming Assassin Emperor of Severance as the stable space of the Kun Peng's Cataclysm Nest...began to rip in ever so small amounts.

Shockingly, even though there was a discrepancy in the Damage Values of a few hundred million and the Assassin Emperor of Severance had its visage faded first, the massive and terrifying crimson gold visage of the <Thousand-Armed Monumental Defiler> also began to fade soon after as its eyes and horns shone with power and malice.
Yet Tepez was unfazed at this as an instant later...
"Thousand-Armed Monumental Defiler."
He calmly called out once more.
BZZZT!
And the massive figure with shining power and malice formed once more as the massive claw like limbs of Tepez shone!
He wasn't worried if his enemy could clash with his abilities, nor if he was even profoundly powerful enough to dispel it with wild power.
This was because the weight of the hand he bore was too big.
The ability he had cast once could be cast again...and again...and again!
This was due to the will he carried.
This was due to the hand he held!
It was....EMPYRAL!
Another page of the Celestial Grimoire turned as after Noah read its recent words, his eyes could help but release shocking beams of light!
